children.text: कथाप्रारंभ ॥
children.translated_text: Beginning of the Story.

children.text: काब्य बद्ध
शकुन्तला दुष्यन्त के गन्धर्व विवाह के विषय में
children.translated_text: Concerning the <s>Gāndharva</s> marriage of <s>Śakuntalā</s> and <s>Duṣyanta</s>.
Composed in verse.

children.text: सवैया
children.translated_text: Savaiyā meter.

children.text: एक समय मुनिनायक कौशिक कानन जाय महातप
कीन्हों । देह को दीन्होंकलेश महा मिटि भेष गयोन
children.translated_text: afflicting his body with severe hardship, his appearance so changed that nothing

children.text: परै कछु चीन्हों ॥ निशिबासर नेमकियो ही निवाज,
children.translated_text: could be recognized. Day and night he kept his vow — O <s>Nivāja</s>,

children.text: निरंजन के पद मैं चित दीन्हों । साधिकै योग को आ-
children.translated_text: he fixed his mind upon the feet of the Formless One (<s>Nirañjana</s>). Perfecting the posture of <s>yoga</s>,

children.text: सन यों इन्द्रासन इन्द्र को चाहत लीन्हों ८ अन्हैबे
children.translated_text: he thus sought to seize the throne of <s>Indra</s> from <s>Indra</s> himself. 8. To bathe at

children.text: कों तीरथ कोऊ बचो न फिर्यो सिगरीं सरतानि के
children.translated_text: the <s>tīrthas</s>, not a single one remained unvisited — he wandered along all the riverbanks.

children.text: कूलनि । चारिहू आगि के बीच में बैठि सह्यो सविता
children.translated_text: Seated amidst fires on four sides, he endured the piercing heat of the sun.

children.text: सन्ताप के शूलनि ॥ धूम को पान अमान कियो पग
children.translated_text: He drank smoke without measure, and hung head-downward with feet bound

children.text: ऊरध बांधि अधोमुख झूलनि । चौंसठि साल विशाल
children.translated_text: above. For sixty-four years, the great lord of sages

children.text: ऋषीश्वर खाइ रह्यो बन के फल फूलनि ९ ॥
children.translated_text: subsisted on the fruits and flowers of the forest. 9.

children.text: घनाक्षरी छंद
children.translated_text: Ghanākṣarī meter.

children.text: धूपके दिननि हेरैमन मुख सूरज सों सन्मुख चाहे
children.translated_text: On hot days, he gazed with his mind facing the sun directly,

children.text: अरु प्रबल अनल वारि धरि कें । जाड़े के दिननि
children.translated_text: and held powerful fire with water. On cold winter days,

children.text: यों रहत जल सोइबैठि रहत नदीमें गरे लों जल भरि
children.translated_text: he would sit immersed in water, remaining in the river with water up to his neck.

children.text: कें ॥ देखि विश्वामित्रको बिशालनेम संयमयों अतिही
children.translated_text: Seeing <s>Viśvāmitra</s>'s vast discipline and self-restraint, the Lord of the Gods (<s>Sureśa</s>)

children.text: सुरेश सो सरल भयो डरिकें । मन को प्रपंच करिबेकों
children.translated_text: became thoroughly alarmed. To create a stratagem of the mind,

children.text: मघवाने तब मेनका बुलाई सन्मान बड़ों करिकें १० ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Maghavān</s> (Indra) then summoned <s>Menakā</s>, honoring her greatly. 10.

children.text: दोहा । आदर देखि सुरेशको हरषति हिरदयखोलि ।
children.translated_text: Dohā meter. Seeing the respect of the Lord of the Gods, she rejoiced with an open heart. In this manner, <s>Menakā</s> rose and spoke to <s>Maghavān</s>. 11.

children.text: याविधितबमघवानसों उठीमेनकाबोलि ११ ॥
घनाक्षरी छन्द । और की कहाहै ब्रह्म हरिहरहू कों
children.translated_text: Ghanākṣarī meter. What need to speak of others — even <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Hari</s>, and <s>Hara</s>,

children.text: जो कहो तो मन्मथ बश काम करि आऊं सो । मेरेमहा
children.translated_text: if you command, I shall bring <s>Manmatha</s> (the god of love) under my power. In my great

children.text: मोह में ठहरि सको छिन भरि ऐसो तिहूंलोक में मैं
children.translated_text: enchantment, not even for a moment can anyone stand firm — such a <s>yogī</s> in all three worlds

children.text: योगी ठहराऊं सो ॥ विश्वामित्र जू को जप तप नेम
children.translated_text: I shall bring to a halt. <s>Viśvāmitra</s>'s chanting, austerity, discipline,

children.text: संयम घरी में खोइ आऊं नेक अवसु करिपाऊं सो ।
children.translated_text: and self-restraint I shall destroy in a moment — just grant me the occasion.

children.text: मुनि के जो मेनकेत नाच गान चाउ महाराजकी दुहाई
children.translated_text: If, before the sage, <s>Menakā</s> does not dance and sing with great zeal, then by the oath of the great king,

children.text: मैं न मैनका कहाऊं सो १२ ॥
children.translated_text: I shall not call myself <s>Menakā</s>! 12.

children.text: छप्पै । गहिकर बीन प्रवीन निपटपरवीन पियारी ।
children.translated_text: Chappai meter. Taking the <s>vīṇā</s> in hand, supremely skilled, the beloved one,

children.text: चढ़ि बिमान असमान लोकतें भूमि सिधारी ॥ सोरह
children.translated_text: mounting the celestial chariot, descended from the heavenly realm to earth.

children.text: करि शृंगार पहरि द्वादश आभूषण । लखि जु अंग
children.translated_text: Adorning herself with sixteen adornments and wearing twelve ornaments,

children.text: की ज्योति गये छिपि शशि अरुपूषण ॥ तप भंग कर-
children.translated_text: seeing the radiance of her limbs, the moon and the stars went into hiding.

children.text: न की बेलि सी फुरसति सी फूलीफली । मूरति बनाइ
children.translated_text: Like a vine blossoming and bearing fruit at the opportune moment to break his penance,

children.text: निज मोहनी मुनिके मनहिं मोहन चली १३ ॥
children.translated_text: fashioning her own enchanting form, she set out to beguile the sage's mind. 13.

children.text: हरिगीत छन्द । सुखिचंद की नहिं होति अब ल-
children.translated_text: Harigīt meter. The moonlight no longer remains pleasing upon

children.text: खि ज्योति जा मुखचंदकी । लरिव चरनकर सुखमा भजी
children.translated_text: beholding the radiance of that moon-face. The beauty of her feet and hands rivals

children.text: सुखमा सरोरुहचंदकी ॥ लखि नैन जाके ललित खंजन
children.translated_text: the beauty of the lotus-moon. Seeing her lovely eyes — <s>khañjana</s> birds,

children.text: मीन अरु मृगनैन की । मुनिमैन के बश करन को उ-
children.translated_text: fish, and deer-eyes pale before them —

children.text: तरी तपोबन मेन की १४ ॥
children.translated_text: to bring the sage under the sway of <s>Madana</s> (Love), the daughter of <s>Menā</s> descended to the hermitage grove. 14.

children.text: हरिगीत छंद । फहरात अंचल नैन चंचल निपट
children.translated_text: Harigīt meter. Her veil fluttering, eyes darting, swaying with utter grace

children.text: लचकत लंफतें । करत विविधकटाक्ष अलपत रागऊंचे
children.translated_text: in her gait, casting various sidelong glances, singing <s>rāga</s>s in high

children.text: सुरनतें ॥ सुनिरागके मृदु सुरनिमुनि दृगखोलिदीन्हें ध्या
children.translated_text: melodious notes — hearing the soft melody of the <s>rāga</s>, the sage opened his eyes from

children.text: न तें । छबि लखत लूट्यों तपजुछूट्यो छुट्यो ऋषि तप
children.translated_text: meditation. Beholding that splendor, his penance was plundered, his austerity broken — the sage was severed from his ascetic knowledge. 15.

children.text: चौपाई । मार्यो मन्मथ साधि शरासन । छोड़ि दि-
children.translated_text: Chaupāī meter. <s>Manmatha</s> (Kāmadeva) struck, readying his bow.

children.text: यो मुनि योग को आसन ॥ जप तप संयम धर्म नशा-
children.translated_text: The sage abandoned the seat of <s>yoga</s>.

children.text: यो । मोहि मेनका के ढिग आयो ॥ अंग अंग सों आ-
children.translated_text: Chanting, penance, self-restraint, and <s>dharma</s> were destroyed. Beguiled, he came near <s>Menakā</s>.

children.text: नि लगायो । योग कियेको फल मनु पायो ॥ एक मुहू-
children.translated_text: Limb to limb he embraced her, as if he had obtained the fruit of all his <s>yoga</s>.

children.text: रत के सुख कारन । खोयो तप करिबर्ष हजारन ॥ पी-
children.translated_text: For the pleasure of a single moment,

children.text: छे निकट बहुत पछितानो । वा बन तें मुनि अनत परा-
children.translated_text: he lost the penance of a thousand years. Afterward, he deeply repented,

children.text: नो ॥ गर्भ मेनका कीन्हों धारन । तब सो मन में लगी
children.translated_text: and the sage fled from that forest to another place.

children.text: बिचारन ॥ नर गर्भहि ले कें जो जावै । तो सुरपुर
children.translated_text: <s>Menakā</s> conceived a child. Then she began to ponder in her mind:

children.text: महँ पैठि न पावे ॥ भई सुता नौ मास भये जब । गई
children.translated_text: "If I carry this mortal's child with me, I shall not gain entry into the celestial city."

children.text: मेनका सुरपुर को तब ॥ १६ ॥
children.translated_text: A daughter was born when nine months had passed. Then <s>Menakā</s> departed for the heavenly realm. 16.

children.text: सवैया । डर डारि सुता कों गई सुरलोकहि दूध
children.translated_text: Savaiyā meter. Abandoning her daughter in fear, she went to the celestial world — she did not nurse her even for a moment.

children.text: पियायो न एक घरी । यह जानि कें मानस की जन्मी
children.translated_text: Knowing her to be born of a mortal's passion,

children.text: कछु मेनका नेकु दयानधरी ॥ कुल माहिंन कोऊ जोराखे
children.translated_text: <s>Menakā</s> showed not the least compassion. In the family there was no one to look after her anywhere — why then did the Creator create her?

children.text: कहूं वह काहे को धौं करतार करी । सुधिलेबे की कोऊ
children.translated_text: There was no one in her company to care for her;

children.text: नहीं सँगमें बन सूने शकुन्तला रोवे परी ॥ १७ ॥
children.translated_text: in the desolate forest, <s>Śakuntalā</s> lay weeping. 17.

children.text: सवैया । न्हैबेकों जाय कढ़यो तिहि मारग देखि के
children.translated_text: Savaiyā meter. Going to bathe, <s>Kaṇva</s> came upon that path and, seeing her, showed great compassion.

children.text: कण्व कृपा अति कीन्ही । देव कि दानवकै नर की कि-
children.translated_text: "Is she of the gods, or of the demons, or of men, or

children.text: धौं नाग की है न परै कुछचीन्ही ॥ सुंदर ऐसी सुताकि-
children.translated_text: of the <s>Nāgas</s>?" — nothing could be discerned. "So beautiful a daughter —

children.text: हि कारण को बन में गहि डारि धों दीन्ही । रोवे अके-
children.translated_text: for what reason was she seized and cast away in the forest?" Weeping alone

children.text: ली परी बनमें ऋषिआय उठाय शकुन्तला लीन्ही १८ ॥
children.translated_text: in the forest, the sage came, lifted up <s>Śakuntalā</s>, and took her. 18.

children.text: दोहा । लीहें सुता शकुन्तला कलपत आश्रम आय ।
children.translated_text: Dohā meter. Taking the daughter <s>Śakuntalā</s>, lamenting, he came to the hermitage. He said to his sister <s>Gautamī</s>, "Revive this child and keep her alive." 19.

children.text: कह्यो गौतमी बहनि सों याकों देहु जिवाय ॥ १९ ॥
छप्पै । सुन्दर गात निहारि गौतमी गरैं लगाई ।
children.translated_text: Chappai meter. Beholding her beautiful form, <s>Gautamī</s> embraced her.

children.text: आयुर्बल तें जिअत नहीं करि यतन जिवाई ॥ करैं कृपा
children.translated_text: She was barely alive — with great effort, she was revived.

children.text: ऋषि बहुत सबै सबके मन भाई । सकल तपोबन मा-
children.translated_text: The sages showed much kindness; she became dear to everyone's heart.

children.text: हिं कण्वकी सुता कहाई ॥ दिन दिन कन्या बढ़त प्रभा
children.translated_text: Throughout the hermitage, she was known as <s>Kaṇva</s>'s daughter.

children.text: छबि अंग अंग फैलिनलगी । गहिबांह सखिनि के संग
children.translated_text: Day by day the girl grew, her radiance and beauty spreading through every limb.

children.text: द्रुमनछांह खेलन लगी ॥ २० ॥
children.translated_text: Taking her friends by the hand, she began playing in the shade of the trees. 20.

children.text: दोहा । शकुन्तला सँग दुइ सखी रहतीं आठौ याम ।
children.translated_text: Dohā meter. Two companions stayed with <s>Śakuntalā</s> at all times of the day.

children.text: यक अनसूया नाम अरु प्रियम्बदा यकनाम ॥ २१ ॥
children.translated_text: One was named <s>Anasūyā</s>, and the other was named <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>. 21.

children.text: सवैया । बैस हैं तीनों समान सखीं दिन हूं दिन
children.translated_text: Savaiyā meter. The three friends were equal in age, and day by day

children.text: तीनहुं प्रीतिबढ़ाई । प्राण तिहूंनके ह्वैरहे यों यक देह में
children.translated_text: their mutual affection grew. Their lives became as one — three souls

children.text: तीनहुं देह दिखाई ॥ शोभा तिहूंन के अंगनि की कबि
children.translated_text: appeared in a single body. The beauty of their limbs —

children.text: केतो करे बरणी नहिं जाई । राखी तिहूंन के अंगनि में
children.translated_text: however much the poet describes, it cannot be fully told.

children.text: बिधि तीनहुं लोक की सुन्दरताई ॥ २२ ॥
children.translated_text: The Creator placed the beauty of all three worlds in the limbs of those three. 22.

children.text: सवैया । काम कमान चढ़ाइ मनो जबहीं कसि के
children.translated_text: Savaiyā meter. As if <s>Kāma</s> (the god of love) had strung his bow and aimed his enchanting arrows somewhere —

children.text: कहुं मोंहनि फेरे । बात कहे हँसि कें जबहीं तब श्रौन-
children.translated_text: whenever they spoke laughing, it was as if nectar was being

children.text: नि माहिं सुधासो निचोरे ॥ जामग ह्‌वैके धरे पगतामग
children.translated_text: squeezed into the ears. Like dark clouds that, having become the path, brought dark fragrance — <s>Anańga</s> (the Bodiless One) ran forth like aloe-wood.

children.text: आनि अनंग अगारू ह्वै दौरे । सुन्दर हैं वे तीनोंसखीं
children.translated_text: Beautiful were all three friends,

children.text: पै शकुन्तला की छविहै कछु औरे २३ ॥
children.translated_text: but the splendor of <s>Śakuntalā</s> was something else entirely. 23.

children.text: दोहा । कछुकदिनन में कण्व मुनि बनते कियोपयान ।
children.translated_text: Dohā meter. After some days, the sage <s>Kaṇva</s> set out from the forest on a journey.

children.text: आश्रमराखिशकुन्तलातीरथचल्योनहान २४ ॥
children.translated_text: Leaving <s>Śakuntalā</s> at the hermitage, he departed for a pilgrimage to bathe at the sacred waters. 24.

children.text: सवैया, । कछु खैबे कों माँगो चहो जब हीं तब हीं
children.translated_text: Savaiyā meter. "Whenever you wish to eat something, ask,

children.text: तुम गौतमी सों कहियो। ऋषि आवे जो कोऊइतै तिहि
children.translated_text: and tell <s>Gautamī</s> at once. If any sage comes here,

children.text: को करि आदर पांइन को गहियो ॥ यह सीख शकुन्त
children.translated_text: receive him with respect and touch his feet."

children.text: लै दै जू गयो ह्वै उदास कछू करियो न हियो । रह
children.translated_text: Giving this instruction, <s>Śakuntalā</s> accepted it, and he departed, somewhat sorrowful. "Do not let your heart be troubled.

children.text: द्योसनि में फिरि आवतु हों तब लों तुम आनन्द सों
children.translated_text: I shall return within some days — until then, remain
in happiness." 25.

children.text: लागी रहन बाप बिन बनमें । मई उदासी कछुक
children.translated_text: Without her father, she began living in the forest. Some melancholy arose

children.text: दिनन में ॥ आश्रम कोउ अतीत जो आवे । ताकों आ-
children.translated_text: in those days. Whenever a guest came to the hermitage,

children.text: दर निपट दिवावे ॥ पासहि के तंदुल गहि ध्यावे । मृग
children.translated_text: she would show him the utmost hospitality.

children.text: छौननि कों आनि खवावे ॥ पानी भरि मूलनि ढरकावे ।
children.translated_text: She would take nearby grain and offer it with devotion, bring food for the young deer,

children.text: छोटे छोटे द्रुमनि बढ़ावे ॥ सोई करै जो यह कछुभाखै ।
children.translated_text: fill water and pour it over the roots of plants,

children.text: जियतें अधिक गौतमी राखे ॥ शकुन्तला को सुख बहु
children.translated_text: and tend the small trees, making them grow. Whatever was asked of her, she did.

children.text: चाहति । दोऊ सखियन सँग में राखति ॥ बालबैस बहु
children.translated_text: <s>Gautamī</s> cared for her more than her own life, always wishing <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s happiness,

children.text: द्योस बिताई । झलकनि लगी कछुक तरुणाई २६ ॥
children.translated_text: keeping her in the company of both friends. Many days of her youthful age passed,

children.text: घनाक्षरी । बिसरन लागो बालापनको अयनप सखिन
children.translated_text: Ghanākṣarī meter. Childhood began to be forgotten, and with her companions

children.text: सों सयानप की बतियां गढ़न लगी । दृगलगि तिरीछे
children.translated_text: conversations of maturity began to form. Her eyes started to move sidelong,

children.text: चलनि पग मन्द लागे उर में कछुक उसांसे सी चढ़न
children.translated_text: her steps grew slow, and within her breast sighs began to rise.

children.text: लगी ॥ अंगनि में आई तरुणाई की झलक लरिकाई
children.translated_text: The gleam of youth appeared in her limbs, and childhood

children.text: अब देह तें हरें हरें कढ़नलगी । होन लागी कटिया
children.translated_text: began to depart from her body, fading away.

children.text: वचटिकें छला सी द्वैज चन्द्र की कला सी तन दीपति
children.translated_text: Her waist began to grow slender like a wasp's, and the radiance of her body began to increase like the crescent moon's waxing light.

children.text: बढ़न लगी २७ ॥
चौपाई । बनहू मैं नहिं दुरति दुराई । शकुन्तलाकी
children.translated_text: Chaupāī meter. Even in the forest, the beauty of <s>Śakuntalā</s>

children.text: सुन्दरताई ॥ जनु बिरंचि कर आपु बनाई । देखे तें मन
children.translated_text: could not remain hidden.

children.text: सुधा सिराई । वह उपमा बरणी नहिं जाई । पूर्व कथा
children.translated_text: As if the Creator himself had fashioned her — upon seeing her, nectar filled the mind. That beauty cannot be described by any comparison;

children.text: भारत में गाई २८ ॥
children.translated_text: it has been sung in the ancient story of the <s>Bhārata</s>. 28.

children.text: घनाक्षरी । मृग के चर्म ही को पहिरैंदुकूल और
children.translated_text: Ghanākṣarī meter. She wore only deerskin garments — what ornaments could she have,

children.text: गहने की कहा है न गरे में जाकें पोति है । तोऊ जाके
children.translated_text: with no necklace of gems around her neck? Yet

children.text: अंग अंग रूपके तरंग उठें सुन्दर अनंग मानों अगनि
children.translated_text: from her every limb waves of beauty arose — as if <s>Anańga</s> (the god of love) were

children.text: की सोति है ॥ देह में निवाज ज्यों ज्यों जोबन बढ़त
children.translated_text: a flame of fire. O <s>Nivāja</s>, in her body, as youth increased

children.text: जात त्यों त्यों हरि दिननि बढ़त जात जोति है । छिन
children.translated_text: day by day, so too the radiance grew day by day.

children.text: और देखिये घरी में कछु और और और छिन छिन
children.translated_text: Look one moment and she appears one way, in the next moment something else — moment by moment,

children.text: घरी घरी औरै द्युति होति है २९ ॥
children.translated_text: hour by hour, her luster kept transforming. 29.

children.text: दोहा । सुन्दर वैसो बर मिले शकुन्तला ज्यों आप ।
children.translated_text: Dohā meter. "May a bridegroom as beautiful as <s>Śakuntalā</s> herself be found.

children.text: करि है ताको ब्याह यह करीप्रतिज्ञा बाप ३० ॥
children.translated_text: Her father has made a vow to arrange her marriage thus." 30.

children.text: लागी रहे शकुंतला बन में यह परकार ।
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s> continued living in the forest in this manner.

children.text: एकसमयदुष्यन्तनृप खेलनकढ़योशिकार ३१ ॥
children.translated_text: One day, King <s>Duṣyanta</s> set out on a hunt. 31.

children.text: घनाक्षरी । रथ असवार दौरे देखिकें शिकार नृप
children.translated_text: Ghanākṣarī meter. The king mounted his chariot and galloped forth upon seeing the game —

children.text: कीन्हों श्रम इतनो न जाकी कछु माप है । दिन चढ़ि
children.translated_text: his exertion was beyond measure. The day advanced; he had ridden very far,

children.text: आयो बढ़ि कढ़ि अति दूरे पैन पायो तोऊ यातें चढ़ि
children.translated_text: yet even so, the heat had risen in his body.

children.text: आयो तन तापहै ॥ जाय नजकाने घोड़े पवन के समा-
children.translated_text: The horses, swift as the wind, would not slow down — they raced on, and he drew his bow to his ear,

children.text: ने दौड़े बाण सों मिलाय खैंचि कान लगि चाप है ।
children.translated_text: matching his arrows to the string.

children.text: आगे तें हरिण भाग्यो ताके नृप संग लागो रही पीछे
children.translated_text: Ahead, a deer fled, and the king pursued it; behind him followed

children.text: सवसैना पीछै हिरिना के आप है ३२ ॥
children.translated_text: his entire army, and he himself was behind the deer. 32.

children.text: सवैया । फोंक लगाय करेरी कमान में कान लों खैं-
children.translated_text: Savaiyā meter. Drawing the bamboo bow with a whistle, pulling the arrow to his ear, he aimed.

children.text: चि लियो शर सास्यो । चोट करैं जब लों तब लों ऋषि
children.translated_text: Just as he was about to strike, from afar the sages

children.text: लोगन दूरि तें आनि पुकास्यो ॥ रक्षा ऋषीश्वर लोगन
children.translated_text: called out. "The protection of the sages

children.text: की करिबे कों भयो अवतार तिहारो । हाहा रह्यो मह-
children.translated_text: is the very purpose of your incarnation. Alas, alas!

children.text: राज हमारे तजो बन को मृग है मत मारो ३३ ॥
children.translated_text: O great king, spare the deer of the forest — do not kill it!" 33.

children.text: चौपाई । ऋषि लोगन यह टेर सुनायो । मृग पर
children.translated_text: Chaupāī meter. The sages thus called out their plea.

children.text: नहिं नृप बाणचलायो ॥ बागें गहि रथ ठाढ़ों कीन्हो ।
children.translated_text: The king did not release the arrow at the deer. Pulling the reins, he halted the chariot.

children.text: आशिर्बाद ऋषिन तब दीन्हो ॥ करि प्रणाम नृप पूछौ
children.translated_text: The sages then bestowed their blessings. The king bowed and then asked:

children.text: यह तब । कहो कण्व को आश्रम कहँ अब ॥ आज पाप
children.translated_text: "Tell me, where is the hermitage of <s>Kaṇva</s> now?

children.text: पुंजनि परि हरें । मुनिवर को चलि दरशन करें ॥ यह
children.translated_text: Today, may the heaps of my sins be removed — let me go and have the <s>darśana</s> of the great sage."

children.text: सुनि ऋषिन बहुत सुख पायो । आश्रम निपट नगीच
children.translated_text: Hearing this, the sages were greatly pleased. They indicated the hermitage was very close by.

children.text: बतायो । महाराज अब कछु दिन भये । तीरथ करन
children.translated_text: "O great king, some days ago,

children.text: कण्व मुनि गये ३४ ॥
children.translated_text: the sage <s>Kaṇva</s> went on a pilgrimage." 34.

children.text: चौपाई । शकुन्तला बेटी करि पाली । सौंप्यो ता
children.translated_text: Chaupāī meter. "He raised <s>Śakuntalā</s> as his own daughter

children.text: कहँ आश्रम खाली ॥ जो महराज वहां लगि जैहैं ।
children.translated_text: and entrusted the hermitage to her care. If the great king goes there,

children.text: यह सुनि कण्व महा सुखपैहैं ॥ तीरथ न्हाय जबै मुनि
children.translated_text: upon hearing this, <s>Kaṇva</s> will be greatly pleased.

children.text: अयहैं । शकुन्तला तासों पुनि कहि हैं ॥ यह मुनि
children.translated_text: When the sage returns from his pilgrimage,

children.text: बचननृपति मनबैठ्यो । रथतेंउतरि तपोबनपैठ्यो ३५ ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s> will tell him all." These words of the sages settled in the king's mind. He descended from his chariot and entered the hermitage grove. 35.

children.text: रथ सारथी समेत टिकायो । आश्रम निकट आप
children.translated_text: He stationed the chariot along with the charioteer. He himself came walking

children.text: चलि आयो ॥ दक्षिणबाहु लग्यो तबफरकन । प्रफुलि-
children.translated_text: near the hermitage. His right arm began to throb —

children.text: त भयो महीपति को मन ॥ कछुक दूरि आगे जब आ-
children.translated_text: the heart of the king was filled with joy.

children.text: यो । सगुन भयो ता कर फल पायो ॥ अद्भुत रूप बैस
children.translated_text: When he advanced a little further, the auspicious omen bore its fruit.

children.text: में नई ॥ बाला तीन नजर परि गई । शीत बात तें नहिं
children.translated_text: Three maidens of wondrous beauty and youthful freshness came into view.

children.text: कछु डरें । सब आश्रम की सेवा करें ३६ ॥
children.translated_text: Undaunted by the cold wind, they were performing all the service of the hermitage. 36.

children.text: हरिगीत छन्द । सेवा न आश्रमकी तजे ंअति श्रमि-
children.translated_text: Harigīt meter. Not abandoning the service of the hermitage, they would come back utterly

children.text: त हवै हवै आवतीं । कोमल कमल से करनि सों क्यारीं
children.translated_text: exhausted. With their tender, lotus-like hands, they would fashion

children.text: नवीन बनावतीं ॥ सिगरो तपोबन सींचिबेकों सलिल
children.translated_text: new flower beds. To water the entire hermitage grove, they would toil

children.text: श्रमकरिल्यावतीं । छोटे द्रुमनकेतटनि भरि भरि घटनि
children.translated_text: to bring water, filling pots and pouring them at the bases of young trees. 37.

children.text: को ढुरकावतीं ३७ ॥
हरिगीत छन्द । सींचति द्रुमन के थकि गईं तनर-
children.translated_text: Harigīt meter. Watering the trees, they grew weary — their bodies were covered

children.text: ह्यो श्रमजलछाय है । अति शिथिल सबअंग हवै गये
children.translated_text: with the moisture of exertion. All their limbs became utterly languid;

children.text: डगमगतिधरतीं पांयहैं ॥ खुलिकेशपासरहे बिथुरिभरती
children.translated_text: they placed their feet with faltering steps. Their hair had come loose and lay scattered;

children.text: उसांस अनंतहैं । तीनोंसखी यों सोहती मानोभये सुरतं-
children.translated_text: they drew endless sighs. The three friends appeared thus as if they were the very essence of beauty.

children.text: तहैं ॥ बिचद्रुमनके हवै जाति बाहर निकसि जोबन की
children.translated_text: Passing through the trees and emerging beyond, the splendor of their youth shone forth.

children.text: छटा । खुलि गये कच यों तड़ित हूं पर गिरि परी मनु
children.translated_text: Their hair had come undone — as if lightning itself

children.text: घन घटा ॥ सिगरे तपोबन में लसति यों गगन में ज्यों
children.translated_text: had been covered by the mass of dark clouds. Throughout the hermitage grove they shone

children.text: शशिकला । यह रूपसों श्रम मुनिन के सो करत बल
children.translated_text: like the crescent moon in the sky. With this beauty, the labor of the sages

children.text: शाकुन्तला ३८ ॥
children.translated_text: was sustained by <s>Śakuntalā</s>. 38.

children.text: घनाक्षरी छन्द । बानी कहिये तो वह बीन को लिये
children.translated_text: Ghanākṣarī meter. If one calls her <s>Vāṇī</s> (Sarasvatī) — she always holds the <s>vīṇā</s>;

children.text: ही रहे मौरी तौ गिरीश अर्द्धंग में लगाई है । कमला
children.translated_text: if one says <s>Gaurī</s> — she adorns the half-body of Lord <s>Giriśa</s> (Śiva).

children.text: न कान्हके हियेते उतरति अरु रमाके सरूप में न ए-
children.translated_text: <s>Kamalā</s> (Lakṣmī) never descends from <s>Kānha</s>'s (Kṛṣṇa's) heart, and in <s>Ramā</s>'s form such surpassing

children.text: ती अधिकाईहै ॥ रति कहिये तो यह बिरोध अतिहीहै
children.translated_text: beauty does not exist. If one calls her <s>Rati</s>, that too is a great contradiction,

children.text: अरु याके तो अंगलगि कछुकलरिकाई है । फेरि फेरि
children.translated_text: for compared to her, <s>Rati</s> still has something of childhood about her.

children.text: बेरि लगि हेरि हेरि हास्यो नृप जानि नाहिंपरी यह को
children.translated_text: Again and again the king gazed and gazed, and laughed, unable to comprehend —

children.text: है कहां आई है ३९ ॥
children.translated_text: "Who is she, and from where has she come?" 39.

children.text: घनाक्षरी । निरखि शकुंतला को नखशिख रीझि
children.translated_text: Ghanākṣarī meter. Gazing upon <s>Śakuntalā</s> from head to toe, the king was utterly

children.text: रह्यो आपु तो महीपति निछावरिसोकीन्होसो । भयो है
children.translated_text: captivated — the sovereign offered himself as a sacrifice to her beauty.

children.text: अचंभो रतिरंभोहै न ऐसी आसरूपको बखानको भयो
children.translated_text: He was filled with wonder — neither <s>Rati</s> nor <s>Rambhā</s> possessed such beauty; to praise such a form,

children.text: है बुधिहीनो सो ॥ सो कबि नेवाज शोभासिंधुमें समाने
children.translated_text: he had become bereft of wit. O poet <s>Nivāja</s>, in that ocean of beauty his eyes

children.text: नैन मनु जन मैन के हवाले करि दीन्हो सो । बाढ़यो
children.translated_text: were immersed — as if his mind had been surrendered to <s>Madana</s> (the god of love).

children.text: उरप्रेम गहि चित्र लिखि काढ़यो मनो ठाढ़यो नृप हवै
children.translated_text: Love swelled in his heart; as if a portrait had been drawn and extracted — the king stood

children.text: रह्यो ठग्यो सो मोल लीन्हो सो ४० ॥
children.translated_text: transfixed, as though enchanted, as though purchased by her beauty. 40.

children.text: दोहा । शकुन्तला को रूप लखि सुफल भयोनृपनैन ।
children.translated_text: Dohā meter. Beholding the beauty of <s>Śakuntalā</s>, the king's eyes became fulfilled.

children.text: श्रवणसुफलचाहतभयो सुनिसुनिमीठेबैन ४१ ॥
children.translated_text: His ears too longed to be fulfilled by hearing her sweet words. 41.

children.text: सघन द्रुमनकी ओटह्‌वै दृग निमेष बिसराय ।
children.translated_text: Concealed behind the dense trees, forgetting even to blink,

children.text: दुरें दुरें देखन लग्यो शकुन्तला के भाय ४२ ॥
children.translated_text: from afar he began watching the ways of <s>Śakuntalā</s>. 42.

children.text: चौपाई । राजहि ये देखहि नहिं कोऊ । पूछन लगीं
children.translated_text: Chaupāī meter. No one could see the king. The two companions began to ask

children.text: सहेली दोऊ ॥ शकुन्तलाजो सींचत जेते । मुनिके द्रुम-
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s> about the trees she was watering —

children.text: प्यारे कहि तेते ॥ मुनिकें तो प्राणनतें प्यारी । करी द्रुम-
children.translated_text: "These trees that the sage holds so dear,

children.text: निकी सींचनिहारी ॥ बिधिअतिहो सुकुमारि सम्हारी ।
children.translated_text: he has made you their caretaker.

children.text: श्रमलायक नाहिं देह तिहारी ॥ बतकहाव यों सखियन
children.translated_text: The Creator has fashioned you so delicate — your body is not made for such toil."

children.text: कीन्हो । शकुन्तला यह उत्तर दीन्हो ॥ ये द्रुम जे सब
children.translated_text: Thus the friends conversed. <s>Śakuntalā</s> gave this reply: "These trees, all of which

children.text: देत दिखाई । मैं जानति येही मम भाई ॥ मुनि के कहे
children.translated_text: appeared before her eyes. 'I know these are my brothers,' the sage said,

children.text: नहीं मैं सींचति । मोहिं मया लागति इन की अति ॥
children.translated_text: 'I do not water them. I feel great affection for them.'

children.text: हरिन चर्म की पहिरें आंगी । कसि बँधि गई गड़न
children.translated_text: Wearing a garment of deerskin, tightly bound, it pressed against her neck

children.text: उर लागी ॥ कर सों अँगिया खुलत न खोली । अन-
children.translated_text: and clung to her chest. With her hands she could not undo the blouse that would not open.

children.text: सूया सों तब यों बोली ॥ प्रियम्बदा कसि बांधी छति-
children.translated_text: She then spoke thus to <s>Anasūyā</s>: '<s>Priyaṃvadā</s>, you tied the blouse too tight!

children.text: या । अनसूया ढीली कर अंगिया ॥ अनसूया हंसि
children.translated_text: <s>Anasūyā</s>, loosen this blouse!' <s>Anasūyā</s> laughed and

children.text: अंगिया खोली । प्रियंबदा तब रिस करि बोली ॥ उस
children.translated_text: opened the blouse. <s>Priyaṃvadā</s> then spoke with annoyance: 'Her

children.text: सति आवे छिन छिन छतिया । याते गाढ़ी द्वैगइ अं-
children.translated_text: chest keeps swelling again and again, that is why the blouse is bound

children.text: गिया ॥ बढ़त जात जोबन की लीला । नाहक मेरो
children.translated_text: doubly tight.' The play of her burgeoning youth keeps growing — needlessly you

children.text: करतीं गीला ॥ शकुन्तला सुनि के शरमानी । सींचन
children.translated_text: blame me.' <s>Śakuntalā</s>, hearing this, was embarrassed, and began watering

children.text: लगी द्रुमन भरि पानी ४४ अलि यक छोड़ि कुसुम्भ
children.translated_text: the trees, filling water. [44] A bee left one safflower blossom

children.text: उड़ानो । शकुन्तला मुख पर ठहरानो ॥ सुमुखि सुगंध
children.translated_text: and flew to <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s face and hovered there. The bee, finding fragrance

children.text: पाय करि मधुकर । बैठयो जाय मधुर अधरन पर ॥
children.translated_text: on her beautiful face, settled upon

children.text: ससकि हाथ तबहीं झहरायो । उड़ि अलि गयो फेरि
children.translated_text: her sweet lips. She gasped and waved her hand at once — the bee flew away but came

children.text: फिरि आयो ॥ शकुन्तला ह्वांते टरिआई । पीछे भ्र-
children.translated_text: back again. <s>Śakuntalā</s> moved away from there, but the troublesome bee

children.text: मर लग्यो दुखदाई ॥ शकुन्तला पुनि जित जित
children.translated_text: followed after her. Wherever <s>Śakuntalā</s>

children.text: डोले । तित ति भ्रमर गुंजरत बोले ॥ राजा नि-
children.translated_text: went, the bee buzzed and hummed there too. The king, watching, became enamored in his heart,

children.text: रखत मन अनुरह्यो । मन मन मधुकर सो अस
children.translated_text: and in his mind he said to the bee
thus: [45]

children.text: घनाक्षरी छन्द । ओठन समीप गुंजत मड़रातमनो
children.translated_text: <s>Ghanākṣarī</s> metre: 'Buzzing near her lips, hovering about,

children.text: बतकही की लगावत लगन हो । चंचल दृगनि की
children.translated_text: you create the occasion for whispered conversation. You have agitated the lids of her restless eyes,

children.text: पलनि करी क्षोभित हूंछुओ फिर आनि कर कपोल
children.translated_text: and again you have come and touched the fruit of her cheek

children.text: फल कनीहो ॥ प्यारी ससकनि झहरावति करति तुम
children.translated_text: with your body. The dear one startles and waves you away,

children.text: उड़ि उड़ि बैठत पियत अधरन हो । दुरि दुरि दुरिही
children.translated_text: yet you fly and fly and alight again to drink from her lips. Standing far, far away,

children.text: ते देखत खड़े रहत मानो हम कीने काज मधुप तुम
children.translated_text: I watch and remain standing — as if you have accomplished my very task, O bee,

children.text: धन्य हो ४९ ॥
children.translated_text: you are blessed!' [49]

children.text: चौपाई । शकुंतला केतो कछु करै । सँग ते मधुप
children.translated_text: <s>Caupāī</s>: Whatever <s>Śakuntalā</s> might do, the bee

children.text: न टास्यो टरै ॥ बन में मधुकर बहुत सताई । शकुंतला
children.translated_text: would not leave her side, would not be driven away. In the forest the bee tormented her greatly, and <s>Śakuntalā</s>

children.text: यह टेर सुनाई ॥ सखियहु मोंढिग अरबर आवहु । या
children.translated_text: cried out this plea: 'O friends, come quickly to me!

children.text: पापीते मोहिं छुड़ावहु ॥ काटत आप टरत नहिं टारे ।
children.translated_text: Save me from this wretch! It stings and will not go when driven away,

children.text: होतु नाहिं कछु हाथन झारे ॥ निरखि सखिन यहहास
children.translated_text: nothing happens from waving my hands.' Seeing this, the friends

children.text: बढ़ायो । हमको तो बिन काज बुलायो ॥ या गनीम सों
children.translated_text: increased their laughter: 'You called us for no reason!

children.text: आनि बचावे । नृप दुःष्यन्तहि बेगि बुलावे ॥ तब नृप
children.translated_text: To save you from this enemy, quickly summon King <s>Duṣyanta</s>!'

children.text: निकसि द्रुमनते आयो । कहो कहो किहतुमहिं सतायो ॥
children.translated_text: Then the king emerged from behind the trees and came forward: 'Tell me, tell me, who has been tormenting you?'

children.text: निरखि नृपहि बिन मोल बिकानी । तीनों छकीं डरीं
children.translated_text: Seeing the king, she was captivated beyond price. All three were startled, frightened,

children.text: अकुलानी ॥ ठाढ़ी रहि न सकीं नहिं डोलें । जकि सों
children.translated_text: and flustered. They could neither stand still nor move; they remained

children.text: रहीं कछु नहिं बोलें ॥ अनसूया तब मन दृढ़कीन्हो ।
children.translated_text: frozen and said nothing. Then <s>Anasūyā</s> steadied her mind

children.text: सहाराजको उत्तर दीन्हो ४७ ॥
children.translated_text: and gave the king an answer. [47]

children.text: घनाक्षरी । जाके तेज होत न अनीति कहूं नीति
children.translated_text: <s>Ghanākṣarī</s>: 'By whose majesty no injustice occurs anywhere — rightly said,

children.text: कहो पानी एक घाट में पियत सिंह गाय है । जप तप
children.translated_text: the lion and the cow drink water at the same river bank. Ascetics perform austerities

children.text: करत तपसी निर्भय तपोबनमें दानव सकत नहिं आय
children.translated_text: fearlessly in the <s>tapovana</s> (forest of penance); demons cannot come near.

children.text: है ॥ काहू न सताई यह भोरीसी शकुन्तला उड़िकेसो
children.translated_text: No one has troubled this innocent <s>Śakuntalā</s> — only a bee

children.text: भ्रमरी भाजी भौन को डराय है । अति ही अभीत म-
children.translated_text: flew near and frightened her, and she fled to the house. O most fearless

children.text: हाराज श्री दुष्यंत ताके राज में ऋषिन कौन सकत
children.translated_text: great king, Śrī <s>Duṣyanta</s>, in your kingdom who can

children.text: सताय है ॥ ४८ ॥
children.translated_text: trouble the sages?' [48]

children.text: दोहा । शकुन्तला सों ताकि तब पूछी यह महिपाल ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Dohā</s>: Then the king looked at <s>Śakuntalā</s> and asked her:

children.text: कहो तिहारे कुशलहैं छोटे द्रुम मृगबाल ४९ ॥
children.translated_text: 'Tell me, are your little trees and young deer faring well?' [49]

children.text: कम्प बढ़यो तन कंटकित मुखते कढ़तनबैन ॥
children.translated_text: Trembling increased, her body bristled with goosebumps, no words came from her mouth;

children.text: जकिसीरहीशकुन्तलानिरखिनृपतिभरिनैन ५०
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s> remained frozen, gazing at the king with eyes brimming full. [50]

children.text: चौपाई । शकुन्तला को बोलि न आयो । अनसूया
children.translated_text: <s>Caupāī</s>: <s>Śakuntalā</s> could not speak. <s>Anasūyā</s>

children.text: यह नृपहि सुनायो ॥ क्यों न होय अब कुशल हमारी ।
children.translated_text: then said this to the king: 'Why would we not be well now?

children.text: तुमसे साधु करत रखवारी ॥ प्यादे श्रम करि तुम यहँ
children.translated_text: Virtuous ones like you are keeping guard.' You have come here

children.text: आये । श्रम जल कत आनन में छाये ॥ शीतल छांह
children.translated_text: exerting yourself as a soldier — why is sweat covering your face?

children.text: सघन तरु डारैं । बैठो इत हम पायँ पखारैं ॥ लखे भा-
children.translated_text: The thick tree branches give cool shade; sit here and let us wash your feet.

children.text: ग्य ते चरण तिहारे । आजु दिवस तुम अतिथि हमारे ॥
children.translated_text: By good fortune we have beheld your feet; today you are our guest.

children.text: शकुन्तला क्यों भई अयानी । ल्याउ पियन को शीतल
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>, why have you become so foolish? Bring cool water

children.text: पानी ॥ तब नृप बैन मैन रस साने । देखत ही हम
children.translated_text: for drinking!' Then the king spoke words mixed with the nectar of love: 'Just seeing you,

children.text: तुम्हें अघाने ॥ मधुर मधुर कहती तुम बानी । यही
children.translated_text: I am satiated. You speak such sweet, sweet words —

children.text: हमारी है मिजमानी ॥ तुमहूं थकी सलिल के सींचे ।
children.translated_text: this itself is our hospitality.' 'You too are weary from watering;

children.text: बैठो घरिकद्रुमनिके नीचे ॥ तब बोली अनसूया बांकी ।
children.translated_text: sit for a while under the trees.' Then the spirited <s>Anasūyā</s> spoke,

children.text: बिहँसति शकुन्तला को ताकी ॥ अद्भुत आज अतिथि
children.translated_text: smiling and looking at <s>Śakuntalā</s>: 'What a wonderful guest

children.text: जो आये । सिगरे कहत बचन मन भाये ॥ इन कर डर
children.translated_text: has come today! Everyone speaks words that please the heart.

children.text: न कछू मन आनो । इन को कहो उचित के मानो ॥
children.translated_text: Have no fear of them in your mind; consider what is proper for them.'

children.text: यह सुनि शकुन्तला छाया में । बैठी मोहि नृपति माया
children.translated_text: Hearing this, <s>Śakuntalā</s> sat in the shade,

children.text: में ॥ शकुन्तला के हिय में पैठ्यो । क्षितिपालौ छाया
children.translated_text: captivated by the king's charm. The king entered <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s heart,
and the king sat down in the shade. [51]

children.text: घनाक्षरी छन्द । भागन तें बन में दुहुन भट भेरो
children.translated_text: <s>Ghanākṣarī</s> metre: By fortune in the forest both met each other —

children.text: भयो खोलो भगवान आज दुहुन को भालु है । दोऊ
children.translated_text: God has today revealed the destiny of both. Both

children.text: दुहूं देखत अघात न द्युननई लगन को दुहुनके शाल्यौ
children.translated_text: gaze at each other insatiably, and the pangs of love afflict

children.text: उर शाल है ॥ मन में दुहुन के मनोज बान लागे संग
children.translated_text: the hearts of both. In both their minds the arrows of <s>Manoja</s> (the god of love) have struck;

children.text: एकै रंग एक दुहुन को भयो एक हाल है । हिये में
children.translated_text: one color, one condition has come upon both alike. The king

children.text: महीप के शकुन्तला समानी सो शकुन्तला के हिये में
children.translated_text: has entered <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s heart, and <s>Śakuntalā</s>

children.text: समानो महिपाल है ५२ ॥
children.translated_text: has entered the heart of the king. [52]

children.text: चौपाई । दोऊ सखी दुहून निहारे । कोटि काम रति
children.translated_text: <s>Caupāī</s>: Both friends observed the two of them, and sacrificed the beauty of a million <s>Kāmadevas</s> (gods of love) and <s>Ratis</s>.

children.text: की छबि वारे ॥ शकुन्तला करि नैन लजोहें । निरखति
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>, with bashful eyes, gazed at the king

children.text: नृपकों तकि तिरछोहें ॥ नृप मुखते यह वचन निकारो ।
children.translated_text: with sidelong glances. The king then uttered these words:

children.text: भलो बनो संयोग तिहारो ॥ एकै रूप बैस एकै हो । देहैं
children.translated_text: 'How well your companionship suits you! You are of one form and one age;

children.text: तीनि प्रान एकै हो ॥ या सुनि नृप की कछू न बोली ।
children.translated_text: three bodies share a single life-breath.' Hearing this, the king said nothing further,

children.text: अनसूया फिरि नृप सों बोली ॥ धनि यह देश जहां तुम
children.translated_text: and <s>Anasūyā</s> again spoke to the king: 'Blessed is this land where you have come;

children.text: आये । विघ्न होत ऋषि यज्ञ बचाये ॥ देव गन्धरव के
children.translated_text: you have protected the sages' <s>yajña</s> (sacrifice) from obstacles.

children.text: मन्मथ हो । चले पियादे क्यों यह पथ हो ॥ करहु कृपा
children.translated_text: Are you some <s>deva</s> (god) or <s>gandharva</s> (celestial being) or <s>Manmatha</s> (god of love) himself? Why have you, a soldier, come by this path?

children.text: संदेह मिटाओ । नाम आपनो हमें बताओ ॥ तब नृप
children.translated_text: Please be gracious, dispel our doubt, and tell us your name.'

children.text: आपु न भेद छिपायो । कहो हमैं दुष्यन्त पठायो ॥ यह
children.translated_text: Then the king did not hide his identity: 'Say that <s>Duṣyanta</s> has sent me.',

children.text: खिदमत करि देइ हमारी । ऋषि लोगन की बन रख
children.translated_text: 'This is my assigned duty:' he said, 'guarding the forest

children.text: वारी ॥ फिरत तपोबन में निशिबासर । नृप दुष्यन्त कर
children.translated_text: for the sage-folk. I roam the <s>tapovana</s> (penance-grove) day and night;

children.text: हों मैं चाकर ॥ कहिये बचन महीप चुपाने । अनसुय्या
children.translated_text: I am a servant of King <s>Duṣyanta</s>.' Having spoken these words, the king fell silent. <s>Anasūyā</s>

children.text: पुनि उत्तर ठाने ॥ अब ऋषि सर्वसनाथ कहाये । तुम
children.translated_text: then replied: 'Now the sages may call themselves protected,

children.text: से साधु तपोबन आये ॥ भलो आनि तुम दरशन
children.translated_text: since virtuous ones like you have come to the <s>tapovana</s>.',

children.text: दीन्हों । हम लोगन किरतारथ कीन्हों ॥ बतरस में अति
children.translated_text: 'It was good of you to come and grant us your sight; you have made us all grateful.

children.text: ही सुख पायो । फिरि महीप यह बचन सुनायो ॥ शकु-
children.translated_text: We have found great joy in conversation.' Then the king said these words again:

children.text: न्तला यह सखी तिहारी । बिधि अतिही सुकुमारि स-
children.translated_text: 'Is <s>Śakuntalā</s> your friend? The Creator has fashioned her

children.text: म्हारी ॥ मुनिवर याहि ब्याहि कहु दै हैं । कै अब यासों
children.translated_text: exceedingly delicate. Will the great sage give her away in marriage to someone,

children.text: तप करवै हैं ॥ वाको अंगन है तप लायक । कहा
children.translated_text: or will he have her perform austerities? Her body is

children.text: विचार करो मुनि नायक ॥ तब अनसूया उत्तर दी-
children.translated_text: fit for penance — what is the sage-chief's intention?' Then <s>Anasūyā</s>

children.text: न्हो । कणव महामुनि यह प्रण कीन्हो ॥ शकुन्तला
children.translated_text: replied: 'The great sage <s>Kaṇva</s> has made this vow:

children.text: सम सुन्दर ह्वै है । करिहौं शकुन्तला जो कहि है ॥
children.translated_text: "<s>Śakuntalā</s> is equally beautiful" — and he has declared regarding <s>Śakuntalā</s>,

children.text: ऐसो बरु काहू लखि पैहौं । तबहीं याहि ब्याहि तहँ
children.translated_text: "When I find a bridegroom worthy of her, only then will I give her

children.text: दैहौं ॥ अनसूया यह कही कहानी । शकुन्तला
children.translated_text: in marriage."' <s>Anasūyā</s> told this story, and <s>Śakuntalā</s>

children.text: सुनि कै शरमानी ॥ यह सुनि कै बोल्यो अवनीपति ।
children.translated_text: was embarrassed upon hearing it. Hearing this, the king spoke,

children.text: शकुन्तला की लखि तन दीपति ॥ पहिले बात बिचारि
children.translated_text: beholding the radiance of <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s body: 'He did not first consider carefully

children.text: न लीन्ही । मुनि यह कठिन प्रतिज्ञा कीन्ही ॥ शकुन्त-
children.translated_text: before the sage made this difficult vow.',

children.text: ला जैसी है सुन्दर । कहो कहां मिलि है वैसोबर ॥ दूँ-
children.translated_text: 'As beautiful as <s>Śakuntalā</s> is, tell me, where will such a bridegroom be found?'

children.text: ढ़ि जगत मुनिवर फिरि अइ है । शकुन्तला अनब्याही
children.translated_text: 'Let the sage search the entire world and come back — <s>Śakuntalā</s> will remain

children.text: रहि है ॥ तब अनसूया फिरि हँसि बोली । खानि चतु-
children.translated_text: unmarried.' Then <s>Anasūyā</s> laughed again and spoke, as if opening a mine of cleverness:

children.text: रता की मनु खोली ॥ जब बिरंचि नीके दिन ल्यावत ।
children.translated_text: 'When the Creator brings auspicious days,

children.text: मन बांछित बैठे घर आवत । तुम से साधु कृपा उर
children.translated_text: what the heart desires comes home of its own accord. Virtuous ones like you have taken compassion to heart

children.text: धरि हैं । सुफल प्रतिज्ञा मुनि की करि हैं ॥ नृप जब
children.translated_text: and will fulfill the sage's vow.' When the king heard these words,

children.text: पाई सुनि यह बानी । शकुन्तला अतिही शरमानी ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s> was exceedingly embarrassed.

children.text: प्रियम्बदा बिहँसति आनन में । शकुन्तला के लगि
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>, laughing, leaned close to

children.text: कानन में ॥ कहो आज जाती तुम ब्याहीं । करिये कहा
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s ear: 'Are you going to your wedding today?

children.text: कण्व घर नाहीं ॥ शकुन्तला भरि नैन लजाही । लख-
children.translated_text: What shall we do — <s>Kaṇva</s> is not at home!'

children.text: ति तिरीछे फिरि २ जाही ॥ राजा शकुन्तला पर अट-
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>, with eyes full of shame, looked sideways again and again.

children.text: क्यौ । राजहि ढूंढत सब दल भटक्यौ ॥ आई फ़ौज
children.translated_text: The king was transfixed upon <s>Śakuntalā</s>, and his entire retinue wandered about searching for the king.

children.text: निकट बज मारी । बन में शोर भयो अति भारी ॥
children.translated_text: The army arrived nearby beating drums, and a great commotion arose in the forest.

children.text: सवैया । घोरनि की खुर थारनि की रज सों सिगरो
children.translated_text: <s>Savaiyā</s> metre: The dust from the horses' hooves and the shields

children.text: नभ मंडल छायो । जंगली जीवनि घेरिवे को चहूं ओर
children.translated_text: covered the entire sky. To encircle the wild creatures, from all four sides

children.text: करोलनि को मनु धायो ॥ खेलत फ़ौज समेत शिकार
children.translated_text: it was as if a net had spread forth. Playing the hunt along with the army,

children.text: नजीक दुष्यन्त महीपति आयो । रे मृग आपने आपने
children.translated_text: King <s>Duṣyanta</s> came near. 'Ho! Tie up your deer,

children.text: बांधहुयों ऋषिलोगन शोर मचायो ॥
children.translated_text: each to his own!' — thus the sage-folk raised a clamor.

children.text: चौपाई । सुनि यह शोर सबै अकुलानी । धक धक
children.translated_text: <s>Caupāī</s>: Hearing this noise, all were agitated; with pounding hearts

children.text: धरनि मुखनि कुम्हिलानी ॥ करन न पाए नृप यह लीला ।
children.translated_text: their faces withered. The king had not intended this sport;

children.text: मन २ करत फ़ौजको गीला ॥ अनसूया भैरससों सानी ।
children.translated_text: in his mind he reproached the army. <s>Anasūyā</s>, her voice tinged with fear,

children.text: यों कहि उठी नृपतिसों बानी ॥ कंपन लागी डरसों छाती ।
children.translated_text: rose and spoke thus to the king: 'Our hearts tremble with fright;

children.text: अब हम सब आश्रमको जाती ॥ श्रमकरि तुम आये आ-
children.translated_text: now we are all going back to the <s>āśrama</s> (hermitage).',

children.text: श्रमको । उचित तिहारी सेवा हमको ॥ सेवा हम कीन्हे बि
children.translated_text: 'You have come to the hermitage with great effort; it is proper for us to serve you.

children.text: नु जातीं । यह बिनती हम करत लजातीं ॥ दोष हमारो
children.translated_text: We are leaving without having served you; we make this entreaty with embarrassment.

children.text: मन नहिं कीजै । एक बार फिरि दरशन दीजै ॥ शकुन्त-
children.translated_text: Do not hold this fault against us in your mind; please come and grant us your sight once more.'

children.text: ला को कर सों गहि कै । चलीं सखी यह नृप सों कहि
children.translated_text: Taking <s>Śakuntalā</s> by the hand, the friends departed, having said this to the king.

children.text: कै ॥ फैली तनमन ब्याकुलताई । राजा चल्यो फ़ौज
children.translated_text: Restlessness spread through his body and mind, as the king departed and the army arrived.

children.text: यह आई ॥
दोहा । तनु आगे मनु जातु है शकुन्तला तनु जातु ।
children.translated_text: <s>Dohā</s>: His body goes forward but his mind goes toward <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s body;

children.text: सन्मुख पौन निशान पट पीछे ज्यों फहरातु ॥
children.translated_text: like a banner that flutters behind while facing the wind.

children.text: याबिधि अतिही दुचितह्वै उतैचल्यो महिपाल ।
children.translated_text: In this manner, deeply troubled, the king departed that way,

children.text: शकुन्तलाको इत चलतभयो निपट बेहाल ॥
children.translated_text: while <s>Śakuntalā</s>, departing this way, was utterly distraught.

children.text: घनाक्षरी छन्द । उरझोई द्रुमन दुकूल सुरझावे लो
children.translated_text: <s>Ghanākṣarī</s> metre: Her garment gets entangled in the trees and she tries to free it;

children.text: ग काढ़नि लागति कंटक बहु पगनि सों । कबहूं निवा
children.translated_text: she begins pulling many thorns from her feet.

children.text: ज खुले केशन कसन में कबहूं अंगिरान लागति अं-
children.translated_text: Sometimes her loosened hair catches in the undergrowth, sometimes her garment clings to her

children.text: गनि सों ॥ ऐसे छल छिद्र कै कै ठाढ़ी ह्वैरहति शकुन्त-
children.translated_text: limbs. Making such pretexts and excuses, <s>Śakuntalā</s> stands still, utterly

children.text: ला निपट भई ब्याकुल लगनिसों । सखियन की नज़रि
children.translated_text: agitated with love. Evading the gaze of her friends,

children.text: निवारि नारि फेरि फेरि महिपालहि देखे द्रगन सों । ५८ ॥
children.translated_text: the woman turns again and again to look at the king with her eyes. [58]

children.text: इतिश्रीसुधातरंगिणयां शकुन्तला नाटके प्रथमोङ्कः १ ॥
children.translated_text: Thus ends the first act of the <s>Śakuntalā</s> drama in the <s>Sudhā-Taraṅgiṇī</s>. [1]

children.text: अथ द्वितीयोङ्कः ॥
children.translated_text: Now begins the second act.

children.text: चौपाई । या विधि नृपसों लगनि लगाई । शकुं-
children.translated_text: <s>Caupāī</s>: Having thus set her heart on the king, <s>Śakuntalā</s>

children.text: तला आश्रम में आई ॥ प्रन प्रन पति शृंगार सिधारे ।
children.translated_text: returned to the hermitage. The lord of her life, <s>Śṛṅgāra</s> (love), departed,

children.text: सूने से सब अंग निहारे ॥ दिनभर भूख प्यास नहिं
children.translated_text: and all her limbs appeared desolate. All day long, neither hunger nor thirst

children.text: लागे । परति न नींद राति भरि जागे ॥ सकुचि सखिन
children.translated_text: afflicted her; sleep did not come, and she lay awake the whole night. Hesitant, she did not speak

children.text: हूं सों नहिं भाखे । हियकी पीर हियेमें राखे १ ॥
children.translated_text: even to her friends; she kept the pain of her heart within her heart. [1]

children.text: सोरठा । लगी कटारी तीर पीरलेत सहि शूरमा ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Soraṭhā</s>: A dagger's wound pierces — a warrior endures the pain.

children.text: नयेबिरहकी पीर काहू सों सहिजात नहिं २ ॥
children.translated_text: But the new pain of separation cannot be borne by anyone. [2]

children.text: कही न मानै कोय जैसी पीर बियोगकी ॥
children.translated_text: No one believes what the pain of separation is truly like;

children.text: जापै बीती होय सोई जानै समुझि कै ३ ॥
children.translated_text: only the one who has experienced it understands it fully. [3]

children.text: दृगबरसत ज्यों मेह बैठतजाय एकान्तघर ॥
children.translated_text: Tears rain from her eyes like a downpour; she sits alone in a secluded room.

children.text: पियरानी सब देह तहूंदुरावति सखिनसों ४ ॥
children.translated_text: Her entire body has turned pale, yet she hides it even from her friends. [4]

children.text: उरभरिरहयो सनेह लागी आगि बियोगकी ॥
children.translated_text: Her heart is brimming with love; the fire of separation has caught aflame.

children.text: मनो बुझावत देह अँशुवनकी झरलायकै ॥
children.translated_text: It is as if her body tries to extinguish it with a cascade of tears.

children.text: दोहा । वा दिनते यह ह्वैगयो शकुन्तला को हाल ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Dohā</s>: From that day onward, this became <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s condition —

children.text: जादिनतेउतनीनजरि देख्योनहिंमहिपाल ६४ ॥
children.translated_text: from the day she could no longer set eyes upon the king. [64]

children.text: चौपाई । महीपाल अति ब्याकुल रहैं। पी रहियेकी
children.translated_text: <s>Caupāī</s>: The king remained deeply restless. To whom could he tell the pain

children.text: कासों कहैं ॥ शकुन्तला सों मन अटकायो । राजकाज
children.translated_text: of his heart? His mind was attached to <s>Śakuntalā</s>; all affairs of the kingdom

children.text: अब सब बिसरायो ॥ नई लगन घर जान न दीन्हों ।
children.translated_text: he now forgot entirely. This new passion would not let him go home;

children.text: डेरा निकट तपोबन कीन्हों ॥ कल न परै निशि दिन
children.translated_text: he made his camp near the <s>tapovana</s> (penance-grove). Neither night nor day did the king find peace;

children.text: महिपालै । शकुन्तला सुधि हियमें शालै ॥ मुनिलोगन
children.translated_text: the thought of <s>Śakuntalā</s> burned in his heart. There was the fear of the sages

children.text: को डर मन तिनको । नेक न मिटत मरोरा मन को ॥
children.translated_text: in his mind, yet the anguish of his heart would not cease even a little.

children.text: बिरह अग्नि सों तावत तनको । नृप यों गिल्ला करत
children.translated_text: With his body burning in the fire of separation, the king thus complained

children.text: मदन को ॥ रे रे मदन महा अपराधी । निपट अनीति
children.translated_text: to <s>Madana</s> (the god of love): 'O <s>Madana</s>, great offender!

children.text: आनिते बांधी ॥ मनते उपजि मनोज कहावत । तिहिमन
children.translated_text: You have bound me with utter injustice. Born from the mind, you are called <s>Manoja</s> (mind-born),

children.text: को तू कहा जरावत ॥
children.translated_text: yet why do you burn that very mind?'

children.text: सोरठा । शंभु नयनकी आगि बड़वानलज्यों समुद्र में ।
children.translated_text: <s>Soraṭhā</s>: 'The fire of <s>Śambhu</s>'s (Śiva's) eye, like the submarine fire in the ocean —

children.text: रही सो तो में लागि तू हमको तासों दहत ॥
children.translated_text: that same fire burns in me; you burn me with it.'

children.text: दोहा । निन्दा करि यों मदन की देखिजुन्हैयाराति ।
children.translated_text: <s>Dohā</s>: Having thus reproached <s>Madana</s> (the god of love), seeing the moonlit night,

children.text: निंदा अब शशिकी करनलाग्योनृप यहिभांति ॥
children.translated_text: the king began to reproach the moon in this manner:

children.text: सोरठा । बिरहिन देत जराय हत्याको शशि डरत नहिं ।
children.translated_text: <s>Soraṭhā</s>: 'You burn those who suffer separation — you, O Moon, do not fear the sin of murder.',

children.text: तुम से पूतहि जाय सागर को सुख देत नहिं ॥
children.translated_text: 'You do not give happiness even to your own pure son, the ocean.'

children.text: हिये बढ़ावत दाहु सो वह दोष तुम्हैं नहीं ॥
children.translated_text: 'You increase the burning in the heart — but that fault is not yours.',

children.text: करतपापयहराहुतुम्हैं जोछोड़तनिगलिके ११ ॥
children.translated_text: 'It is <s>Rāhu</s> who commits this sin — he swallows you and then releases you.' [11]

children.text: तुम्हें सुधानिधि नाउँ लोग कहत जे बावरे ।
children.translated_text: 'You are called the treasure of nectar — those people who say so are fools.',

children.text: बारि दते सवठाउँ आगि जलन के छलनसों ॥
children.translated_text: 'You sprinkle water everywhere, but it is a deceit to extinguish the fire of burning.'

children.text: दोहा । शकुन्तलाके बिरह सों ब्याकुल अतिमहिपाल ।
children.translated_text: <s>Dohā</s>: In separation from <s>Śakuntalā</s>, the king was exceedingly distraught.

children.text: एक दिवस कछु कहन को आये ह्वै मुनिबाल ॥
children.translated_text: One day, some young sages came to speak with him.

children.text: चौपाई । ह्वै मुनि सिद्ध द्वार पर आये । सुनतहि
children.translated_text: <s>Caupāī</s>: Having attained <s>siddhi</s> (accomplishment), the sages came to his door; hearing this,

children.text: राजा तुरत बुलाये ॥ आशिर्बाद दुहुन तब दीन्हों ।
children.translated_text: the king summoned them at once. Both gave blessings,

children.text: करि प्रणाम नृप आदर कीन्हों ॥ तब ऋषि बोलि
children.translated_text: and the king received them with respect and obeisance. Then the two sages

children.text: उठे हैं दोनों । बिना कण्व यह बन है सूनों ॥ महाराज
children.translated_text: spoke up: 'Without <s>Kaṇva</s>, this forest is desolate.',

children.text: है यज्ञ हमारे । सो ह्वै सकतु न बिन रखवारे ॥ राक्षस
children.translated_text: 'O great king, there is our <s>yajña</s> (sacrifice), and it cannot proceed without a protector.',

children.text: बिघ्न करन को आवत । सब ऋषिलोगन आनि स-
children.translated_text: '<s>Rākṣasas</s> (demons) come to create obstacles and torment

children.text: तावत ॥ कछुक दिनन तुम चलौ तपोवन । बिनती
children.translated_text: all the sage-folk. For some days, please come to the <s>tapovana</s> (penance-grove)' —

children.text: करी सकल ऋषि लोगन ॥ बन को चहत हतो नृप
children.translated_text: all the sages made this entreaty. The king had already wanted to come to the forest;

children.text: आयो । सुनि पुनि वचन बहुत सुख पायो ॥ बिनती
children.translated_text: hearing these words, he found great joy.

children.text: करियों ऋषिन बुलायो । राजा हरषि तपोबन आयो ॥
children.translated_text: The sages entreated and summoned him, and the king joyfully came to the <s>tapovana</s>.

children.text: आपु अकेलो नृप धनुधारी । करत ऋषिन की बन
children.translated_text: Alone, the king with his bow stood guard over the forest

children.text: रखवारी ॥ पैठ्यो-बिरह नृपति के मन में । ढूंढ़त शकु-
children.translated_text: for the sages. Separation had entered the king's heart; he searched for <s>Śakuntalā</s> —

children.text: न्तला को बन में ॥ ग्रीषम तरुन तेज तपि आयो ।
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s> in the forest. The fierce heat of summer arrived.

children.text: तब नृप मन में यह ठहरायो ॥ शकुन्तला यह धूप
children.translated_text: Then the king resolved this in his mind: '<s>Śakuntalā</s>, in this terrible heat,

children.text: बिकट में । बैठी नदी मालिनी तट में ॥ बिन देखे
children.translated_text: sits on the bank of the river <s>Mālinī</s>.' Without seeing her,

children.text: नृप धरत न धीरहि । आयो नदी मालिनी तीरहि ॥
children.translated_text: the king could not maintain his composure. He came to the bank of the river <s>Mālinī</s>.

children.text: फूले कमल भ्रमर जहँ बोलत । शीतल पवन मन्द जहँ
children.translated_text: Lotuses bloomed, bees hummed, cool and gentle breezes

children.text: डोलत ॥ हरषि मोर पिक करत पुकारें । अति झुकिरहीं
children.translated_text: swayed. Joyful peacocks and cuckoos called out. The heavy branches

children.text: सघन तरु डारें ॥ शीतल सघन छांह जहँ पाई । कमल
children.translated_text: of dense trees drooped low. Where cool, dense shade was found, a bed

children.text: दलन की सेज बिछाई ॥ शकुन्तला तो पौढ़ी तामें ।
children.translated_text: of lotus petals was spread. <s>Śakuntalā</s> lay down upon it,

children.text: अतिही ब्याकुल बिरह बिथामें ॥ घिसि २के नितचंदन
children.translated_text: deeply anguished by the pain of separation. Sandalwood was ground and brought repeatedly;

children.text: ल्यावे । दासि कमल दल पौन डुलावै ॥
children.translated_text: the maidservant fanned [her] with lotus petals.

children.text: दी० । जारत बिरह महीप की ताहि कहत सरमाति ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: Burning with the separation from the king, she was ashamed to speak of it.

children.text: करत बहानो सखिनसों शकुन्तला इहिभांति ॥
children.translated_text: Making excuses to her friends, <s>Śakuntalā</s> [spoke] in this manner:

children.text: चौपाई । ग्रीषम तरनि तेजतपि आयो । त्रियहिसो
children.translated_text: Caupāī: 'The fierce heat of the summer sun has arrived. For women

children.text: बन में दाह बढ़ायो ॥ उरमें दाह कहाँ लों सहिहों । तन
children.translated_text: it has increased the burning in the forest. How long shall I endure this burning in my breast? My body

children.text: कलपैहों जबमरिजैहों । शकुन्तला निदरति इमिप्राननि ।
children.translated_text: will waste away and then I shall die.' As <s>Śakuntalā</s> moaned thus,

children.text: झनकपरी राजाके काननि ॥
children.translated_text: the sound fell upon the king's ears.

children.text: दोहा । पहुंचो नृपति तहीं जिते सुने दीन ये बैन ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: The king arrived at that very place where he heard these piteous words.

children.text: बिरहिनि महा शकुन्तला देखि तबै भरि नैन ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing <s>Śakuntalā</s>, the great woman of separation, his eyes filled with tears.

children.text: मनमलीन तनछीन अति पियरानो सब अंग ।
children.translated_text: Her mind was dejected, her body emaciated, all her limbs grown pallid;

children.text: दुखित भयो नृप देखि के शकुन्तलाको रंग ॥
children.translated_text: the king became sorrowful upon seeing <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s complexion.

children.text: चौपाई । तब नृपके मनमें यह आई । अभे न दीजे
children.translated_text: Caupāī: Then this thought came to the king's mind: 'I should not yet

children.text: इन्हें दिखाई ॥ रहे दुराइ द्रुमान दे गातन । सुनेश्रवण
children.translated_text: reveal myself to her.' He remained hidden, concealing his body behind the trees, and listened

children.text: दै इनकी बातन ॥
children.translated_text: with attentive ears to their conversation.

children.text: दोहा । यों कहि बनमें दुरिरहे नृपति द्रुमन की ओट ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: Having said this, the king hid in the forest behind the shelter of trees.

children.text: शकुन्तला सखियान सों कहत बिरहकी चोट ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s> told her friends of the pangs of separation.

children.text: चौपाई । जादिन तें वह बन रखवारो । दरशन देकें
children.translated_text: Caupāī: 'Ever since that guardian of the forest

children.text: फिरन सिधारो ॥ ता दिन तें बिसरी सुख हांसी । हेत
children.translated_text: gave his darśana and departed, from that day all joyful laughter has been forgotten. Attachment

children.text: गहे दिन राति उदासी ॥ जरीजाति बिरहनके जारे ।
children.translated_text: has seized me; day and night I am desolate. I am being consumed by the fire of separation,

children.text: कहत नहीं लाजनके मारे ॥
children.translated_text: but cannot speak of it, overcome by shame.'

children.text: दोहा । अनुसूया के बचन सुनि प्रियम्बदा करिखेद ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: Hearing <s>Anasūyā</s>'s words, <s>Priyamvadā</s>, distressed,

children.text: परगट ह्वै फूछन लगी शकुंताला सों भेद ॥
children.translated_text: came forward and began to ask <s>Śakuntalā</s> the secret.

children.text: चौपाई । सुन सखि है अब और न खोई । कै तें कै
children.translated_text: Caupāī: 'Listen, friend, there is no one else left now. From now on

children.text: अब सखिहम दोई ॥ तैं हम ते अब कहा दुरावति ।
children.translated_text: there are only we two friends. What are you hiding from us now?

children.text: पीर हिये की क्यों न बतावति ॥ दिन दिन देह जाति
children.translated_text: Why do you not tell the pain of your heart? Day by day your body grows

children.text: दुबरानी । पियरानी सब अंग निशानी ॥ छिन छिन
children.translated_text: more emaciated; the pallor of all your limbs is a sign. Moment by moment

children.text: फैलति अंग छिनाई । घटत अकेली नहीं लुनाई ॥ दिन
children.translated_text: the wasting spreads through your limbs; it is not beauty alone that diminishes. Day

children.text: दुसहायहदशा तुम्हारी । निशि दिनछतिया फटैहमारी ॥
children.translated_text: by day, helpless, is your condition; night and day our hearts break.

children.text: दाह निहारे तनमें जेतो । तरनि तेज ताते नहिं तेतो ॥
children.translated_text: The burning we see in your body is not even matched by the sun's heat.

children.text: छोड़ो लाजकही यहमानो । हम सों करनो कहाबहानो ॥
children.translated_text: Set aside shame; accept what I say. Why make excuses to us?

children.text: जियको रोग जानि जो लीजे । तो फिरि तैसो जतन
children.translated_text: If you identify the ailment of the heart,

children.text: करीजे ॥ यह सुनि दुभकीली अँखियन सों । बोली श-
children.translated_text: then the proper remedy can be applied.' Hearing this, with tearful eyes,

children.text: कुंतला सखियन सों ॥ तुम हो सखि प्राणहुते प्यारी ।
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s> spoke to her friends: 'You are, friends, dearer than life itself.

children.text: दुख अरुसुखमें हौ नहिं न्यारी । विथा बड़ी यह कब
children.translated_text: In sorrow and in joy you are not separate from me. This great pain—how long

children.text: लगि सहिहों । तुम सों छोड़ि कौन सोंकहिहों ॥ यातें मैं
children.translated_text: shall I endure it? Leaving you aside, to whom shall I tell it? That is why

children.text: नकहत हों अजहूं । सुनि तब दुख ह्वैजैहै तुमहूं ॥ जब
children.translated_text: I still do not speak; [for] if you hear it, you too will be pained. Since

children.text: ते वह बन को रखवारी । तबहीं ते यह दशाहमारी ॥
children.translated_text: the day that guardian of the forest [appeared], from that very day this has been my condition.

children.text: छिन भरि पीर टरत नहीं टारी । कै अब वाहि दिखाव
children.translated_text: Not for a moment does the pain cease or relent. Either show me that beloved one now,

children.text: हु प्यारी ॥ करो उपाय बेगहीं एरी । कैदैचुकौ तिलांज-
children.translated_text: O dear friend, or quickly find some remedy, or else offer

children.text: लि मेरी ॥ इतनो कहत गरोभरि आयो । लगी लाज
children.translated_text: the funeral water-oblation for me.' Saying this much, her throat choked up;

children.text: नीचो शिर नायो ॥ यह दुख जिय को सखिन सुनायो ।
children.translated_text: overcome by shame, she bowed her head low. She told her friends the sorrow of her heart;

children.text: नृपश्रवणनिमें सुधा पियायो ॥ शकुन्तलायों बोलि चुपा
children.translated_text: [it was as though] she fed nectar to the king's ears. Having spoken thus, <s>Śakuntalā</s> fell

children.text: नी । कही सखिन फिरि मीठी बानी ॥ अबहीं ह्वै है सब
children.translated_text: silent; then her friends spoke sweet words again: 'Right now everything will become

children.text: मन भायो । भले ठौर ते मन अटकायो ॥ आयो इत है
children.translated_text: as your heart desires. You have fixed your heart on a worthy object. The one who came here

children.text: बन रखवारो । राजा है वह प्राणनि प्यारो ॥ रक्षा को स
children.translated_text: as the guardian of the forest—that king is beloved of your very life. He summoned all

children.text: ब ऋषिन बुलायो । फेरि तपोबन ही में आयो । देखो
children.translated_text: the sages for protection and then returned to this very hermitage-forest. See,

children.text: हम अति हौ दुबरानो । अंग २ को रँगपियरानो ॥ क-
children.translated_text: he too has grown quite thin; the color of each limb has turned pallid.

children.text: हत न कछू रहत मन मारे । भयो बिकल कछु बिरह
children.translated_text: He says nothing, keeping his heart suppressed; he too has become distressed from separation

children.text: तिहारे ॥ लिखो एक लिखि पठवो वाकों । परगट करि
children.translated_text: from you. Write a letter and send it to him,

children.text: निज बिरह बिथाकों ॥ दशा तिहारी जो सुनि पैहै ।
children.translated_text: revealing to him the pain of your separation. When he hears of your condition,

children.text: तुरत तिहारे ढिग चलि अैहै ॥
children.translated_text: he will come to your side at once.'

children.text: दोहा । कीजे यही उपाय अब सखिन कही समुझाय ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: 'Let us do just this remedy now'—so the friends advised.

children.text: बोली बहुरि सखीन सों शकुन्तला सरमाय ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s> spoke again to her friends, bashfully.

children.text: चौ० । यह उपाव तो है अति नीको । याकों यह डर
children.translated_text: Caupāī: 'This plan is indeed very good, but this fear

children.text: मिटत न जीको ॥ परगट ह्वै हो छोड़ति लाजनि । लेखी
children.translated_text: does not leave my heart. Having cast aside modesty openly,

children.text: लिखि २ पठवत राजनि ॥ निराखि नृपति जो निरादरु
children.translated_text: [I would be] writing and sending letters to the king. If the king, upon seeing it, should treat [me] with

children.text: ठाने ॥ हम को तजे बने फिरि प्राने । शकुन्तला यह डर
children.translated_text: contempt, [and] abandon me—then my life is over.' <s>Śakuntalā</s> expressed this fear

children.text: मन कीन्हो । अनसूया फिरि उत्तर दीन्हो ॥ शकुन्तला तैं
children.translated_text: in her mind; <s>Anasūyā</s> then gave her reply: '<s>Śakuntalā</s>,

children.text: क्यों बौरानी । अनमिल कहति कहा ते बानी ॥ देखि
children.translated_text: why have you gone mad? You speak such unfitting words!

children.text: आपने घर धन आवत । कोऊ कहूं किवार दिवावत ॥
children.translated_text: When one sees wealth coming to one's own home,

children.text: शीतल किरन चंद की लागे । कौन ओट दै राखत
children.translated_text: does anyone ever close the door? When the cool rays of the moon fall upon you,

children.text: आगे ॥ इती कौन में मूरखता है । तैं जिहि चाहे सो
children.translated_text: who holds up a screen before them? Where is the foolishness in this?

children.text: तुहि चाहे ॥ लगनि तिहारी जो नृपजाने । धन्य भाग्य
children.translated_text: The one you love also loves you. If the king knew

children.text: अपनो किर माने ॥ कागद कलम दवाइत नाहीं । सुनो
children.translated_text: of your attachment, he would surely consider his fortune blessed. There is no need for paper, pen, or ink;

children.text: श्रवण करि मेरी याहीं ॥ भली २ करि मनमें बातन ।
children.translated_text: just listen to my suggestion with your ears. Think well, ponder the words in your mind,

children.text: नख सों लिखी कमल के पातन ॥
children.translated_text: and inscribe [them] with your nail upon a lotus petal.'

children.text: दोहा । सुनिये बैन शुकुन्तला सुधि जिय में ठहराय ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: 'Listen to the words, <s>Śakuntalā</s>; fix [them] firmly in your mind.'

children.text: पाती पंकज पात की नख सोंलिखीबनाय ॥
children.translated_text: A letter on a lotus leaf, composed by inscribing with the nail.

children.text: पाती लिखिफिरिसिखनसोंशकुन्तला मुखचाहिं ।
children.translated_text: Having written the letter, <s>Śakuntalā</s> turned to her friends and

children.text: कहन लगी कै सुनहु यहलिखतबनीकै नाहिं ॥
children.translated_text: began to say, 'Listen to what I have written, whether it has turned out well or not.'

children.text: चौपाई । सखी सुनन लागीं दे कानन । शकुन्तला
children.translated_text: Caupāī: The friends began to listen, lending their ears. <s>Śakuntalā</s>

children.text: खोल्यो तब आनन ॥
children.translated_text: then opened her mouth.

children.text: सोरठा । कीजै कौन उपाय दया तुम्हारे है नहीं ।
children.translated_text: Sorathā: 'What remedy can I devise? You have no compassion.

children.text: मन लै गये चुराय फेरि दिखाई देत नहिं ॥
children.translated_text: You have stolen my heart and carried it away, and do not appear again to show yourself.

children.text: कोमल सब अँग और रचे बरंचि बिचारिके ।
children.translated_text: All your limbs are soft, fashioned with deliberation by <s>Brahmā</s>;

children.text: हिरदे निपट, कठोर मन काहे ते ह्वै गयो ॥
children.translated_text: yet your heart is utterly hard—why has your mind become so?'

children.text: चौपाई । शकुन्तला यह सखिन सुनायो । राजा निक-
children.translated_text: Caupāī: When <s>Śakuntalā</s> recited this to her friends, the king emerged

children.text: सि द्रुमन ते आयो ॥ निकसि द्रुमन तें दरशन दीन्हो ।
children.translated_text: from among the trees and came forth. Emerging from the trees, he gave his darśana

children.text: शकुन्तला सों उत्तर कीन्हो ॥
children.translated_text: and replied to <s>Śakuntalā</s>.

children.text: सोरठा । निशिदिन रहत अचेंत घर जैबो भारूंभयो ।
children.translated_text: Sorathā: 'Day and night I remain restless; going home has become burdensome.

children.text: एक तिहारे हेत बनवासी हम हूं भये ॥
children.translated_text: For your sake alone, I too have become a forest-dweller.'

children.text: चौपाई । यह कहि नृपति निकट चलिआयो । देखि
children.translated_text: Caupāī: Saying this, the king came near. Seeing him,

children.text: सखिन अतिही सुख पायो ॥
children.translated_text: the friends felt the greatest joy.

children.text: दोहा । लागी उठन शकुंतला आदर कीरबे काज ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: <s>Śakuntalā</s> began to rise to pay her respects.

children.text: छीन अंग तब देखिके यों बोल्यो महराज ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing her emaciated body, the great king spoke thus:

children.text: चोपाई । अतिही दुर्बल देह तिहारी । माफ तुम्हे
children.translated_text: Caupāī: 'Your body has become extremely frail. Spare yourself

children.text: ताजीम हमारी ॥ देखि दुसहू यह दाह तिहारो । मन
children.translated_text: the formality of honoring me. Seeing this unbearable burning of yours, my

children.text: मलीन ह्वै गयो हमारो । पौढ़ीं रहो गेह हम नारी ।
children.translated_text: mind has become dejected. Lie down and stay here, O lady;

children.text: करें उताहिल जतन तुम्हारी ॥ हियो गयो भरि आ-
children.translated_text: we shall eagerly attend to your care.' Her heart was filled with utmost

children.text: नँद अतिसों । प्रियम्बदा बोली छिति पतिसों ॥ भले
children.translated_text: joy. <s>Priyamvadā</s> spoke to the lord of the earth: 'Well

children.text: आज तुम अवसर आये । तुम सिगरे दुख आनि
children.translated_text: have you come at the right moment today. You have come and dispelled all

children.text: मिटाये ॥ तुमसे वेद खबरि अब लेहैं । शकुंतला तनु
children.translated_text: sorrow. Now you must attend to her like a physician. The burning in <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s body

children.text: दाह न रहि हैं ॥ बैठो निकट गहो अब नारी । लखे
children.translated_text: shall not remain. Sit near her, take this lady's hand;

children.text: वेदई आज तिहारी ॥
children.translated_text: attend to her today as a healer.'

children.text: दोहा । यों कहि तब मुसक्याय नृप बैठो वाही ठोर ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: Having said this, the king sat down at that very spot with a smile.

children.text: रही लजाय शकुंलैला लखति सखिन की ओर ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s> remained bashful, glancing toward her friends.

children.text: चौपाई । प्रीति समान दुहुन की तोली । अनसूया
children.translated_text: Caupāī: The love of both was weighed and found equal. <s>Anasūyā</s>

children.text: तब नृपसों बोली ॥ एक बात ते नृप हम डरतीं । ताते
children.translated_text: then spoke to the king: 'There is one thing, O king, that we fear;

children.text: हम बिनती अब करतीं ॥ राजनि के होतीं बहुनारी ।
children.translated_text: therefore we now make this entreaty. Kings have many wives,

children.text: जरें सवतिया दाह कि जारी ॥ माई न बाप कुटुम्ब
children.translated_text: and the burning jealousy of co-wives consumes [one]. Neither mother

children.text: न भाई । शकुंतला बिधि दुखी बनाई ॥ तुमसों कछु
children.translated_text: nor father, neither clan nor brother—Fate has made <s>Śakuntalā</s> destitute of all.

children.text: जो निरादर ह्वैहै । शकुन्तला पुनि जियत न रहि
children.translated_text: If any disregard from you should befall her,

children.text: है ॥ अनसूया कीह बचन चुपानी । कही महीपति
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s> will no longer remain alive.' <s>Anasūyā</s> finished her words and fell silent.

children.text: फिर यह बानी ॥ तुमहूं अब लगि मोहिं न जानो । मैं
children.translated_text: The king then spoke these words: 'You still do not know me.

children.text: बनाय यह होत बिकानो ॥जे घर मेरे हैं बहुतेरी ।
children.translated_text: Hearing this, I am distraught. Those many [women] who are in

children.text: शकुन्तला की हैं सब चेरी ॥ शकुन्तला यह सखी ति-
children.translated_text: my household—they are all <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s handmaidens. <s>Śakuntalā</s>, this friend of

children.text: हारी । मोहिं लगति प्राणनि ते प्यारी ॥ जब ते वह
children.translated_text: yours, is dearer to me than my very life. Ever since I gazed at her

children.text: भरि दीठि निहारी । तब सुधि बुधि सबे बिसारी ॥
children.translated_text: with eyes full [of love], from that moment I have forgotten all sense and awareness.

children.text: मोहिं कछू अब घर जो सुहातो । मैं अबलों का घरै न
children.translated_text: Nothing at home pleases me now; otherwise, would I not have gone home by now?

children.text: जातो ॥ शकुन्तला जो मोहिं न बरिहै । अपनो मोहिं
children.translated_text: If <s>Śakuntalā</s> does not accept me, she will at least

children.text: दास तो करिहै ॥ शकुन्तला बिन घरै न जैहौं । शकु-
children.translated_text: make me her servant. Without <s>Śakuntalā</s>, I shall not go home;

children.text: न्तला को दास कहैहौं ॥ कही बातराजा अति नीकी ।
children.translated_text: I shall call myself <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s servant.' The king spoke most excellent words.

children.text: निसांभई सखियन के जीकी ॥
children.translated_text: The friends' hearts were reassured upon hearing them.

children.text: दोहा । विहँसी नृपकी ओर लखि, शकुंतला के गात ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: Smiling and looking toward the king, <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s limbs [showed delight].

children.text: अनसूया सों कहि उठी प्रियंबदा यह बात ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Anasūyā</s> rose and spoke this matter to <s>Priyamvadā</s>:

children.text: सोरठा । भूखे हैं मृगबाल ढूंढ़त हैं निज माय को ।
children.translated_text: Sorathā: 'The fawns are hungry and searching for their mother.

children.text: चलो सखी उठिहाल दीजे तिन्हेंमिलापअब ॥
children.translated_text: Come, friend, let us rise and bring about their reunion now.'

children.text: चौपाई । चलीं सखीं दोऊ छल करिके । शकुंतला
children.translated_text: Caupāī: The two friends departed by a ruse. <s>Śakuntalā</s>

children.text: बोली तब उठिके ॥ दइयहु को तुम नहीं डरातीं । मोहिं
children.translated_text: then spoke, rising up: 'You wretches, do you not fear propriety?

children.text: कहाँ छोड़े अब जातीं । घरिकु रहो पियपास अकेलीं ।
children.translated_text: Where are you going, leaving me here?' 'Remain a moment alone with your beloved'—

children.text: यों कहिके टरि गई सहेलीं ॥ शकुंतला तब उठी अक-
children.translated_text: saying so, the friends went away. <s>Śakuntalā</s> then rose

children.text: सिके । राजा गही बाँह तब हँसिके ॥ दिन दुपहर यह
children.translated_text: reluctantly; the king seized her arm with a laugh. 'At this hour of midday

children.text: तपतु अनैसो । चाह तुम्हारो तन में ऐसो ॥ ऐसोठौर
children.translated_text: the sun blazes so fiercely—just like the desire in your body.

children.text: कहाँ तुम पैहो । शीतल छांह छोड़ि कहँ जैहो ॥ हम
children.translated_text: Where will you find such a place [of shade]? Where will you go, leaving this cool shade?
