children.text: से सेवक निकट तिहारे । कहा सखिन के होत सिधारे ॥
children.translated_text: A servant like me is near you. What is the use of your friends' departure?

children.text: तुमकहँ मोकहँ सोंपसिधारी । वे दोऊ प्रिय सखींनिहारी ॥
children.translated_text: Those two dear friends have entrusted you to me and gone.

children.text: सखियनकी अब शोध न लीजे । जो कछु होय सो हम
children.translated_text: Do not seek the friends now; whatever is to happen, let me do it now.

children.text: अब कीजे ॥ कहो अगर चंदन घिसि ल्याऊं । कहो तो
children.translated_text: Say the word and I shall grind sandalwood and bring it; say the word and I shall fan you with cool breezes.'

children.text: शीतल पवन डुलाऊं ॥ यह कहिके नृप करी ढिठाई ।
children.translated_text: Saying this, the king grew bold;

children.text: कर गहि शकुंतला बैठाई ॥ धक धक छतिया लागी
children.translated_text: taking her hand, he seated <s>Śakuntalā</s>. Her heart began to

children.text: डोलें । शकुंतला लागी फिरि बोलें ॥ महाराज यह उ-
children.translated_text: throb. <s>Śakuntalā</s> then spoke again:

children.text: चित नहीं है । कहा हमारी बांह गही है ॥ बापहमारो
children.translated_text: 'Great king, this is not proper. Why have you seized my arm?

children.text: है घर नाहीं । अरु अबलों हमहैं अनब्याहीं ॥ और
children.translated_text: My father is not here at home, and I am, moreover, an unmarried maiden.

children.text: ब्याह अब नहिं अमिलाखो । हम तुमको मनमें करि
children.translated_text: And marriage cannot be arranged without [his consent]. Yet

children.text: राखो ॥ बाप हमारो जब घर ऐहै । तुमको हमें ब्याहि
children.translated_text: keep me in your heart. When my father returns home,

children.text: तब दैहै ॥ अबलों तुम हमसे नहिं ब्याहे । मोहिं कलंक
children.translated_text: he will give me to you in marriage then. Until then you have not married me—

children.text: लगावत काहे ॥ शकुन्तला यों देखि डरानी । बोल्यो
children.translated_text: why do you bring reproach upon me?' Seeing <s>Śakuntalā</s> thus frightened,

children.text: फेरि महीपति बानी ॥
children.translated_text: the king spoke these words again:

children.text: दोहा । कहु कितने नृपकीसुतन गन्ध्रब कीन्हें ब्याह ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: 'Tell me, how many kings' daughters have had <s>gāndharva</s> marriages?

children.text: गईं ब्याहि बरु पाइके तिनको होत सराह ॥
children.translated_text: They were wed and found their grooms, and they are praised.'

children.text: गही बांह अब आजुते तुम प्यारी हमनाह ।
children.translated_text: 'Having taken your hand today, you are my beloved and I your lord.

children.text: हमें तुम्हें यहठौर अब भयो गन्धर्ब बिवाह ॥
children.translated_text: Here and now, for the two of us, the <s>gāndharva vivāha</s> (marriage by mutual consent) has taken place.'

children.text: चौपाई । मुनि कोउ न कछू उरआने । वह मुनिवर
children.translated_text: Caupāī: 'Let no sage take any objection to heart. Those sages

children.text: हैं निपट सयाने ॥ तीरथ न्हाय जबै मुनि ऐहैं । यहसुनि
children.translated_text: are supremely wise. When they return from bathing at the holy places,

children.text: के बहुतै सुख पैहैं । जबलों बातकही नृप येती । करी
children.translated_text: hearing this, they will be greatly pleased.' By the time the king had said this much, <s>Kāma</s> (the god of love)

children.text: काम केती कमनैती ॥ शकुन्तला लाजहिं भरिआई ।
children.translated_text: had accomplished his artful work. <s>Śakuntalā</s> was filled with modesty;

children.text: गहिकर नृपबर गरे लगाई ॥ कस्सों नृप छतिया गहि
children.translated_text: the king took her hand and drew her to his neck [in embrace]. Pressing her to his chest,

children.text: मसकी । शकुन्तला लीन्ही तब ससकी ॥ चुम्बन कियो-
children.translated_text: the king smiled; he then took <s>Śakuntalā</s> trembling [into his arms]. The king kissed her,

children.text: नृपति मन मायो । शकुन्तला मुख झझकि छुड़ायो ॥
children.translated_text: delighting his heart; <s>Śakuntalā</s> freed her face with a start.

children.text: शीतल पवन मंद वहि आयो । सधन बायुमें सुरति
children.translated_text: A cool gentle breeze came there;

children.text: मचायो ॥ उरलाग्यो अधरन रस चहुंके । शकुन्तला
children.translated_text: in the dense grove they made love. Breast pressed to breast, both savoring the nectar of each other's lips,

children.text: कोयल सी कुहुंके ॥ भरि दुपहरियों सुरति मचाई । बातें
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s> cooed like a cuckoo. They made love through the full afternoon,

children.text: कहत सांझ ह्वै आई ॥ देखि गौतमीको उठिधाईं । दोऊ
children.translated_text: and as they spoke sweet words, evening arrived. Seeing <s>Gautamī</s> approaching, [<s>Śakuntalā</s>] rose and hastened.

children.text: सखी कहन यों आई ॥ पियकी हरबर करो बिदाई ।
children.translated_text: The two friends came and spoke thus: 'Quickly bid farewell to your beloved;

children.text: फुफी गौतमी निकटहिं आई ॥ शकुन्तला सुनि निपट
children.translated_text: aunt <s>Gautamī</s> has come near.' <s>Śakuntalā</s>, hearing this, was utterly

children.text: डरानी । बोलि उठी नृपसों फिरि बानी ॥ दुरहू द्रुमनमें
children.translated_text: frightened; she spoke again to the king: 'Hide among the trees,

children.text: प्रेमपियारे । हमते फेरि भये तुमन्यारे ॥ फुफी गौतमी
children.translated_text: O beloved; once again you are separated from me. Aunt <s>Gautamī</s>

children.text: अब इत ऐहै । कर गहि मोहिं धरै लैजैहै ॥ इततेकहो
children.translated_text: will come this way; she will seize my hand and take me away. Tell me,

children.text: कहाँ तुम जैहो । हमहिं फेरि कब दरशनदैहो । दरश-
children.translated_text: where will you go from here? When will you grant me your darśana again? If you do not give

children.text: नहीं जोहरबरे दैहो । हमें फेरि तुम जियत न पैहो ॥
children.translated_text: your darśana promptly, you will not find me alive again.

children.text: ऐसी कछू निसानी दीजे । जाहिदेखि मन धीरज कीजे ॥
children.translated_text: Give me some token by which I may see it and steady my heart.'

children.text: शकुन्तला ये बैन सुनाये । नृपके नैन सजल ह्वै आये ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s> spoke these words; the king's eyes filled with tears.

children.text: तब नृप खोलि अंगूठी लीन्ही । शकुन्तलाकेकरमेंदीन्ही ॥
children.translated_text: Then the king removed his ring and placed it

children.text: और बात नृप कहन न पाई । निपट नगीच गौतमी
children.translated_text: in <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s hand. The king could say nothing more,

children.text: आई ॥ चलत गौतमीको पगबाज्यो । सुनि नृप दुरयो
children.translated_text: for <s>Gautamī</s> had come very near. As <s>Gautamī</s> approached, the sound of her footsteps was heard;

children.text: द्रुमन में भाज्यो ॥ शकुन्तला फिरि दुखभरि आई । पौढ़ि
children.translated_text: hearing it, the king hid, fleeing among the trees. <s>Śakuntalā</s>, filled again with sorrow, came back

children.text: रही जहँ सेज बिछाई ॥ तबलों तहाँ गौतमी आई ।
children.translated_text: and lay down where the bed had been spread. By then <s>Gautamī</s> arrived there

children.text: शकुन्तला गहि गरे लगाई ॥ पूछनि लगी गौतमी बा-
children.translated_text: and embraced <s>Śakuntalā</s> around the neck. <s>Gautamī</s> began to ask

children.text: तनि । अबकछु दाह घटो तव गातनि ॥ शकुन्तला
children.translated_text: questions: 'Has the burning in your body lessened any?' <s>Śakuntalā</s>

children.text: यह वचन कहयो तब । कछु बिशेष भयो तोहै अब ॥
children.translated_text: then spoke these words: 'Something special has happened to me now.'

children.text: तब गहि शकुंतला के करको ।ह्वाँते चली गौतमी घर
children.translated_text: Then, taking <s>Śakuntalā</s> by the hand, <s>Gautamī</s> departed from there

children.text: को ॥ शकुन्तला निज आश्रम आई । नृप दुखसागर
children.translated_text: to go home. <s>Śakuntalā</s> came to her own hermitage; the king,

children.text: थाह न पाई ॥ शकुंन्तला सँग जहँ सुखपायो । वाहीठौर
children.translated_text: in the ocean of sorrow, could find no bottom. Where he had found joy

children.text: फेरि नृप आयो ॥ सूनी सेज कमल दलवारी । देखि
children.translated_text: in <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s company, to that very place the king returned again. The empty bed with lotus petals—seeing it,

children.text: भयो नृपके दुखभारी ॥ बिरह ताप चढ़ि आयो तनमें
children.translated_text: the king's burden of sorrow grew heavy. The fire of separation rose in his body;

children.text: नृप यों शोचन लाग्यो बनमें ॥ कहाँ जाऊँ कैसे सुख
children.translated_text: the king began to lament thus in the forest: 'Where shall I go, how shall I find peace?

children.text: पाऊं । यह दुख गाढ्यो काहि सुनाऊं ॥ अघ यों कब
children.translated_text: To whom shall I confide this deep sorrow? Alas, when will I see her again?

children.text: फिरि दरशन पैहौं । तबलों यहदुख कैसे सहिहौं ॥ ज्यों २
children.translated_text: Until then, how shall I endure this suffering? The more

children.text: लखत सेज यह सूनी । त्यों त्यों बढ़त पीर उर दूनी ॥
children.translated_text: I look upon this empty bed, the more the pain in my heart doubles.'

children.text: मनमें नृप यों शोच बढ़ाथो । मुनिन महाबन शोर म-
children.translated_text: As the king thus increased his lamentation in his mind, the sages in the great forest raised

children.text: चायो ॥ महराज क्यों सुधि घिसराई । जित तित दानव
children.translated_text: a clamor: 'Great king, why have you forgotten your duties? Everywhere the demons [are causing havoc].'

children.text: देत दिखाई ॥ लखत दानवन की परछाहीं । हमरो यज्ञ
children.translated_text: appeared before their sight. Seeing the shadows of the demons, our sacrifice

children.text: सकल रहि जाहीं ॥ ऋषिन दीनयों बचन सुनायो । तु-
children.translated_text: was all being obstructed. The sages delivered this sorrowful message. Im-

children.text: रत बियोगी नृप उठिधायो ॥ हित में भयो बितज अति
children.translated_text: mediately the king, separated from his beloved, rose and rushed forth. In their welfare arose a great

children.text: भारी । फेरि करनलाग्यो रखवारी ॥
children.translated_text: tumult. He began once more to stand guard.

children.text: इतिश्रीशकुंतलानाटकोद्वितीयोङ्कह २ ॥
children.translated_text: Thus ends the second act of the Shakuntala drama. Act 2.

children.text: अथ तृतीयोङ्कः ॥
children.translated_text: Now begins the third act.

children.text: चौपाई । पकरि गोतमी आश्रम आई । बिरह ल-
children.translated_text: Chaupai. Catching hold, <s>Gautamī</s> came to the <s>āśrama</s> (hermitage). The creepers of separation

children.text: तनि में अतिही छाई ॥ बथा बिरह की सही न जाई ।
children.translated_text: had spread exceedingly. The agony of separation could not be endured.

children.text: शकुंतला सुधि बुधि बिसराई ॥ संग सखी तन कोउ न
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s> had lost all awareness and consciousness. No companion

children.text: भावे । बैठि एकांत दृगनि बरसावे ॥ बिनदेखे कल नेक
children.translated_text: pleased her heart. Sitting alone, she let tears rain from her eyes. Without seeing him, she found

children.text: न पावे । घरी २ ज्यों बरस बितावे ॥ सूनो सो सबरो
children.translated_text: not a moment's peace. Each moment passed like a year. The world seemed desolate

children.text: जग लेखति । धरेध्यान पिय मूरति देखति ॥ आईसुधि
children.translated_text: and barren to her. She sat in meditation, beholding the beloved's image. When the memory

children.text: पीतम कीरतिकी । तबै अंगूठी देखी नृपकी ॥
children.translated_text: of the beloved's glory came to mind, then she beheld the king's ring.

children.text: घनाक्षरी । सुधि और सब कौन समुझावे वाके उर
children.translated_text: Ghanakshari. What other awareness could anyone give her? Nothing

children.text: कछु नहिं भावे न सहेली कोऊ साथमें । अतिही दुखित
children.translated_text: pleased her heart, nor any companion at her side. Extremely distressed,

children.text: शिरनाये सूने सदन में बैठी प्यारी धरिके बदन बाम
children.translated_text: head bowed, sitting in a desolate dwelling, the dear one resting her face on her left

children.text: हाथ में ॥ चित्र कैसी लिखि नेक डोलति न बोलति न
children.translated_text: hand. Like a painting, she neither stirred nor spoke,

children.text: दुखनकी मोट धरिदीन्ही बिधि माथमें । सुनत बात
children.translated_text: and fate had placed a bundle of sorrows upon her head. Hearing words,

children.text: सूने से ह्वैगये सकल गात बैठी ध्यान कीन्हे मन दीन्हे
children.translated_text: all her limbs became as if lifeless; she sat in meditation, her mind given over

children.text: प्राणनाथ में २ ॥
children.translated_text: to her lord of life.

children.text: चौपाई । शकुंतलायोंमनअटकायो । मुनिदुर्वासाआश्रम आयो ३ ॥
children.translated_text: Chaupai. <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s mind was thus entangled. The sage <s>Durvāsā</s> came to the <s>āśrama</s> (hermitage). 3.

children.text: सवैया । पिय ध्यान में बैठी शकुंतलाहै ऋषि आय
children.translated_text: Savaiya. <s>Śakuntalā</s> was seated in meditation on her beloved; the sage came

children.text: गयो अनचाह्योई चाह्यो । नहिं शासन बूझि कै आसन
children.translated_text: uninvited though uninvited. She did not inquire of his command, nor offered a seat,

children.text: दीन्हों न आदर सों कछु बैन कह्यो ॥ तबयों दुर्वासा
children.translated_text: nor spoke any words of welcome to him. Then <s>Durvāsā</s>

children.text: रिसाइकह्यो जिहिको यहि भांति तू ध्यान धरयो । सुधि
children.translated_text: in anger said: 'He on whom you meditate in this manner, his memory

children.text: तेरीनसो करिहै कबहूं यह शाप सिताब देजातरह्यो ४ ॥
children.translated_text: of you he shall never retain' -- giving this curse, he departed swiftly. 4.

children.text: सवैया । बोल सुनो न ऋषीश्वरको न ऋषीश्वरकी
children.translated_text: Savaiya. She heard not the words of the great sage, nor did she see

children.text: निरखी परछाहीं । ध्यानधरे जुहती चित में तिय ध्यान
children.translated_text: the great sage's shadow. Absorbed in meditation, that woman remained offering oblations in her heart,

children.text: धरेही रही चितमाहीं ॥ क्रोधी महा दुर्वासा ऋषीश्वर
children.translated_text: her mind fixed in meditation. The supremely wrathful sage <s>Durvāsā</s>

children.text: दीन्हों है शाप पसारि के बाहीं । आयो कभे कब जातु
children.translated_text: pronounced his curse with outstretched arms.

children.text: रह्यो यह नेक शकुंतलाको सुधिनाहीं ५ ॥
children.translated_text: When he came and when he departed -- of this <s>Śakuntalā</s> had not the slightest awareness. 5.

children.text: चौपाई । सुनत शाप सखियां उठिधाईं । हरबर दु-
children.translated_text: Chaupai. Hearing the curse, the companions rose and ran. In haste they came to

children.text: र्वासा ढिगआईं ॥ भयो सखिन के जिय दुख गाढ़यो ।
children.translated_text: <s>Durvāsā</s>'s side. Deep sorrow arose in the companions' hearts.

children.text: पांय पकरि कीन्हों मुनि ठाढ़यो ॥ शकुंतलाके नेहु नि-
children.translated_text: Grasping his feet, they made the sage stand still. Beholding <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s

children.text: हारे । बिनती लगींकरे करजोरे ॥ क्रोध ईतनो तुम्हरे
children.translated_text: love, they began to entreat him with folded hands. 'This much anger is

children.text: लायक । यह अपराध क्षमो मुनिनायक ॥ करो न क्रोध
children.translated_text: fitting for you. Forgive this offense, O chief among sages! Do not be angry,

children.text: दया मन ल्यावहुा । करहुकृपा यह शाप मिटावहु ॥ यह
children.translated_text: bring compassion into your heart. Show mercy and remove this curse. This

children.text: बिनती मनधरहु हमारी । कण्व सुता सो सुता तुम्हारी ॥
children.translated_text: is our plea -- take it to heart. <s>Kaṇva</s>'s daughter is as your own daughter.'

children.text: दोऊ सखिन कही यह बानी । सुनि किरपा कछु मुनि मनआ
children.translated_text: Both companions spoke these words. Hearing them, some compassion arose in the sage's

children.text: नी ॥ राजागयो अंगूठीदैहै । बाहि लखतही फिरि सुधिह्वैहै ॥
children.translated_text: heart. 'When the king comes and gives the ring, upon seeing it, the memory shall return.'

children.text: यह बिधि छूटयो शाप हमारो । यह कहिके मुनि फेरि
children.translated_text: In this manner, the curse was mitigated. Saying this, the sage departed

children.text: सिधारो ॥ छूटो शाप हरष भयो गातन । दोऊ सखी
children.translated_text: once more. The curse was lifted, and joy filled their limbs. Both companions

children.text: लगीं फिर बातन ॥ जो मुनि कही सो है नहिं झूंठी ।
children.translated_text: began talking again. What the sage said is not false.

children.text: शकुंतलहि नृपदई अंगूठी ॥ जब नृपको बे सुधि करि
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s> was given a ring by the king. When she can make the king

children.text: पावे । वहै अंगूठी वाहि दिखावे ॥ काहू सों न कहो
children.translated_text: remember, she should show that very ring to him. Tell

children.text: नहिं मानै । हमैं तुम्हैं यह शापहि जानै ॥ शकुन्तला
children.translated_text: no one, for no one will believe it. Only we know of this curse. If <s>Śakuntalā</s>

children.text: जो कछु सुनि पैहै । कवनिहुं जतन न जीवति रहि है ॥
children.translated_text: hears any of this, she will by no means survive.

children.text: योंकहिके बातें दुखहाईं । दोऊ शकुंतला ढिग आईं ६ ॥
children.translated_text: Saying these sorrowful words, both companions came to <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s side. 6.

children.text: दोहा । निरखति नैननसों कछू कछू सुनित नहिंकान ।
children.translated_text: Doha. Her eyes perceiving nothing, her ears hearing nothing,

children.text: निहँचलचित्त शकुतंला बैठिकरति पियध्यान ७ ॥
children.translated_text: with steadfast mind <s>Śakuntalā</s> sat in meditation on her beloved. 7.

children.text: चौपाई ॥ शकुंतला यों दिबस बितावति । राजा
children.translated_text: Chaupai. <s>Śakuntalā</s> thus spent her days. Of the king,

children.text: हिये न कछु सुधि आवति ॥ मुनिन बिदा करि दीन्हों
children.translated_text: no memory came to her heart. The sages bade farewell

children.text: राजहि । गयो आपने राज समाजहि ॥ शापगयो मुनि
children.translated_text: to the king. He went to his own royal court. The curse had been given by the sage,

children.text: दे दुखदाई । शकुंतला की सुधि बिसराई ॥ बहुतकाल
children.translated_text: bringing sorrow. <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s memory was lost. A long time

children.text: इहि भांति बितायो । शकुंतला उरगर्भ जनायो ॥ नीक
children.translated_text: passed in this manner. <s>Śakuntalā</s> conceived a child in her womb. Her body

children.text: न लगति देह दुबरानी । अंगअंगकी छबि पियरानी ॥
children.translated_text: grew weak and thin. The radiance of every limb turned pale.

children.text: आलस आनि चित्तमें छाये । उतस्यो बदन उससि
children.translated_text: Languor came and settled in her mind. Her face grew weary, and sighs

children.text: उर आयो ॥ नेह पीछलो नृप बिसरायो । तीरथन्हाय
children.translated_text: rose in her breast. The tender love of the king was forgotten. Having bathed at sacred

children.text: कण्व मुनि आयो ८ ॥
children.translated_text: pilgrimage sites, the sage <s>Kaṇva</s> returned. 8.

children.text: दोहा । कछुक दिनन में कण्व मुनि आयो तीरथन्हाय ।
children.translated_text: Doha. After some days, the sage <s>Kaṇva</s> returned from bathing at pilgrimage sites.

children.text: शकुंतला निजगर्भसों मुनिकोलखत लजाय ९ ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>, with child in her womb, felt ashamed before the sage. 9.

children.text: चौपाई । मुनि वर होमकरन लागेजब । भईअग्नि
children.translated_text: Chaupai. When the great sage began to perform the <s>homa</s> (fire sacrifice),

children.text: ते बानी यह तब १० ॥
children.translated_text: then a voice arose from the fire. 10.

children.text: दोहा । व्यहि नृप दुष्यंतको करि गंधर्व बिवाह ।
children.translated_text: Doha. To King <s>Duṣyanta</s> himself, through the <s>Gāndharva</s> (celestial) marriage,

children.text: शकुंतलाहै गर्भसों भलोभयो मुनि नाह ११ ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s> is with child -- this is well, O sage lord. 11.

children.text: चौपाई । कढ़ी अग्निते जब यह बानी । सुनि के
children.translated_text: Chaupai. When this voice emerged from the fire, hearing it,

children.text: मुनिवर आनँद ठानी ॥ करीहोम बिधि मुनि मनभाई ।
children.translated_text: the great sage was filled with joy. The <s>homa</s> (fire ceremony) was performed in the manner pleasing to the sage.

children.text: शकुतंला मुनि तुरत बुलाई ॥ लाजहि नख शिख अंग
children.translated_text: The sage immediately summoned <s>Śakuntalā</s>. She concealed every part of her body

children.text: छिपाये । आई शकुंतला शिर नाये ॥ शकुंतला ढिगमें
children.translated_text: from head to toe in modesty. <s>Śakuntalā</s> came with bowed head. He seated

children.text: बैठाई । करन लगे मुनि बहुत बड़ाई ॥ बड़ो मोहिं ते
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s> near himself and began to praise her greatly. 'You have given me

children.text: सुख यह दीन्हों । अतिही मोहिं सुचित करि लीन्हों ॥
children.translated_text: great happiness. You have made me exceedingly pleased.

children.text: चक्रवर्ति सुत में बरु दीन्हों । जित ते ब्याह गंधरब
children.translated_text: I have given my ward in marriage to a son who shall be a universal sovereign (<s>Cakravartin</s>). Since the <s>Gāndharva</s>

children.text: कीन्हों ॥ मैं अवलोकत दर्व न रहिहों । भोरतोहिं सा-
children.translated_text: marriage was performed. I shall not delay in looking after you. Tomorrow I shall

children.text: सुरे पठैहों ॥ शकुंतलाको सुनि ससुरासी । भई सखिन
children.translated_text: send you to your in-laws' home.' Hearing of her departure to her in-laws' home,

children.text: के चित्त उदासी ॥ निरखि सखिन के मुख मुरझाये ।
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s companions became heavy-hearted. Seeing the companions' faces

children.text: शकुंतला के दृग भरि आये ॥ भयो भोर रवि दई दि-
children.translated_text: wilt, <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s eyes filled with tears. Dawn came and the sun showed

children.text: खाई । शिरते शकुंतला अन्हवाई ॥ बिदा समै मुनि
children.translated_text: itself. <s>Śakuntalā</s> was bathed from head to toe. At the time of departure, the sage

children.text: कण्व बुलाये । सब ऋषि बधू मिलनको आये ॥ मुनि
children.translated_text: <s>Kaṇva</s> was called. All the sages' wives came to meet her. The sage

children.text: ससुरारहि देत पठाये । शकुंतला सिसकति शिरनाये ॥
children.translated_text: sent her off to her in-laws' home. <s>Śakuntalā</s>, sobbing, bowed her head.

children.text: बैठीं घेरि सकल ऋषि नारी । लगीं अशीषें देने प्या-
children.translated_text: All the sages' wives gathered around, and the dear ones began to give

children.text: री ॥ प्रान समान होहु पति प्यारी । लखि लखि सौतें
children.translated_text: blessings. 'May you be as dear to your husband as life itself. May your co-wives

children.text: जरहि तिहारी ॥ सुत सपूत ह्वै है घर जाता । सुखसा-
children.translated_text: burn with envy upon seeing you. May your sons be worthy and prosperous at home. May you remain immersed

children.text: गर में रहो समाता ॥ ये बातें कहिके हितकारी । घर
children.translated_text: in the ocean of happiness.' Having spoken these kind words, the sages'

children.text: अपने मुनि बधू सिधारी ॥ शकुंतला ढिग और न कोऊ ।
children.translated_text: wives departed to their own homes. Near <s>Śakuntalā</s> there was no one else

children.text: कै गौतमि कै सखियां दोऊ ॥ शकुंतला अंशुवन भरि
children.translated_text: except <s>Gautamī</s> and the two companions. <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s eyes filled with

children.text: आई । गही गौतमी गोद बिठाई ॥ बडी बेरलों गूंथि
children.translated_text: tears. <s>Gautamī</s> took her into her lap and seated her. After a long while,

children.text: बनाई । फूलमाल सखियन पहिराई ॥ कासों कहें कहां
children.translated_text: flower garlands were strung and prepared, and placed upon the companions. From whom could they get,

children.text: ते ल्यवें । गहनो नहीं कहा पहिरावें ॥ भरि भरि दुहूं
children.translated_text: from where could they bring jewels? There were none to adorn her with. Both companions shed tears

children.text: दृगन जल मोचें । दोऊ सखी दुखित ह्वै शोचें ॥ भूषण
children.translated_text: filling both their eyes, grieving in distress. 'We have brought all the

children.text: बसन सबै हम ल्याये । द्वैमुनि बालक गहनो ल्याये ॥
children.translated_text: garments and ornaments. Two young hermit boys brought the jewels.'

children.text: गहने को जिनि शोक बढ़ावहु । लेहु ललित गहनो
children.translated_text: 'Do not increase your sorrow over jewels. Take these beautiful ornaments

children.text: पहरावहु ॥ गहनो देखि सखिन सुखपायो । कहन लगी
children.translated_text: and adorn her.' Seeing the jewels, the companions found happiness. They began to ask

children.text: किततें यह आयो १२
children.translated_text: where these had come from. 12.

children.text: दोहा । देखि अचंभौ सबन को दोऊ तब मुनिबाल ।
children.translated_text: Doha. All were amazed to see them; then the two hermit boys

children.text: कहन लगे यहभांति हैं इह गहनेके हाल १३ ॥
children.translated_text: began to tell the account of these jewels in this manner. 13.

children.text: घनाक्षरी । कण्व गुरु हमको पठायो कै शकुंतला
children.translated_text: Ghanakshari. Guru <s>Kaṇva</s> sent us, saying, 'Go pick flowers for <s>Śakuntalā</s>

children.text: को फूल तोरि ल्याउ फूल माला पहिराउ आनि । हम
children.translated_text: and bring garlands to adorn her.' We

children.text: गये फूल तोरें और गति भईं तब सिद्धि है गुरू की
children.translated_text: went to pick flowers, and then the supernatural powers of our guru came to pass, for he

children.text: वह हमको परति जानि ॥ काहूं पाये पानकाहूं काजर
children.translated_text: knew of us. Someone found lac-dye, someone kohl,

children.text: ललित काहूं काहूं महाउर काहूं सेंदुर सुहाग बानि ।
children.translated_text: someone beautiful vermilion, someone auspicious sindoor (red powder) in the bridal manner.

children.text: रूखन के भीतर हाथन निकासि गहि भूखन बसन
children.translated_text: From within the trees, jewels and garments were brought out by hand

children.text: हमें दीन्हें बन देवतानि १४ ॥
children.translated_text: and given to us by the forest deities. 14.

children.text: चौपाई । सुनि गौतमी सगुन ठहरायो । शकुंतलहि
children.translated_text: Chaupai. Hearing this, <s>Gautamī</s> declared it an auspicious omen. She adorned <s>Śakuntalā</s>

children.text: गहनो पहिरायो ॥ सेंदुर सखियन मांग चढ़ायो । का-
children.translated_text: with the jewels. The companions filled the parting of her hair with vermilion,

children.text: जर नैनन माहिं लगायो ॥ जावक रंग पगनि झलका-
children.translated_text: applied kohl to her eyes. They applied lac-dye to her feet,

children.text: वो । चुनि चटकीलो पट पहिराय ॥ बीरी सखिन बनाइ
children.translated_text: making them glow. A bright garment was chosen and put on her. The companions prepared betel

children.text: खबाई । शकुंतला दुलहिन बनि आई ॥ जब लों यह
children.translated_text: and fed it to her. <s>Śakuntalā</s> was adorned as a bride. By the time this

children.text: शृंगार बनायो । तब लों न्हाय कण्व मुनि आयो ॥
children.translated_text: adornment was completed, the sage <s>Kaṇva</s> had returned from his bath.

children.text: शकुंतला को दुख रमि जागो । मुनि मन माह िंकहन
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s sorrow stirred and awoke. In the sage's mind, he began to
speak thus. 15.

children.text: छन्द । धरत न धीर गरो भरि भरि आवतहै निकसि
children.translated_text: Chhand. He cannot hold his composure, his throat fills again and again, and tears come forth

children.text: निकसि नीर आवत दृगनि में । हरष हिरानो जात कछू न
children.translated_text: flowing from his eyes. Joy is vanishing away; nothing pleases body and mind,

children.text: सुहात तन मन अकुलात योंरहो नजात बनमें ॥ आजु
children.translated_text: which are agitated -- thus he cannot remain in the forest. Today

children.text: ससुरारि को शकुंतला सिधारेगी सो याही शोच सकुच
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s> will depart for her in-laws' home; this worry and anxiety

children.text: सँभारन तन में । मेरे बनवासी के भयोहै दुख एतोदुख
children.translated_text: fills his body. 'I, a forest-dweller, have suffered this much sorrow;

children.text: केतेहोत हवैहै घरबासिन के मन में ॥ १६ ॥
children.translated_text: how much sorrow must arise in the hearts of those who dwell in homes!' 16.

children.text: चौपाई । यह मुनि मन में मोह बढ़ायो । शकुंतला
children.translated_text: Chaupai. This delusion grew in the sage's heart. He came

children.text: के ढिग चलि आयो ॥ बापहि देखि मोह सों पागी ।
children.translated_text: to <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s side. Seeing her father, overcome with affection,

children.text: शकुंतला तब रोवन लागी ॥ दुखतें नीर रह्यो भरि
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s> then began to weep. Tears of sorrow filled

children.text: नैननि । बोल्यो पुनि मुनि गद्‌गद बैननि ॥ मंगल
children.translated_text: her eyes. The sage spoke again in a choked voice. 'It is

children.text: है पियके घर जैबो । अब या समय उचित नहिंरुइ-
children.translated_text: auspicious to go to your husband's home. It is not proper to weep

children.text: बो ॥ क्यों गौतमी नाहिं समुझावति । शकुंतला यों
children.translated_text: at this time. Why, <s>Gautamī</s>, do you not console her?'

children.text: रोवनि पावति ॥ है शुभघरी बिलम्ब न लावहु । अब
children.translated_text: Thus <s>Śakuntalā</s> was brought to tears. 'It is an auspicious hour; do not delay.

children.text: हीं ह्यांतें याहि पठावहु ॥ यों कहि मुनि ह्वै शिष्य बु-
children.translated_text: Send her forth from here right now.' Saying this, the sage called his disciples

children.text: लाये । शकंतला सँग को ठहराये ॥ गहि बहियां गौत-
children.translated_text: and appointed companions for <s>Śakuntalā</s>. Holding her arms, <s>Gautamī</s>

children.text: मी उठाई । शकुंतला ससुरारि पठाई १७ ॥
children.translated_text: raised her up. <s>Śakuntalā</s> was sent off to her in-laws' home. 17.

children.text: दोहा । पोंछति दृग सुसकति चली शकुंतला ससुरारी ।
children.translated_text: Doha. Wiping her eyes, sobbing, <s>Śakuntalā</s> set off for her in-laws' home.

children.text: तबसबरेबनद्रुमनसों मुनियोंकह्योपुकारि १८ ॥
children.translated_text: Then, to the trees of the forest, the sage spoke these kind words. 18.

children.text: घनाक्षरी । फूलति तुम्हैं निहारि ऐसे उर फुलतिहो
children.translated_text: Ghanakshari. 'You would bloom upon seeing her -- just as a woman's heart blossoms

children.text: सुत के भये तें फूल होत जैसे नारि को । क्यारीं आल
children.translated_text: with the birth of a son, so you would flower. She would tend the beds and plants,

children.text: बालनि बनावति रहतींयाही श्रम में बितावतीं हुतीं जो
children.translated_text: spending her time in this labor, she who watered you

children.text: वार पहेर चारि को ॥ जबलों पहिले तुम्हें न सींचिले
children.translated_text: every four days. Until she watered you first,

children.text: ती हुती तबलों न कबहूं जो पियत हुती वारिको । सेवा
children.translated_text: she would not drink water herself. This is the service

children.text: इहि भांति जो करति ही तिहारी सोई सुनिये शकंतला
children.translated_text: she rendered to you -- know this, for <s>Śakuntalā</s>

children.text: सिधारी ससुरारिको १९ ॥
children.translated_text: is departing for her in-laws' home.' 19.

children.text: चौपाई । मुनिवर यह बन द्रुमन सुनायो । पिकनि
children.translated_text: Chaupai. The great sage spoke thus to the forest trees. The cuckoos,

children.text: द्रुमनि चढ़ि शोर मचायो ॥ कोयल कुंहकति चढ़ि चढ़ि
children.translated_text: perched on the trees, raised a clamor. The cuckoos cooed from branch

children.text: डारिन । मनुद्रुमवतवत करत पुकारन ॥ देखि रही अ-
children.translated_text: to branch, as if the trees were calling out. Seeing her own

children.text: पने द्रुमलाये । शकुंतलाके दृग भरिआये ॥ शकुंतला
children.translated_text: beloved trees, <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s eyes filled with tears. <s>Śakuntalā</s>

children.text: यह शोक समानी । सखियन सों बोली यह बानी ॥
children.translated_text: was overwhelmed by this grief. She spoke these words to her companions.

children.text: लाग्यो जड़ नृप नेहु निगोड़ो । मोपै जात नहीं बन
children.translated_text: 'The love of this foolish, obstinate king has taken root in me. I cannot leave the forest

children.text: छोड़ो ॥ मेरो लाई द्रुम अरु पाती । देखे दुख भरिआ-
children.translated_text: though I must go. Looking at the trees and leaves I planted,

children.text: वत छाती ॥ अब सेवा नाहीं हेमोपे । येद्रुम जात तुम्हें
children.translated_text: my breast fills with sorrow. Now there is no one to tend them.

children.text: को सौंपे ॥ यह सुन के भरिआईं अँखियां । बोलि उठी
children.translated_text: These trees I entrust to you as I leave.' Hearing this, tears filled their eyes.

children.text: तब दोऊ सखियां ॥ कहा सौंपती ये द्रुम पाती । हमैं
children.translated_text: Then both companions spoke up. 'Why do you entrust these trees and plants to us?

children.text: काहि तुम सौंपेजाती ॥ योंकहि परम प्रेमसों पागी ।
children.translated_text: To whom do you entrust us as you go?' Saying this, drenched in deepest love,

children.text: सखी शोरकै रोवन लागी ॥ मया सखिन के अति हिय
children.translated_text: the companions began to weep aloud. Affection swelled greatly in the companions' hearts.

children.text: बाढ़ी । शकुंतला रोवतिहै ठाढ़ी ॥ बड़ी बेरलों मुनिस-
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s> stood weeping. After a long while, the sage

children.text: मुझाई । शकुंतला आगे चलिआई ॥ शकुंतला मग
children.translated_text: consoled them. <s>Śakuntalā</s> came forward and proceeded. <s>Śakuntalā</s> again set out on the

children.text: फेरि सिधारी । भयो सकल बनके दुखभारी ॥ नाचनि
children.translated_text: path. The entire forest was heavy with sorrow. The peacocks

children.text: मोरनि ने बिसराई । उगिलत घास हरिण अधखाई ॥
children.translated_text: forgot their dancing. The deer stopped chewing, leaving their grass half-eaten.

children.text: रह्यो चकित ह्वै पवन न डोलत । दुखित भ्रमर गुंजत
children.translated_text: The wind stood still in astonishment, not stirring. The bees, grieving, hummed

children.text: नहिं बोलत ॥ जितनो जानि हतो बनबासी । सबही
children.translated_text: but did not sing. Every creature of the forest

children.text: के तन भई उदासी ॥ सब बनमें छाई बिकलाई । शकुं-
children.translated_text: was filled with dejection. The whole forest was pervaded by distress. <s>Śakuntalā</s>

children.text: तला कोसुक चलि आई ॥ पहरुक तबलों दिन चढ़ि
children.translated_text: came forth with ease. By then a good part of the day had

children.text: आयो । मुनिको यह गौतमी सुनायो ॥ देखो बड़ी बेर
children.translated_text: passed. <s>Gautamī</s> told the sage. 'Look, much time

children.text: चढ़ि आई । शकुंतलाको करो बिदाई ॥ सीख होय सो
children.translated_text: has passed. Make your farewell to <s>Śakuntalā</s>. Whatever instruction

children.text: याहि सिखावो । ठाढ़े होउन आगे आवो ॥ मुनिको भयो
children.translated_text: you have, teach it to her now. Stand up and come forward.' The sage was seized

children.text: महा दुख गाढ़यो । भयो सबनको ले मुनिठाढ़यो २० ॥
children.translated_text: by deep grief. All stood together with the sage. 20.

children.text: दोहा । शिष्यनिसों मुनिकहि उठे मन बिचारिठहराइ ।
children.translated_text: Doha. The sage, having considered in his mind, rose and spoke to his disciples.

children.text: कहियोनृपदुष्यंतसों यहसँदेश समुझाइ २१ ॥
children.translated_text: 'Tell King <s>Duṣyanta</s> this message, making him understand. 21.

children.text: चौपाई । हमहैं आश्रित राव तिहारे । तुमहौ रक्षक
children.translated_text: Chaupai. We are dependent on you, O king.

children.text: सदाहमारे ॥ शकुंतलाहै सुता हमारी । याहि जानियो जि-
children.translated_text: You too are always our protector. <s>Śakuntalā</s> is our daughter.

children.text: यते प्यारी ॥ हमैं न आश्रम आवनदीन्हों । आपहिं व्याह
children.translated_text: Know that she is dear to our very soul. We did not permit her to leave the <s>āśrama</s> (hermitage).

children.text: गंधरब कीन्हीं ॥ शकुंतला जुनसुख में रहिहै । यहदुख
children.translated_text: She herself entered into a <s>Gāndharva</s> (love) marriage. May <s>Śakuntalā</s> live in happiness.

children.text: मोपै सहीनजैहै २२ ॥
children.translated_text: This sorrow I cannot endure.' 22.

children.text: दोहा । नृप के हेत सँदेश के शिष्यन सों कहिबैन ।
children.translated_text: Doha. Having spoken these words of message for the king to his disciples,

children.text: शूकुंतलाकोसीखतब लगोमहामुनिदेन २३ ॥
children.translated_text: the great sage then began to give <s>Śakuntalā</s> her instructions. 23.

children.text: चौपाई । सासु ननँदकी सेवा करियो । पति के प्यार
children.translated_text: Chaupai. 'Serve your mother-in-law and sister-in-law. Do not forget your husband's

children.text: भूलि मति परियो ॥ सौतिनहूं में हिलिमिलि रहियो ।
children.translated_text: love. Get along well even with co-wives.

children.text: अपनो भेद न कबहूं कहियो ॥ भागन के न गरब मन
children.translated_text: Never reveal your secrets. Do not let pride of fortune

children.text: धरियो । पति शासन ते नेक न टरियो ॥ यह बिधि तें
children.translated_text: enter your heart. Never stray from your husband's command. In this manner

children.text: पति के घर रहियो । सब घर सों कुल बधू कहैयो ॥ यह
children.translated_text: live in your husband's house. Let all the household call you a true bride of the family.' Take

children.text: सिख सब मन में धरिलीजै । बन को मोहिं बिदा अब
children.translated_text: all these instructions to heart. Now give me leave to return to the forest.

children.text: कीजै ॥ अपने संग गौतमी लीजे ॥ बिदा सखिनहूं की
children.translated_text: Take <s>Gautamī</s> with you. Now bid farewell

children.text: अब कीजे ॥ शकुंतला जल भरि अँशुवन को । रोवन
children.translated_text: to the companions as well.' <s>Śakuntalā</s>, her eyes brimming with tears,

children.text: लगी गरो गहि मुनिको ॥ मिलिके मुनिकी करी बिदाई ।
children.translated_text: began to weep, clasping the sage's neck. They embraced and bade the sage farewell.

children.text: शकुंतला सखियन ढिग आई ॥ सखियन मिलि गहि
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s> came to the companions' side. Meeting and embracing

children.text: गरे लगाई । अँशुवनकी तब नदी बहाई ॥ बिछुरन के
children.translated_text: them, a river of tears flowed. The sorrow of separation

children.text: दुख महा समानी । बड़ी बेरलों रोय चुपानी ॥ जो
children.translated_text: was overwhelming. After a long while, they wept and fell silent. The

children.text: सराप दुर्बासा दीन्हों । सो सखियन अपने मन कीन्हों ॥
children.translated_text: curse that <s>Durvāsā</s> had given, the companions kept within their own hearts.

children.text: अनसूया तबकरि चतुराई । शकुंतला सों बातचलाई ॥
children.translated_text: Then <s>Anasūyā</s>, with cleverness, engaged

children.text: अटकत चित्त बहुतकाजनिमें । सुधि वैसी नरहतिराजनि
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s> in conversation. 'The mind gets entangled in many affairs.

children.text: में ॥ समयो बीतिगयो बहुतेरी । नृप जो नेह बिसारे तेरो ॥
children.translated_text: Such is the memory of kings and noblemen. Much time has passed. If the king has forgotten your love,

children.text: जो नृप गयो अंगूठी दैहै । वाहि लखतही फिरि सुधि
children.translated_text: when the king comes, he will give the ring. Upon seeing it, the memory will return.

children.text: अैहै ॥ सुनि सखियातें जिनि बिसरावै । कहूं अँगूठी
children.translated_text: Hear this from your companions and do not forget. Keep the ring safe somewhere --'

children.text: जानन पावै ॥ यह सुनि डरते छतिया डोली । शकुंतला
children.translated_text: would come to know.' Hearing this, her heart trembled with fear. <s>Śakuntalā</s>

children.text: सखियन सों बोली ॥ यह सँदेह ते मोहिं सुनायो । याको
children.translated_text: spoke to her friends: 'You have told me this doubt,

children.text: मैं कछु भेद न पायो ॥ अतिही गूढ़कहीं तेंबानीयह सुनि-
children.translated_text: but I have not understood any secret of it.

children.text: केहौं निपट डरानी ॥ तब सखियन यह बचन सुनायो ।
children.translated_text: These words are exceedingly obscure' — hearing this, she became greatly frightened.

children.text: देखो दिन दुपहर हवै आयो ॥ बिदा होउ छोड़ो अब
children.translated_text: Then her friends said these words: 'See, the midday hour has arrived.

children.text: बाते । चलौ उताबल पहुंचो जाते २४ ॥
children.translated_text: Take your leave, stop talking now; let us hurry and reach [our destination].' (24)

children.text: दोहा । चले शिष्य आगे तबहिं शकुंतला के साथ ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: The disciples went ahead then, along with <s>Śakuntalā</s>;

children.text: दोऊ सखियां संगलै उतैं चल्यो मुनिनाथ २५ ॥
children.translated_text: both friends went along too, and from that side the lord of sages (<s>Muni</s>) also set out. (25)

children.text: चौपाई । दोऊ सखियांफिरिफिरि देखों । सूनो सोंसबरों
children.translated_text: Chaupāī: Both friends kept looking back again and again; the whole world seemed empty and desolate

children.text: जग लेखें ॥ कछुक दूरि आगे तब डोली । हाथनि तो-
children.translated_text: to them. When the palanquin had gone a little distance ahead, she turned back, breaking off [leaves] with her hands, and spoke thus:

children.text: ड़त फिरि यों बोली ॥ गई द्रुमन की ओट छिपाई ।
children.translated_text: 'She has gone behind the trees, hidden from view;

children.text: शकुंतला नहिं देत दिखाई ॥ सखियन को आश्रम लै
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s> can no longer be seen.' The friends were brought back to the <s>āśrama</s> (hermitage),

children.text: आयो । शकुंतला पति पुर नगिचायो २६ ॥
children.translated_text: and <s>Śakuntalā</s> drew near to her husband's city. (26)

children.text: दोहा । पति पुर मारग निकट में देख्यो भस्यो तलाव ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: On the road near her husband's city, she saw a fine pond.

children.text: शकुंतला प्यासी भई गई तहां करि चाव २७ ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s> was thirsty and went there with delight. (27)

children.text: चौपाई । पानी पियो प्यास तब भागी । शकुंतला मुंह
children.translated_text: Chaupāī: She drank water and her thirst was quenched. <s>Śakuntalā</s> began

children.text: धोवन लागी ॥ भयो बिनाश महा है पल मैं । करतें गिरी
children.translated_text: to wash her face. In that moment, a great disaster occurred — while doing so, the ring fell

children.text: अंगूठी जल मैं ॥ गिरी अंगूठी जब जल माहीं । शकुंत-
children.translated_text: into the water. When the ring fell into the water,

children.text: ला को कछु सुधि नाहीं २८ ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s> had no awareness [of it]. (28)

children.text: दोहा । शिष्यनि सहित शकुंतला आई नृप के द्वार ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: <s>Śakuntalā</s>, accompanied by the disciples, came to the king's gate.

children.text: खिलवत में बैठी हतो तबनृप करि दरबार २९ ॥
children.translated_text: At that time the king was sitting in private audience, holding court. (29)

children.text: चौपाई । शिष्यनि की बातें सुनि लीन्हीं । खोजनिजाय
children.translated_text: Chaupāī: The words of the disciples were heard; a search was made and

children.text: खबरि तब दीहीं ॥ महाराज मुनि कण्व पठायो । शिष्य
children.translated_text: then the news was given: 'O great king, the sage <s>Kaṇva</s> has sent [us]. Two disciples

children.text: दोय द्वारे पर आये ॥ लीन्हे संगललित ह्वै नारी । करो
children.translated_text: have come to the gate.' They brought with them a beautiful woman [saying]: 'She

children.text: चहत मन नजरि तिहारी ॥ नारि सुने नृप अचरज
children.translated_text: desires to present herself before your gaze.' Hearing [the word] 'woman,' the king was astonished

children.text: मानो । अतिही चिंता में चितु आनो ॥ निकरि यज्ञ
children.translated_text: and became absorbed in great anxiety. He came out and entered the <s>yajñaśālā</s> (sacrificial hall),

children.text: शालामें आयो । मुनिके शिष्यनिकों बुलवायो ३० ॥
children.translated_text: and had the sage's disciples summoned. (30)

children.text: दोहा । शिष्यनि पीछे गौतमी पैठी नृप के द्वार ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: Behind the disciples, <s>Gautamī</s> entered the king's gate,

children.text: पीछे सबके ह्वैचली शकुन्तला दरबार ३१ ॥
children.translated_text: and behind everyone, <s>Śakuntalā</s> walked into the court. (31)

children.text: चौपाई । राजा करि सन्मान बुलाये । याबिधि शिष्य
children.translated_text: Chaupāī: The king called them with due honor: 'In this manner have the disciples

children.text: कणवके आये ॥ शकुन्तला लाजहि गहि गाढ़यो । आई
children.translated_text: of <s>Kaṇva</s> come.' <s>Śakuntalā</s>, held firmly by modesty, came

children.text: पियघर घूंघट काढ़यो ॥ चढ़योअभाग्य आनितबजाग्यो ।
children.translated_text: to her husband's house and drew her veil. Then misfortune arose, and [an ill omen]

children.text: नैन दाहिनो फरकन लाग्यो ॥ यह असगुन तब आनि
children.translated_text: awoke — her right eye began to throb.

children.text: जनायो । शकुंतला के दुख भरिआयो ॥ दीठि पसारि
children.translated_text: This bad omen then made itself known,

children.text: बिसारि निमेखन । शकुंतला लागीं नृप देखन ॥ बिलखे
children.translated_text: and <s>Śakuntalā</s> was filled with sorrow. Opening her eyes wide

children.text: अद्भुत रससों पाग्यो । मन मन नृपति कहनयोंलाग्यो ॥
children.translated_text: and forgetting to blink, <s>Śakuntalā</s> began to gaze at the king. Disconcerted,

children.text: कोहैनारि कहां यह आई । बनमें मुनिन कहां यहपाई ॥
children.translated_text: steeped in the <s>rasa</s> (sentiment) of wonder, the king began to say to himself:

children.text: जानिनपरतु कहां ये आये । यहांजाइ काहेको ल्याये ॥
children.translated_text: 'Who is this woman? Where has she come from? Where did the sages find her in the forest?

children.text: यहबिचारमनमेंनृपकीन्हों । आशिर्बादमुनिनतबदीन्हों
children.translated_text: I do not know, nor [do I know] where these people have come from; why have they brought her here?' The king pondered this in his mind; then the sages gave their blessings.

children.text: दोहा । आसनते उठि दूरते कीन्हों नृपतिप्रणाम ॥
children.translated_text: Dohā: Rising from his seat, from afar the king made salutations.

children.text: क्षेमकुशल पूछनलग्योछोड़ि और सबकाम ३३ ॥
children.translated_text: Setting aside all other business, he began to inquire about their welfare. (33)

children.text: महाराजके राजमें रह्यो न दुखको हेत ॥
children.translated_text: 'In the kingdom of the great king, there remains no cause for sorrow.

children.text: तपतु तरणिके तेज ते तुम न दिखाईदेत ३४ ॥
children.translated_text: Even from the blazing heat of the sun, you show no distress.' (34)

children.text: चौपाई । कहोकुशल सब मुनि बन वारे । रहतकणव
children.translated_text: Chaupāī: 'Tell us, are all the sages of the forest well? Does your <s>guru</s> <s>Kaṇva</s>

children.text: गुरु सुखित तिहारे ३५ ॥
children.translated_text: remain in comfort?' (35)

children.text: दोहा । जिनके आशिर्वादते लोगअमरह्‌वैजात ॥
children.translated_text: Dohā: 'Those by whose blessings people become immortal —

children.text: तिनसिद्धिनकेकुशलकीफौनचलावतबात ३६ ॥
children.translated_text: who would question the welfare of those accomplished ones?' (36)

children.text: चौपाई । महाराज के ढिग हम आये । यह संदेश
children.translated_text: Chaupāī: 'O great king, we have come to your presence. We have brought this

children.text: गुरू के लाये ॥ हमको बिदा गुरू जब कीन्हों । यह सं-
children.translated_text: message from our <s>guru</s>: When the <s>guru</s> gave us leave,

children.text: देश तुमको कहिदीन्हों ॥ जानी हम सब बात तिहारी ।
children.translated_text: he spoke this message for you: "We have come to know your whole affair.

children.text: शकुंतला है सुता हमारी ॥ जोगन्धर्व व्याह तुमठानो ।
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s> is our daughter.

children.text: सो हम कछू दुःख नहिं मानो ॥ महाराजमें हैं गुनजेते ।
children.translated_text: The <s>gāndharva</s> (love) marriage you performed —

children.text: शकुंतलाहू में हैं तेते ॥ भलीभई सुनि हम सुख पायो ।
children.translated_text: we do not regard it as any cause for sorrow.

children.text: विधि यह भल संयोग बनायो ॥ शकुंतला यह गर्भ स-
children.translated_text: Whatever virtues the great king possesses,

children.text: हितहै । सुनि मुनि तुरत पठाई इतहै ॥ शकुंतला को
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s> too possesses the same. It is well; hearing this, we are pleased.

children.text: घरमें राखो । मुनिका कहो संदेश सुभाखो ॥ शकुंतला
children.translated_text: Fate has arranged this good union. <s>Śakuntalā</s> is with child;

children.text: हम इत पहुंचाई । हमको तुम अबकरो बिदाई ॥ मुनि
children.translated_text: hearing this, the sage has promptly sent her here. Keep <s>Śakuntalā</s>

children.text: को शाप न मनते डोल्यो । बेसुधराजा फिरियों बोल्यो ॥
children.translated_text: in your house.' Speak this auspicious message of the sage. We have brought <s>Śakuntalā</s>

children.text: मुनिके शिष्य प्रवीनमहाहो । तुम ये बातेंकरत कहाहो ॥
children.translated_text: here; now give us leave to depart.' [Though] the sage's curse made his mind waver, the bewildered king again spoke thus:

children.text: शकुंतला किन व्याहीको है । मोहिं नहीं यह सुधि तनको
children.translated_text: 'O most learned disciples of the sage, what are you saying?

children.text: है ॥ राजाकही कठिन यहबानी । सुनि शिष्यनने अति
children.translated_text: Who has married <s>Śakuntalā</s>? I have no memory of this at all.'

children.text: रिसठानी ॥ सुनि नृपबैन सबै सुधिभागी । शकुंतला कं-
children.translated_text: The king spoke these harsh words. Hearing them, the disciples became very

children.text: पन तबलागी ॥ नृपके बचन-धरमतेडोले । दोऊ शिष्य
children.translated_text: angry. Hearing the king's words, all awareness fled; <s>Śakuntalā</s> began

children.text: कोपि कै बोले ॥ महाराज कछु धरमहि जानो । ऐसो
children.translated_text: to tremble. The two disciples, shaken by the king's words contrary to <s>dharma</s> (righteousness), spoke

children.text: अधरम मति मन आनो ॥ कस्योव्याह तब करिछल
children.translated_text: in anger: 'O great king, do you know anything of <s>dharma</s>? Do not bring

children.text: घातें । अब्यो कहनलगे तुम बातें ॥ सोईकरत जो कछु
children.translated_text: such <s>adharma</s> (unrighteousness) to mind. Having performed the marriage through deceit,

children.text: मन आवत । राजालोगन पीरहि जानत ३७ ॥
children.translated_text: you now speak such words! Kings do only what comes to their minds; they care nothing for others' pain.' (37)

children.text: दोहा । राजाके सुनि बैनये निपट उठी अकुलाय ॥
children.translated_text: Dohā: Hearing these words of the king, greatly agitated,

children.text: शकुतलासों गौतमी कहनलगी समुझाय ३८ ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Gautamī</s> began to counsel <s>Śakuntalā</s>. (38)

children.text: चौपाई । घरी एक छोड़ो तुम लाजहि । मुख उधार
children.translated_text: Chaupāī: 'Set aside your modesty for a moment; lift your face

children.text: दिखरावहु राजहि ॥ मुखजो तिहारो देखनपावे । तोनृप
children.translated_text: and show it to the king. If he can see your face,

children.text: को अबहीं सुधिआवे ॥ कहि गौतमी घुंघट खुलवायो ।
children.translated_text: then the king will remember at once.' Speaking thus, <s>Gautamī</s> had the veil removed,

children.text: शकुंतला मुख नृपहिं दिखायो ३९ ॥
children.translated_text: and <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s face was shown to the king. (39)

children.text: दोहा । पलकपसारि निहारितब शकुंतलाको रूप ॥
children.translated_text: Dohā: Opening his eyelids, the king then gazed at <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s beauty.

children.text: नाहीं हां कछु करत नहिं रह्यो भूलिसो भूप ४०
children.translated_text: He said neither 'yes' nor 'no' — the king stood as if lost in a daze. (40)

children.text: चौपाई । राजाजबकछु ओंठनखोले । मुनिके शिष्य
children.translated_text: Chaupāī: When the king just barely opened his lips, the sage's disciples

children.text: फेरि पुनि बोले ॥ महाराज मनमें सुधिकीजै । अब हम
children.translated_text: spoke again: 'O great king, search your memory;

children.text: को कछु उत्तरदीजै ॥ शकुंतला की लखि तन दीपति ।
children.translated_text: now give us some answer.' Seeing <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s radiant body,

children.text: बोल्यो फिरयों बिसुधि महीपति ॥ बड़ी बेरलों सुधिकरि
children.translated_text: the king spoke again, [still] bewildered: 'After long deliberation I have tried to recollect,

children.text: देखी । मैं सपनेहूं यह नहिं पेखी ॥ तुमतो कहत कि तुम
children.translated_text: but I have not seen her even in a dream.

children.text: यह ब्याहीं । मोहिं कछू सुधि आवतिनाहीं ॥ गर्भ स-
children.translated_text: You say that I married her,

children.text: हित यह नारि बिरानी । कैसे राखिसकौं करिरानी ॥ यह
children.translated_text: but no memory comes to me. This woman, a stranger, is with child —

children.text: सुनि शिष्य रिसनसों पाग्यो । या विधि नृपसों बोलन
children.translated_text: how can I keep her as my queen?' Hearing this, the disciple was filled with anger

children.text: लाग्यो ॥ ऐसोपाप कहामन आनत । तुम ऋषिलोगन
children.translated_text: and began to speak to the king in this manner: 'How do you bring such sin to mind?

children.text: को नहिं जानत ॥ कण्व महामुनि जबरिसकरिहै । तुर-
children.translated_text: You do not know the ways of sages!

children.text: तहिं तुम्हैं जानि तब परिहै ४१ ॥
children.translated_text: When the great sage <s>Kaṇva</s> grows angry, then you will know, and it will be too late!' (41)

children.text: दोहा । करिके बातें कठिन ये राजाको डरपाय ॥
children.translated_text: Dohā: Having spoken these harsh words to frighten the king,

children.text: शकुंतलासोंशिष्यतबबोलेनिपटरिसाय १४२ ॥
children.translated_text: the disciples then spoke to <s>Śakuntalā</s> in great anger: (42)

children.text: चौपाई । काहूकोतब बूझिनलीन्हों । आपहि व्याह
children.translated_text: Chaupāī: 'You did not ask anyone's counsel then, and performed

children.text: गन्धरब कीन्हों ॥ जैसेकियो सोफल अबलीजै । राजाको
children.translated_text: the <s>gāndharva</s> (love) marriage on your own. Now accept the fruit of what you did.

children.text: कछु उत्तरदीजै ॥ लाज छांड़ि अँखियनको खोली । श-
children.translated_text: Give some answer to the king.' Abandoning her shame and opening her eyes,

children.text: कुंतला तब नृपसों बोली ॥ महाराजयह नीति कहाहै ।
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s> then spoke to the king: 'O great king, what kind of justice is this?

children.text: याते अधरम होतु महाहै ॥। यामें कहो कहातुम पावत ।
children.translated_text: From this, great <s>adharma</s> (unrighteousness) results.

children.text: क्यों बिन काज कलंक लगावत ॥ तब पहिले हमतुम्हें
children.translated_text: In this, tell me, what do you gain? Why do you cast blame without cause?

children.text: न जानति । कहो जु तुम कछु सो हम मानत ॥ तब
children.translated_text: Before, I did not know you; whatever you said then, I believed.

children.text: वैसी करिके छल घातें । अब तुम कहत कहा ये बातें ॥
children.translated_text: Having practiced such deceit then,

children.text: बिदा होत तुम दई अंगूठी । यातेहौं हुइहौं नहिं झूंठी ॥
children.translated_text: how do you now speak such words? When you departed, you gave me a ring;

children.text: और भेद अब कहा बतावों । वहै अंगूठी कहो दिखा
children.translated_text: by that, I will not be [proven] false. What other proof shall I now show?

children.text: वों ॥ शकुन्तला योंबोलि चुपानी । राजा कही फेरि यह
children.translated_text: Let me show you that very ring.' Having spoken thus, <s>Śakuntalā</s> fell silent. The king then

children.text: बानी ॥ यह तुम बात न्याय की कीन्ही । अबलों क्यों
children.translated_text: spoke these words again: 'What you have said is a matter of justice;

children.text: न अंगूठी दीन्ही ॥ जो मैं लेखन अंगूठी पाऊँ । तो मैं
children.translated_text: why have you not given the ring until now?

children.text: तुमहिं सांच ठहराऊं ॥ परसि अंगूठी केरि ठिकानो । श
children.translated_text: If I find the ring as evidence, then I shall

children.text: कुंतला को मुख पियरानो ॥ कर में तब न अंगूठी पाई ।
children.translated_text: confirm you as truthful.' Feeling for the ring's place,

children.text: हाय २ तिहि ठौर मचाई ॥ लै उसांस करि सजल निमे
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s face turned pale. She did not find the ring on her hand then,

children.text: षनि । लगी गौतमी को फिरि देखनि ॥ शकुंतला अति
children.translated_text: and she cried 'Alas! Alas!' at that spot. Taking a deep breath, with tear-filled eyes,

children.text: ही शरमानी । राजा कही बिहँसि यह बानी ॥ त्रिय च-
children.translated_text: she turned to look at <s>Gautamī</s>. <s>Śakuntalā</s> was overcome with shame.

children.text: रित्र सुनि राखै बैननि । ते हम लखेआज निजनैननि ॥
children.translated_text: The king spoke with a laugh: 'The wiles of women —

children.text: मैंकब तोको दई अंगुठी । ऐसी बातकहतक्यों झूंठी ॥
children.translated_text: I have heard them described in words, but today I have seen them with my own eyes.

children.text: पर तिय ते मन बिमुख हमारो । चलि है कछु न प्रपंच
children.translated_text: When did I ever give you a ring? Why do you speak such falsehood?

children.text: तिहारो ॥ बिधि नृप के मन ते यों डोली । शकुंतला
children.translated_text: My mind is averse to another's wife; your trickery will not work.'

children.text: नृप सों पुनि बोली ॥ देखी मैं प्रभु की प्रभुताई । जिहि
children.translated_text: Thus the king's mind was moved by fate. <s>Śakuntalā</s> again

children.text: जिहि बिधि हों नाचनचाई ॥ नहीं अंगूठी कहा दिखाऊं ।
children.translated_text: spoke to the king: 'I have seen the lord's lordliness —

children.text: कहो और मैं भेद बताऊं ॥ एक दिना तुम हम बन
children.translated_text: whatever way he wishes, he makes me dance. I have no ring to show;

children.text: माहीं । बातें कहत हते चित चाहीं ॥ मैं अपने कर सेय
children.translated_text: but let me tell you another proof. One day, you and I were in the forest,

children.text: बढ़ायो । तहां एक मृगको सुत आयो ॥ वाहि चहो तुम
children.translated_text: speaking words from the heart. I extended water with my own hand,

children.text: बारि पियायो । वह न तिहारे ढिग चलि आयो ॥ तब
children.translated_text: and there came a fawn.

children.text: मैं जल अपने कर लीन्हों । मृग सुत आय तुरत पी-
children.translated_text: You wished to give it water to drink, but it would not come to you.

children.text: लीन्हों ॥ तबतुम तहांकरी यहहांसी । तुमये दोऊहौबन
children.translated_text: Then I took water in my own hands,

children.text: बासी । मृग सुत संगहि रहत तिहारे । पियहि नीर क्यों
children.translated_text: and the fawn came and drank at once. Then you made this jest there: "You are both forest-dwellers.

children.text: हाथ हमारे ॥ यह कहि के तब हंसी बढ़ाई । अब तुम
children.translated_text: The fawn stays always with you; why does it drink water from

children.text: सबरी सुधि बिसराई ॥ यहू सुने सुधि मन नहिं आई ।
children.translated_text: my hand?" Saying this, you then increased [our] laughter. Now you have forgotten all memory of it.'

children.text: राजा फिरि यह बात चलाई ॥ या विधि मीठी बातें करि
children.translated_text: Even hearing this, no memory came to the king's mind.

children.text: कै । लेत त्रिया सब को मन हरिकै ॥ या बिधि अद्भुत
children.translated_text: The king again spoke thus: 'In this manner, women win the hearts of all

children.text: बात बनाई । छू न गई मनु कहूं झुठाई ॥ यह सुनि मन
children.translated_text: by speaking sweet words. In this manner you have fashioned a wondrous tale,

children.text: में अति सतरानी । कही गौतमी नृप सों बानी ॥ महा
children.translated_text: but no falsehood has touched my mind.' Hearing this, greatly distressed

children.text: राज तुम हौ बिशवासी । कपट कहा जानें बनबासी ॥
children.translated_text: in mind, <s>Gautamī</s> spoke these words to the king: 'O great king, you are the one to be trusted.

children.text: कपट कहा हम सीखो बनमें । कपट होत राजनके मन
children.translated_text: What deceit do forest-dwellers know?

children.text: में ॥ यों कहि कै गौतमी चुपानी । राजा फेरि कही यह
children.translated_text: What deceit have we learned in the forest? Deceit dwells in the minds of kings.'

children.text: बानी ॥ होत स्वभावहि ते चतुराई । सब नारिनमें हम
children.translated_text: Having spoken thus, <s>Gautamī</s> fell silent. The king again spoke:

children.text: ठहराई ॥ सुनहु न कोयल की चतुराई । करती कागनि
children.translated_text: 'Cleverness is natural, and I have confirmed it in all women.

children.text: सों ठगहाई ॥ काग हवाले सुत करि देती । बड़ो भये
children.translated_text: Have you not heard the cleverness of the cuckoo? She practices deception with the crows,

children.text: अपनो फिरि लेती ॥ राजा कही कठिन यह बानी। श-
children.translated_text: entrusting her young to the crow's care, and when they grow up,

children.text: कुंतला सुनि कै शरमानी ॥ कहा कहत हैरे अन्याई । तैं
children.translated_text: taking them back as her own.' The king spoke these harsh words. <s>Śakuntalā</s>,

children.text: मोसों कीन्हीं ठगराई ॥ तब मैं तोहिं न ठग करि जान्यो ।
children.translated_text: hearing them, was overcome with shame: 'What are you saying, O unjust one? You have

children.text: जो तू कह्यो सो तब मैं मान्यो ॥ यों कहि नीचेशीश न-
children.translated_text: practiced deception upon me! Then I did not know you to be a deceiver.

children.text: वायो । दुख भरि गयो गरो भरि आयो ॥ मुख को ढांकि
children.translated_text: Whatever you said, I believed.' Saying this, she bowed her head low,

children.text: दुखन सों पागी । शकुंतला तब रोवन लागी ॥ ओंठ दुहूं
children.translated_text: filled with sorrow, her throat choked. Covering her face,

children.text: शिष्यन तब खोले । शकुंतला सों रिस करि बोले ॥ नेहु
children.translated_text: steeped in grief, <s>Śakuntalā</s> began to weep. Both disciples then opened

children.text: करत काभे न जनायो । जैसो कियो सो फल अब पायो ॥
children.translated_text: their lips and spoke to <s>Śakuntalā</s> in anger: 'Why did you not reveal your love

children.text: पूछ लीजियत पहिचाने सों । प्रीति न करियतु अनजाने
children.translated_text: [to us earlier]? As you have done, so now you receive the fruit.

children.text: सों ॥ शकुंतला सों तब यों कहि कै । बोले तब नृप सों
children.translated_text: One should inquire from those one knows; love should not be given to strangers.'

children.text: रिसगहिकै ॥ सुनौ नृपति यह बात हमारी । भली बुरी यह
children.translated_text: Having spoken thus to <s>Śakuntalā</s>, they then spoke to the king,

children.text: नारि तिहारी ॥ छोड़हु याहि कि घर में राखहु । हमसों
children.translated_text: seizing their anger: 'Hear our words, O king:

children.text: तुम अब कछु मति भाखहु ॥ ये बातें राजा सों कहि कै ।
children.translated_text: good or bad, this woman is yours. Either abandon her or keep her in your house;

children.text: चले गौतमी को कर गहि कै ॥ तुम हूं छोड़ी या शठ
children.translated_text: but say nothing more to us.' Having spoken these words to the king,

children.text: छोड़ी । कहां जाउँ हौं जन्म निगोड़ी ॥ शकुन्तला यों
children.translated_text: they departed, taking <s>Gautamī</s> by the hand. 'You too have forsaken me, and this wretch has forsaken me;

children.text: रोय पुकारी । आपहु शिष्यन संग सिधारी ४३ ॥
children.translated_text: where shall I go, wretched as I am?' <s>Śakuntalā</s> thus

children.text: दोहा । शिष्यन के पीछे लगी शकुन्तला अकुलाय ॥
children.translated_text: cried out and departed with the disciples herself. (43)

children.text: पीछे देखि शकुन्तल हिं बोले शिष्य रिसाय ४४ ॥
children.translated_text: Dohā: <s>Śakuntalā</s> followed behind the disciples, distraught.

children.text: चौपाई । कहां अभागिनि तू इतआवत । सोई करति
children.translated_text: Seeing <s>Śakuntalā</s> behind them, the disciples spoke in anger: (44)

children.text: जो कछु मन भावत ॥ ज्यों नृप कहत जोतैं है तैसी ।
children.translated_text: Chaupāī: 'Where are you coming, wretched one? You keep doing

children.text: करि है कहा सुता मुनि ऐसी ॥ सांचु जो है यह तेरो क-
children.translated_text: only what pleases your own mind. As the king says you are, so you are.

children.text: हिबो । उचित तोहिं यह पिय घर रहिबो ॥ मुनि के आ-
children.translated_text: How is such a one a sage's daughter?

children.text: श्रम तूं अब रहि है । सब जग तोहिं कलंकिनि कहिहै ॥
children.translated_text: If what you say is true, then it is proper for you to live in your husband's house.

children.text: पियकी जोह्वैरहिहै दासी । तेहूं न तेरी ह्वैहै हांसी ॥ योंकहि
children.translated_text: If you remain now in the sage's <s>āśrama</s> (hermitage), the whole world will call you fallen.

children.text: कै फिरि शिष्य सिधारे । राजायोंकहि फेरि पुकारे ॥ कहां
children.translated_text: Even if you remain as a servant in your husband's [house], you will not be mocked.'

children.text: जातहौ छोड़े जाको । झूंठी आशदेतहौ ताको ॥ ४५ ॥
children.translated_text: Having spoken thus, the disciples turned back; and the king again called out: 'Where are you going, abandoning this one? You give her false hope!' (45)

children.text: दोहा । शकुन्तला की दुरदशा देखि दया मन ठानि ॥
children.translated_text: Dohā: Seeing <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s miserable plight, taking pity in his heart,

children.text: सोमराज प्रोहितबिबुध बोल्यो नृपसों आनि ४६ ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Somarāja</s>, the royal priest and sage, came and spoke to the king: (46)

children.text: चौपाई । लरिकाको यह ज्यावै जबलों । मेरे घरे रहै
children.translated_text: Chaupāī: 'Until this child is born and raised,

children.text: यह तबलों । ह्वै है सुत चक्कवै तिहारे । यह सब पंडित
children.translated_text: let her stay at my house until then. Your son will be a <s>cakravartī</s> (universal sovereign) —

children.text: कहत पुकारे ॥ शकुन्तला जिहि पूतहि ज्यावै । सुजो च-
children.translated_text: all the <s>paṇḍits</s> (scholars) proclaim this aloud. If <s>Śakuntalā</s> gives birth to a son

children.text: क्कवै लक्षण पावै ॥ तो या को सांची करि मानो । महा
children.translated_text: who bears the marks of a <s>cakravartī</s>,

children.text: राज अपने घर आनो ॥ और जो और तरह यह ह्वै
children.translated_text: then accept her as true and bring her to your own home, O great king.

children.text: है । तौ अपने मुनिके घर जै है ४७ ॥
children.translated_text: And if it turns out otherwise, then she will go to the sage's house.' (47)

children.text: दोहा । सुर के मुनि के शापते नर बेसुध ह्वै जात ॥
children.translated_text: Dohā: 'By the curse of gods or sages, a man becomes senseless.

children.text: शापमिटे आवेसुरति फिरिपीछे पछितात ४८ ॥
children.translated_text: When the curse is lifted, memory returns, and afterwards one feels remorse.' (48)

children.text: चौपाई । यह सुनि नृपति कही यह बानी । करहु
children.translated_text: Chaupāī: Hearing this, the king spoke: 'Do

children.text: जो तुम अपने मन आनी ४९ ॥
children.translated_text: as you think best.' (49)

children.text: दोहा । यह लैआयसु नृपति सों पीर राखि सब देह ॥
children.translated_text: Dohā: Taking this permission from the king, the priest, bearing all the pain in his body,

children.text: शकुन्तलासों कहि उठो चलो हमारेगेह ५० ॥
children.translated_text: rose and said to <s>Śakuntalā</s>: 'Come, let us go to our house.' (50)

children.text: शिष्य छोंड़ या बिधि गयेया बिधिछोड़ी नाथ ॥
children.translated_text: The disciples left her thus, and the lord [husband] forsook her thus;

children.text: शकुन्तला रोवतिचलीसोमराजकेसाथ ५१ ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>, weeping, went with <s>Somarāja</s>. (51)

children.text: शकुन्तला को देखि दुख आगि लपटसी आय ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s sorrow — a flame of fire seemed to approach;

children.text: माय मेनका लैगई शकुन्तलाहिउठाय ५२ ॥
children.translated_text: her mother <s>Menakā</s> came and took <s>Śakuntalā</s> away, lifting her up. (52)

children.text: चौपाई । शकुन्तलाको सोधन पायो । प्रोहित दौरि नृप-
children.translated_text: Chaupāī: The priest, searching for <s>Śakuntalā</s>, found [her gone];

children.text: ति ढिग आयो ॥ महाराज कह कहिये बैननि । ऐसो
children.translated_text: he ran to the king's presence: 'O great king, hear what I have to say:

children.text: अचरज देखो नैननि ॥ अंशुवन की गहि नैननि माला ।
children.translated_text: I have seen such a marvel with my own eyes!

children.text: चली साथ मेरे वह बाला ॥ धुनत दुहूंकर भाग अभा
children.translated_text: Shedding strings of tears from her eyes,

children.text: गी । जात हती मेरे संग लागी ॥ तब यक आगि लपट
children.translated_text: that maiden was walking with me. Beating both her hands against her wretched fate,

children.text: सी आई । चाहि गगन लै गइ उठाई ॥ यह सुनि हरष
children.translated_text: she was going along with me — then a flash of fire came

children.text: अंग उपजायो । राजा यह तब बचनसुनायो ॥ हम प-
children.translated_text: and, reaching toward the sky, lifted her and carried her away.' Hearing this, joy arose in the king's body, and the king then spoke these words: 'We have

children.text: हिलेही वह तजिदीन्हीं । भली भांति परमेश्वर कीन्हीं ॥
children.translated_text: Forget those who are wretched. The Lord has arranged things well.

children.text: यह कहि प्रोहित धरहि पठायो । नृप उठि शयन मंदिर
children.translated_text: Having said this, the priest was sent away. The king rose and came to

children.text: हि आयो ॥ जऊ सुरति आवत कछु नाहीं । तऊभई
children.translated_text: the bedchamber. Though no memory came to him at all,

children.text: चिंता चित माहीं ॥ नेकुन आवत नींद सुखन में ।
children.translated_text: still anxiety remained in his heart. Not a moment of sleep came amidst comforts;

children.text: रहति उदासी निशिदिनमन में ५३ ॥
children.translated_text: he remained melancholy in his mind day and night. (53)

children.text: इतिश्री शकुंतलानाटककथातृतीयोंक: ३ ॥
children.translated_text: Thus ends the third act of the tale of the <s>Śakuntalā</s> drama. (3)

children.text: अथ चतुर्योंकः ॥
children.translated_text: Now the fourth act.

children.text: चौपाई । शकुंतला जल में जो गिराई ।
children.translated_text: Caupāī. The ring that <s>Śakuntalā</s> dropped in the water,

children.text: वही अंगूठी केवट पाई ५४ ॥
children.translated_text: that very ring was found by a fisherman. (54)

children.text: दोहा । वही अंगूठी हाट ले बेचन गयो बजार ॥
children.translated_text: Dohā. Taking that very ring to market, he went to sell it at the bazaar.

children.text: बेचत ही सो पकरि गोपायो अतिहीमार ५५ ॥
children.translated_text: As soon as he tried to sell it, he was seized — the wretch was beaten severely. (55)

children.text: चौपाई ।नृप को नाउँ अंगूठी देखो ।
children.translated_text: Caupāī. The king's name was seen on the ring.

children.text: चोर केवटहि लोगन लेखो ५६ ॥
children.translated_text: People reckoned the fisherman a thief. (56)

children.text: दोहा । चोर जानि कै केवटहि पकर्यो तबकुतवाल ॥
children.translated_text: Dohā. Thinking him a thief, the magistrate seized the fisherman.

children.text: तहां अंगूठी को लग्यो केवट कहन हवाल ५७ ॥
children.translated_text: Then the fisherman began to explain the story of the ring. (57)

children.text: चौपाई । साहिब यह मैं नाहिं दुराई ।
children.translated_text: Caupāī. 'Master, I have not stolen this;

children.text: मैं यह तालहि भीतर पाई ५८ ॥
children.translated_text: I found it inside the lake. (58)

children.text: दोहा । भरे ताल मछरीन के खेलत हतो शिकार ॥
children.translated_text: Dohā. In a lake full of fish, I was playing at hunting;

children.text: तहांअंगूठीललित यह कढ़िआयोपरिजार ५९ ॥
children.translated_text: there this beautiful ring came out through the water.' (59)

children.text: चौपाई । यों सुनि केवट को छुटवायो । कोतवाल नृप
children.translated_text: Caupāī. Hearing this, the fisherman was released. The magistrate

children.text: के ढिगआयो ॥ आय अँगूठीनृपहिं दिखाई । शकुन्तला
children.translated_text: came to the king's presence. Coming, he showed the ring to the king.

children.text: नृपको सुधि आई ॥ पैठोदुख जियसुख कढ़ि भाग्यो । टप
children.translated_text: The king's memory of <s>Śakuntalā</s> returned. Sorrow entered his heart and happiness fled.

children.text: टप दृग जल बरसन लाग्यो ॥ दोऊ करशिरमें दैमारे ।
children.translated_text: Tears began to fall drop by drop from his eyes. He struck both hands upon his head

children.text: हायहायमुख बचन निकारे ॥ और कछून रहीसुधि तन
children.translated_text: and cried out 'Alas! Alas!' from his mouth. No other awareness remained

children.text: में । नृप यों शोचन लाग्यो मन में ॥ कासों कहौं कहा मैं
children.translated_text: in his body. The king began to grieve thus in his mind: 'To whom shall I tell what I have done?

children.text: कीन्हीं । मैं अपने गर छूरी दीन्हीं ॥ प्राण प्रिया घर
children.translated_text: I have put a knife to my own throat. My beloved wife came

children.text: बैठें आई । मोपै घर में रहन न पाई ॥ भूलि गई हवै
children.translated_text: and sat at home, yet I did not let her remain in the house. Forgotten were

children.text: सब दुख दाईं । अब वे बातें सब सुधि आईं ॥ प्रिया
children.translated_text: all those sorrowful things; now all those memories have returned.

children.text: लाज तजि भेद बतायो । तऊ न मेरे मन कछु आयो ॥
children.translated_text: My beloved cast aside her modesty and revealed her secret, yet nothing came to my mind.

children.text: प्राण प्रिया इत ते मैं छोड़ी । चले शिष्य उत छोड़ि
children.translated_text: I, wretched one, abandoned my beloved wife from this side; from the other side, the disciples left

children.text: निगोड़ी ॥ करि पुकार मग रोवन लागी । तऊ दया
children.translated_text: the poor woman. She cried out and began weeping on the road, yet no compassion

children.text: नहिं मेरे जागी ॥ वह अब सब सुधि मन में करकति ।
children.translated_text: arose in me. Now all those memories scratch at my mind —

children.text: कहा करौं छतिया नहिं दरकति ६० ॥
children.translated_text: what shall I do, yet my chest does not split open!' (60)

children.text: दोहा । दई अंगूठी आनि करि जादिन ते कुतवाल ॥
children.translated_text: Dohā. From the day the magistrate brought and delivered the ring,

children.text: तादिन ते लाग्यो रहन महा दुखित महिपाल ॥
children.translated_text: from that day the king remained in great sorrow.

children.text: घनाक्षरी । देह पियरान लागी नेह की बिथा सो जा
children.translated_text: Ghanākṣarī. His body began to turn pale; the pain of love arose;

children.text: गी मूखर भागी नींद न परति एकौ छिन है । भावतुनराग
children.translated_text: merriment fled; sleep did not come for even a moment. Desire, which brings pleasure,

children.text: बैराग सो हरत लीन्हे सुनि के दशायों सुख लागत अरि
children.translated_text: was taken away by renunciation; hearing of his condition, comfort felt like an enemy

children.text: नहै ॥ आठौ पहरन कराहत ही बितावत शकुन्तलाकी
children.translated_text: to him. He spent all eight watches groaning; the memory of <s>Śakuntalā</s>

children.text: सुधि हिये शालति कठिन है । केहूं दिन बीतत तो बीतत
children.translated_text: burned cruelly in his heart. Somehow the day would pass, but the night would not;

children.text: न राति अरु राति कहें बीतति तो बीतत न दिन है ॥
children.translated_text: and if somehow the night passed, the day would not pass.

children.text: चौपाई । राजा की यों देखि उदासी ।
children.translated_text: Caupāī. Seeing the king's melancholy thus,

children.text: सिगरे दुखित नगरके बासी ॥
children.translated_text: all the city's residents were distressed.

children.text: घनाक्षरी । गाइबो बजाइवो सवनि बिसराय डास्यो
children.translated_text: Ghanākṣarī. Singing and playing music — everyone forgot and cast them aside;

children.text: छोहरनि खिलन को खेलिवो भुलाइगो । सब पुर बासी
children.translated_text: children forgot their play and games. All the city's residents

children.text: महा रहत उदासीन खोज हाँसी को सबनि के मुखन
children.translated_text: remained in great gloom; the search for laughter disappeared

children.text: ते हिराय गो ॥ नारि औ पुरुष मिलि सबही बिसारो
children.translated_text: from everyone's face. Women and men together all forgot

children.text: सुख सिगरे नगर में निरो दुख छाय गो ॥ सबही के सुख
children.translated_text: happiness; throughout the entire city, nothing but sorrow spread. The king who

children.text: को दिवैया महिपाल सो शकुन्तला के शोच के समुद्र
children.translated_text: was the giver of happiness to all had himself sunk

children.text: में सिरायगो ॥
children.translated_text: in the ocean of grief for <s>Śakuntalā</s>.

children.text: घनाक्षरी । बिरही दुष्यंत महाराज जूके राजको
children.translated_text: Ghanākṣarī. The governance of the love-stricken King <s>Duṣyanta</s>'s

children.text: अमल न कहूं निर्मल निहारियत है । कहत निवाज
children.translated_text: kingdom — nowhere is it seen to be pure or clear. Says <s>Nivāja</s>:

children.text: कहूं पावत न कुहुंकन कोकिल बागन तें उड़ाई मारि
children.translated_text: nowhere are the cuckoo's cooing sounds found; from the gardens, cuckoos have been driven

children.text: यत है ॥ बिकत न बजारमें न केसरी गुलाब और चौंर
children.translated_text: away. In the bazaar, neither saffron nor rose-water sells; colorful garments with fly-whisks

children.text: के रंगीले बसनन फारियत है । फूलन न पावत द्रुमन
children.translated_text: are being torn apart. Flowers are not found on the trees —

children.text: में बनाय फूल काचीकली गहि २ तोरिडारियत है ॥
children.translated_text: artificial flowers are being made; tender buds are seized

children.text: चौपाई । नित पियरात जात ज्यों रोगी । मनमारे
children.translated_text: Caupāī. Growing paler each day like a sick man, the king

children.text: नृप रहत वियोगी ॥ बारहिं बार गरो भरि आवत । लो-
children.translated_text: remained heart-stricken in separation. Again and again his throat filled up,

children.text: चन अँशुवन की झरिलावत ॥ राजकाज ते चित्तसके
children.translated_text: and his eyes brought streams of tears. His mind was far from

children.text: लो । बैठो रहत एकांत अकेलो । सूनोसो सिगरो जग
children.translated_text: matters of state; he sat alone in solitude. He regarded the whole world

children.text: लेखत । धरैध्यान भावहि तिहि देखत ॥
children.translated_text: as empty, meditating with his thoughts fixed on her alone.

children.text: दोहा । निहचल करि चितलाय मनमूंदि लिये युगनैन ।
children.translated_text: Dohā. Making his mind steady and focused, closing both eyes,

children.text: देखि ध्यानमें भावतिहि कहन लग्योनृप बैन ॥
children.translated_text: seeing his beloved in meditation, the king began to speak these words:

children.text: चौपाई । मन तें दूरिकरो निठुराई । परगट ह्वै अब
children.translated_text: Caupāī. 'Remove this cruelty from my heart; appear now

children.text: देहु दिखाई ॥ कहा करों तब सुधि नहिं आई । जैसी
children.translated_text: and show yourself to me. What can I do? Then no memory came;

children.text: करी सो तैसी पाई ॥ बिरह बिथा सों अब जिन मारो ।
children.translated_text: as I did, so I have received. Do not kill me now with the pain of separation;

children.text: क्षमो एक अपराध हमारो ॥ ज्यों हम त्यों हम सो हुइ
children.translated_text: forgive this one transgression of ours. As we are, so have we become,

children.text: आई । तुम अपनी मति तजो बड़ाई ॥ छोड़हु कोप
children.translated_text: and you too — abandon the pride of your own mind. Let go of anger,

children.text: दया मन ल्यावहु । होहु जिते तित तें कढ़ि आवहु ॥
children.translated_text: bring compassion to your heart; wherever you may be, come forth from there.'

children.text: इतनी कहत मूरछा आई । फैलि गई मुखमें पियराई ॥
children.translated_text: Saying this much, he fainted; pallor spread across his face.

children.text: तनमें निकसि पसीना आयो । डोलत अब कछु हाथ न
children.translated_text: Sweat broke out from his body; swaying, he could no longer grasp anything with his hands.

children.text: पायो ॥ दौरि चतुरिका दासी आई । मुख पर आनि ब-
children.translated_text: Running, the clever maid <s>Caturikā</s> came and

children.text: यारि डुलाई ॥ देखि चतुरिका रोवन लागी । तबकछु
children.translated_text: fanned a breeze upon his face. Seeing [him], <s>Caturikā</s> began to weep; then

children.text: नृपहि मूरछा जागी ॥
children.translated_text: the king's faint somewhat lifted.

children.text: दोहा । देखि चतुरिकै सांसले उठोनृपति यों बोलि ।
children.translated_text: Dohā. Seeing <s>Caturikā</s> anxiously, the king rose and spoke thus:

children.text: जागिउठी मनिमूरछा दीन्हें दृगतबखोलि ॥
children.translated_text: 'My faint has arisen and awakened — opening my eyes, [I see you].'

children.text: चौपाई । ते बिनु काजहिको इत आई । महा मूरछा
children.translated_text: Caupāī. 'Why have you come here without purpose? You awakened me

children.text: आनि जगाई ॥ घरिक मूरछामें कलपाई । फिरिमोकोतैं
children.translated_text: from a great swoon. For a moment, in the faint, I was in anguish;

children.text: सुरति दिवाई ॥ दुखकी खानि नृपति यों खोली । चतुर
children.translated_text: you have again brought me back to consciousness.' Thus the king

children.text: चतुरिका दासी बोली ॥
children.translated_text: opened the mine of his sorrow. The clever maid <s>Caturikā</s> spoke:

children.text: दोहा । महाराज अचरजबड़ो सर्ब गुणनिकी खानि ।
children.translated_text: Dohā. 'Great king, what a great wonder — she who was a mine of all virtues —

children.text: शकंतला किहिंहरिलई यहकछुपरीनजानि ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>, who has taken her away? This I have not been able to understand.'

children.text: चौपाई । राजातबवहबातसुनाई । हतीमेनकाकीवहजाई ॥
children.translated_text: Caupāī. The king then told her the story: she was the daughter of <s>Menakā</s>,

children.text: दोहा । सहिन सुताकोदुख सकीउतरि गगनतें आय ।
children.translated_text: Dohā. Unable to bear her daughter's suffering, descending from the sky,

children.text: माय मेनका लेगई भुवते वाहि उठाय ॥
