children.translated_text: the mother <s>Menakā</s> came and took her away, lifting her from the earth.

children.text: चौपाई । राजा कही सांच तब बानी । चतुर चतु-
children.translated_text: Caupāī. The king spoke the truth then. The clever <s>Caturikā</s>

children.text: रिकाफिरि बतरानी ॥
children.translated_text: spoke again in conversation:

children.text: दोहा । शकुंतलहि जो लेगई पकरि मेनका आप ।
children.translated_text: Dohā. '<s>Śakuntalā</s>, whom <s>Menakā</s> herself seized and took away —

children.text: महाराज तौ हरबरैं हुईहै बहुरि मिलाप ॥
children.translated_text: Great king, then be joyful! There will be a reunion again.

children.text: चौपाई । तबलों अपनो गिनत न कछु सुख । माय
children.translated_text: Caupāī. Until then, she counts no happiness as her own. The mother

children.text: सुताको देखति जब दुख ॥ तुम्हें सुरति आई करिपैहै ।
children.translated_text: sees her daughter's suffering. When your memory returns, she will bring [her back];

children.text: फेरि मेनकाताहि मिलैहै ॥ राजा फिरि यहबचन निकारो ।
children.translated_text: <s>Menakā</s> will reunite her with you.' The king then spoke these words again:

children.text: ऐसो है नहिं भाग हमारी ॥
children.translated_text: 'Such is not our fortune.'

children.text: दोहा । हम भुवमंडल इत रहत रही जाय सुरलोक ।
children.translated_text: Dohā. 'We remain here on this earth; she has gone to the world of the gods.',

children.text: क्यों मिलापह्वै सकत अब मिटत हमारा शोक ॥
children.translated_text: How can a reunion happen now? Our grief cannot be ended.'

children.text: चौपाई । यों कहि नृप मन गही उदासी । बोली फेरि
children.translated_text: Caupāī. So saying, the king took to melancholy in his heart. The maid

children.text: चतुरिका दासी ॥ महाराज मैं कहत न झूठी । यहकै-
children.translated_text: <s>Caturikā</s> spoke again: 'Great king, I do not speak falsely. How

children.text: से मिलि गई अंगूठी ॥ कहां गिरी जल में किहिं पाई ।
children.translated_text: did this ring come back? Where did it fall into the water? Who found it?

children.text: महाराज के कर फिर आई ॥ चतुर चतुरिका यों सम-
children.translated_text: [And yet] it has come back to the king's hand.' The clever <s>Caturikā</s> thus

children.text: झायो । भेद अंगूठी को सुनि पायो ॥ महाराज अति
children.translated_text: explained, and having heard, the king grasped the secret of the ring. 'Great king, afflicted

children.text: दुख सों पाग्यो । कहन अँगठी सों यों लाग्यो ॥ जग
children.translated_text: with great sorrow,' he began to speak thus to the ring: 'In this world,

children.text: में बड़ी अभाग्यो मैंरी । तुहूं बड़ी अभागिन हैरी ॥
children.translated_text: I am the most unfortunate, and you too are most unfortunate.

children.text: तोहिं हतीतो पहिरें प्यारी । तासों छोड़ भई तूं न्यारी ॥
children.translated_text: You were worn by my beloved; you became separated from her.

children.text: अब पीछे तू हूं पछितैहै । वैसी कहां अंगूठी पैहै ॥
children.translated_text: Now afterwards, you too will regret — where will you find such a finger again?'

children.text: दोहा । सुधि बुधि कछुतनमें नहीं मनको कठिनहवाल ।
children.translated_text: Dohā. No awareness or sense remained in his body; the state of his mind was pitiable.

children.text: रहत बावरो सो बकत ब्याकुल यों महिपाल ॥
children.translated_text: The king remained thus, raving like a madman, utterly distraught.

children.text: शकुन्तला को मेनका जब ले गई उठाय ।
children.translated_text: When <s>Menakā</s> had taken <s>Śakuntalā</s> away, lifting her up,

children.text: तब कश्यप मुनिनाथ के आश्रम राखी जाय ॥
children.translated_text: she went and placed her at the hermitage of the sage lord <s>Kaśyapa</s>.

children.text: कश्यपके आश्रम रहत बीति गयो कछु काल ।
children.translated_text: Living in <s>Kaśyapa</s>'s hermitage, some time passed.

children.text: शकुन्तला के सुत भयो भस्यो भाग्य सों भाल ॥
children.translated_text: A son was born to <s>Śakuntalā</s>, whose forehead shone with fortune.

children.text: चौपाई । भरत नाम सुतको ठहरानो । कछु दिन में
children.translated_text: Caupāī. The son was named <s>Bharata</s>. In some days

children.text: कछु भयो सयानो ॥ गंडा बांधि गरे मुनि दीन्हो । तिहि
children.translated_text: he grew somewhat wise. The sage tied an amulet around his neck and gave

children.text: गंडा को फलअस कीन्हो ॥
children.translated_text: this power to the amulet:

children.text: दोहा । माई बाप को छोड़ि कै और छुवै जोवाहि ।
children.translated_text: Dohā. If anyone other than his mother and father touches him,

children.text: काटे कालीनाग ह्वै यह गंडा तब ताहि ॥
children.translated_text: this amulet will become a black serpent and bite that person.

children.text: तब कछु दिन में मेनका कहो इन्द्र सों जाइ ।
children.translated_text: Then, after some days, <s>Menakā</s> went and said to <s>Indra</s>:

children.text: तुम राजा दुःष्यन्त को भेजहु यहां बुलाय ॥
children.translated_text: 'Send for King <s>Duṣyanta</s> and summon him here.

children.text: यहां बुलाइ बनाइ के राजहि सुरति दिवाय ।
children.translated_text: Having summoned and prepared the king here, restore his memory,

children.text: शकुन्तलहि गहि बांह तब दीजै फेरि मिलाय ॥
children.translated_text: and then, taking <s>Śakuntalā</s> by the arm, reunite them.'

children.text: नृपहिं बुलावन हेततब करो बहुत सन्मान ।
children.translated_text: To summon the king, show him great honor;

children.text: भेजो मातलि सारथी सुरपति सहित बिमान ।
children.translated_text: send the charioteer <s>Mātali</s>, the lord of the gods, with the celestial chariot.

children.text: चौपाई । राजा बिरह बिथा सों छायो । इन्द्र सारथी
children.translated_text: Caupāī. The king was consumed by the pain of separation when <s>Indra</s>'s charioteer

children.text: मातलि आयो ॥ ललित बिमान इन्द्र को लायो । मा-
children.translated_text: <s>Mātali</s> arrived. He brought <s>Indra</s>'s beautiful celestial chariot. <s>Mātali</s>

children.text: तलि ड्योढ़ीपर तब आयो ॥
children.translated_text: then came to the palace gate.

children.text: दोहा । चोबदार नृपसों कह्यो महाराज मघवान ।
children.translated_text: Dohā. The herald said to the king: 'Great king, Lord <s>Indra</s>

children.text: भेज्यो मातलि सारथी लायोललित बिमान ३५ ॥
children.translated_text: has sent the charioteer <s>Mātali</s>, who has brought a beautiful celestial chariot.' (35)

children.text: चौपाई । सुनतहि राजा तुरत बुलायो । मातलि म-
children.translated_text: Caupāī. Hearing this, the king immediately summoned him. <s>Mātali</s>

children.text: हाराज ढिग आयो ३६ ॥
children.translated_text: came to the king's presence. (36)

children.text: दोहा । मातलि कस्यो सलामतब पूंछनलग्यो नरेश ।
children.translated_text: Dohā. <s>Mātali</s> offered his salutation. Then the king began to ask:

children.text: कहो कुशल सों रहत हैं सबके सुखद सुरेश ३७ ॥
children.translated_text: 'Tell me, does the lord of the gods, the giver of happiness to all, remain well and safe?' (37)

children.text: चौपाई । कुशल क्षेम मातलि कहि दीन्ही । राजा
children.translated_text: Caupāī. <s>Mātali</s> reported that all was well and safe, then

children.text: सों फिरि बिनती कीन्ही ॥ महाराज ढिग मोहिं पठायो ।
children.translated_text: made a request to the king: 'Great king, [<s>Indra</s>] has sent me to your presence

children.text: यह सँदेश सुरनाथ सिखायो ॥ हमसों दानव करत
children.translated_text: and instructed me to deliver this message: "The demons are waging war against us;

children.text: लराई । होहु हमारे आनि सहाई ॥ आनि दानवन को
children.translated_text: come and be our ally. Come and slay the demons

children.text: इत मारो । बड़ो भरोसो हमैं तिहारो ॥ मातलि जबहिं
children.translated_text: here; we place great trust in you."' When <s>Mātali</s>

children.text: सँदेश सुनायो । सुनि महिपाल महा सुखपायो ३८ ॥
children.translated_text: delivered the message, the king was greatly pleased upon hearing it. (38)

children.text: दोहा । अंबर आछे पहरिके कमरबांधि हथियार ॥
children.translated_text: Dohā. Donning fine garments, girding weapons at his waist,

children.text: राजा अम्बर को चल्यो ह्वै बिमान असवार ३९ ॥
children.translated_text: the king departed for the sky, riding upon the celestial chariot. (39)

children.text: चौपाई । राजा चढ़ि बिमान में आयो । मातलि ग-
children.translated_text: Caupāī. The king came aboard the celestial chariot, and <s>Mātali</s>

children.text: गन विमान चलायो ॥ नृप ह्वै मगन गगन नगिचायो ।
children.translated_text: drove the chariot through the sky. The king, enraptured, approached the heavens;

children.text: तब इक अचल नजरिमें आयो ४० ॥
children.translated_text: then a mountain came into view. (40)

children.text: दोहा । परसु भुवार अकाश में लीन्हो ललितबहार ॥
children.translated_text: Dohā. Beyond the earth, in the sky, he beheld a beautiful spectacle.

children.text: राजा यों पूछनलग्यो है यहकौन पहार ४१ ॥
children.translated_text: The king thus began to ask: 'What mountain is this?' (41)

children.text: मातलि तब कहि यों उठो हेमकुंठठ है नाम ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Mātali</s> then spoke thus: 'Its name is <s>Hemakūṭa</s>.

children.text: महाराज यह अचलमेंकश्यपमुनिकोधाम ४२ ॥
children.translated_text: Great king, upon this mountain is the abode of the sage <s>Kaśyapa</s>.' (42)

children.text: चौपाई । कश्यपमुनि कहँ नृप सुनिपायो । मातलि
children.translated_text: Caupāī. When the king heard of the sage <s>Kaśyapa</s>, he

children.text: को यहबचन सुनायो ॥ रथयह गिरिकै सन्मुख कीजै ।
children.translated_text: said these words to <s>Mātali</s>: 'Turn this chariot toward that mountain;

children.text: मुनिवरको दरशन करिलीजै ॥ मातलि अचल निकट
children.translated_text: let me have the sight of the great sage.' <s>Mātali</s> brought the chariot near

children.text: रथ लायो । राजा उतरि अचल में आयो ४३ ॥
children.translated_text: the mountain, and the king descended and came upon the mountain. (43)

children.text: दोहा । शकुंतलाको सुत तहां देखो जाय नरेश ॥
children.translated_text: Dohā. There the king went and saw <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s son,

children.text: बलसोंसिंधिनिकेसुतहिं खैंचतधरि२केश ४४ ॥
children.translated_text: who was pulling the cubs of a lioness by the mane with [his] strength. (44)

children.text: सँग लागीं ह्वै तपसिनी तिनकी सुनि तबबात ॥
children.translated_text: Female ascetics followed along; hearing their words then,

children.text: शकुंतलाकोसुत गिनत सिंघिनसुतकेदांत ४५ ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s son was counting the teeth of the lion cub. (45)

children.text: चौपाई । याबिधि बालको लखिपायो । नृपके मन
children.translated_text: Caupāī. Beholding the boy in this manner, the king's heart

children.text: अद्भुत रसछायो ॥ बालकके सँग चितअनुरागो । मनमन
children.translated_text: was filled with the emotion of wonder. His heart was drawn to the boy;

children.text: नृपति कहनयों लागो ॥ ज्यों अपने सुतकीउरलागति ।
children.translated_text: in his mind, the king began to speak thus: 'Just as one's own son clings

children.text: याकी मोहिं मयात्यों लागति ॥ बिन सुतको बिधि मोहिं
children.translated_text: to one's breast, so does this boy's affection seem to me.

children.text: बनायो । मयालगति लखि पूत परायो ॥ बालहिं बैस
children.translated_text: Fate has made me without a son; yet seeing this other's child, I feel such attachment.

children.text: बीरता बाँको । यहअद्भुतसुत है धौं काको ॥ मनमें उप-
children.translated_text: At this age, the boy's valor is fierce — whose wondrous son might this be?' An extraordinary

children.text: ज्योअद्भुतरसअति । पूछनलग्यो तापसिननरपति ४६ ॥
children.translated_text: emotion of wonder arose in his mind, and the king began to ask the female ascetics. (46)

children.text: दोहा । बोलिउठीं तब तापसी कहा कहें हम हेत ॥
children.translated_text: Dohā. Then the female ascetics spoke up: 'What shall we say about the reason?

children.text: याके पापीबापको नाउँ न कोऊलेत ४७ ॥
children.translated_text: No one takes the name of this boy's sinful father.' (47)

children.text: सुलज सुशील पतिब्रता शकुंतलासीनारि ॥
children.translated_text: 'Modest, virtuous, devoted to her husband — <s>Śakuntalā</s> is that woman

children.text: जिहिं बिनकारणतजिदई घरतेदीन्हनिकारि ४८
children.translated_text: whom he abandoned without cause, casting her out of his home.' (48)

children.text: ये बातें सुनि के भयो नृप के मन संदेह ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing these words, doubt arose in the king's mind;

children.text: फेरिभेदपूछनलगो राजाकरिअतिनेह ४९ ॥
children.translated_text: the king began to ask further with great affection. (49)

children.text: चौपाई । याको पिता पापयुत जो है । याकी माय
children.translated_text: Caupāī. 'This boy's father, who is sinful — and his mother,

children.text: कहो तुम को है ॥ राजा इहि बिधि बातें खोलीं । फेरि
children.translated_text: tell me, who is she?' The king thus opened the matter, and

children.text: तापसी दोऊ बोलीं ५० ॥
children.translated_text: the two female ascetics spoke again: (50)

children.text: दोहा । महाबीर यह बालकी शकुंतला है माय ॥
children.translated_text: Dohā. 'Great hero, this boy's mother is <s>Śakuntalā</s>.

children.text: ताहि मेनका ता समय ल्याई इहांउठाय ५१ ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Menakā</s> at that time brought her here, lifting her up.' (51)

children.text: यह सुनिकर आनन्द तब मनसंदेह मिटाय ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing this, joy [arose]; the doubt in his mind was dispelled;

children.text: हालआयमहिपालतब लीन्होंसुतहिउठाय ५२ ॥
children.translated_text: the king approached and took the boy up in his arms. (52)

children.text: हरबर भरिआयोगरो दृग आंशु बरसाय ॥
children.translated_text: His throat filled with emotion; tears rained from his eyes.

children.text: कहनतापसिनसोंलगो राजायोंसमुझाय ५३ ॥
children.translated_text: The king began to speak to the female ascetics, explaining thus: (53)

children.text: चौपाई । जाको तुम मुख नाउँ न काढ़ो । वह पापी
children.translated_text: Caupāī. 'He whose name you will not utter from your mouths — that sinful one

children.text: मैंहीहौं ठाढ़ो ॥ पतिव्रतावह प्राणपियारी । मैंपापी बिन
children.translated_text: is I myself, standing here. That devoted wife, that beloved of my life —

children.text: हेत निकारी ॥ प्राणपियारी मोहिंदिखावो । मेरो अइबो
children.translated_text: I, the sinful one, cast her out without cause. Show me my beloved wife;

children.text: जाय सुनावो ॥ बालक गरे जो गण्डा राजै । सोहै सां-
children.translated_text: go and tell her of my arrival.' The amulet around the boy's neck

children.text: पन काटतु राजै ॥ यह तापसिन भेद मन आन्यो ।
children.translated_text: that should have bitten as a serpent — [did not]. The female ascetics understood this secret in their hearts

children.text: सांचो करि दुःष्यन्तहि जान्यो ५४ ॥
children.translated_text: and recognized <s>Duṣyanta</s> as the true [father]. (54)

children.text: दोहा । दौरिगई तब तापसिन यहसबभेद बताय ॥
children.translated_text: Dohā. Then the female ascetics ran, revealing all this secret,

children.text: शकुंतलहिको आपनै ल्याई जाय लिवाय ५५ ॥
children.translated_text: and went and brought <s>Śakuntalā</s> back with them. (55)

children.text: मुख मैले मैले बसन फैले मैले केश ॥
children.translated_text: With soiled face, soiled garments, and disheveled, dirty hair,

children.text: आई पियके पास तब शकुंतला यहभेश ५६ ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s> came before her beloved in this state. (56)

children.text: देखतभरिआयो गरो दृगनरहो जलछाय ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing her, his throat filled with emotion; tears covered his eyes.

children.text: पिय ढिग ठाढ़ी ह्वैरही शकुंतला शिरनाय ५७ ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s> stood near her beloved, her head bowed. (57)

children.text: चौपाई । राजहि और न कछु कहिआयो । शकुन्तला
children.translated_text: Caupāī. The king could say nothing else; he bowed his head

children.text: के पग शिरनायो ५८ ॥
children.translated_text: at <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s feet. (58)

children.text: दोहा । पाप लगावत क्यों हमें परसि हमारे पांय ॥
children.translated_text: Dohā. 'Why do you attach sin to us by touching our feet?'

children.text: योंकहि सुसकिशकुंतला राजहिलियोउठाय ५९ ॥
children.translated_text: So saying with a sob, <s>Śakuntalā</s> raised the king up. (59)

children.text: चौपाई । शकुन्तला फिरि बात चलाई । क्यों तब
children.translated_text: Caupāī. <s>Śakuntalā</s> then spoke: 'Why did you then

children.text: मेरी सुधि बिसराई ॥ महाराज अब क्यों सुधि आर्ह ।
children.translated_text: forget me? Great king, how has your memory now returned?'

children.text: राजा तब यह बात सुनाई ॥ यह मैं जबै अंगूठी पाई ।
children.translated_text: The king then told her the story: 'When I received this ring,

children.text: याहि लखतही सबसुधि आई ६० ॥
children.translated_text: upon seeing it, all my memory returned. (60)

children.text: दोहा । जा दिनते आई सुरति तादिनते यह हाल ॥
children.translated_text: Dohā. From the day my memory returned, from that day onward this has been my state;

children.text: निशि दिनकहतैहीरह्यो जियनभयोजंजाल ६१
children.translated_text: day and night I have been saying nothing but this; my heart found no peace. (61)

children.text: चौपाई । अब कछु गिनोन दोष हमारो । कठिन पी-
children.translated_text: Caupāī. Now do not count any fault of ours; forget the harsh

children.text: छिलो दुःख बिसारो ६२ ॥
children.translated_text: past suffering.' (62)

children.text: दोहा । यहसुनि बचन शकुन्तला बोलीकरि अनुराग ॥
children.translated_text: Dohā. Hearing these words, <s>Śakuntalā</s> spoke with affection:

children.text: महाराजको दोष कह बुरो हमारो भाग ६३ ॥
children.translated_text: 'It is no fault of the great king — it is our unfortunate fate.' (63)

children.text: चौपाई । नखशिख नृपति सुखनि सों छायो । सुनि
children.translated_text: Caupāī. From head to toe, the king was covered with happiness. Hearing [the news],

children.text: मुनि कश्यप नृपहिं बुलायो ६४ ॥
children.translated_text: the sage <s>Kaśyapa</s> summoned the king. (64)

children.text: दोहा । तनमें नहीं समात यों मन में बंड़ो हुलास ॥
children.translated_text: Dohā: The body cannot contain the great joy swelling in the mind.

children.text: शकुन्तलाअरुसुतसहितआयोनृप मुनिपास ६५ ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>, together with her son, came to the king at the sage's abode. (65)

children.text: चौपाई । राजा लखि प्रणाम तब कीन्हों । आशि-
children.translated_text: Caupāī: The king, upon seeing [them], made obeisance. The great sage gave

children.text: बार्द महामुनि दीन्हों ॥ अपनेढिग मुनि नृपहिं बुलायो ।
children.translated_text: his blessing. The sage called the king near to himself,

children.text: कुशलपूछि सादर बैठायो ६६ ॥
children.translated_text: asked after his well-being, and seated him with respect. (66)

children.text: दोहा । शकुंतलाकीओर लखिअरुलखिसुत अवदात ॥
children.translated_text: Dohā: Looking in the direction of <s>Śakuntalā</s>, and looking at the fair-complexioned son,

children.text: इहिविधितब महिपालसों कहीमहामुनिबात ६७ ॥
children.translated_text: in this manner the great sage then spoke to the king: (67)

children.text: शकुंतला है कुलबधू यह सुत है शुभयोग ॥
children.translated_text: '<s>Śakuntalā</s> is your lawful wife; this son is born of an auspicious union.

children.text: राजबंशके रतन तुम भलो बनो संयोग ६८ ॥
children.translated_text: You are the jewel of the royal lineage — a fine union has been made.' (68)

children.text: चौपाई । मुनिवर यह शुभ बात सुनाई । राजा यह
children.translated_text: Caupāī: The great sage delivered this auspicious message. The king then

children.text: फिरि बात चलाई ॥ मुनिवर कहौ दया मन ल्यावहु ।
children.translated_text: raised this matter: 'O great sage, please show mercy in your heart;

children.text: मेरेमनको भ्रम सोमिटावहु ॥ तुमत्रिकालकी जानतबातें
children.translated_text: dispel the confusion in my mind. You know the affairs of all three times [past, present, future];

children.text: मैं तुमसे यह पूछत तातें ६९ ॥
children.translated_text: therefore I ask you this. (69)

children.text: दोहा । कियो गंधरब ब्याह मैं याकेसंग करि प्रीति ॥
children.translated_text: Dohā: 'I performed a <s>Gāndharva</s> (love) marriage with her, having become attached;

children.text: फिरि मोको सुधिना रहीअद्भुतहैयहरीति ७० ॥
children.translated_text: then I had no recollection — this is a wondrous matter.' (70)

children.text: चौपाई । पीछे यह घर बैठे आई । मोसों घरमें रहन
children.translated_text: Caupāī: 'Afterwards she came and sat at home, but I could not let her stay

children.text: न पाई ॥ पहिले मैं क्योंसुधि बिसराई । लखत अंगूठी
children.translated_text: with me in the house. Why did I first forget [everything]? And upon seeing the ring,

children.text: क्यों सुधि आई ॥ भयो अचंभो योंचित माहीं । मोको
children.translated_text: why did the memory return? Such wonder arose in my heart;

children.text: जानि परत कछु नाहीं ॥ राजा यहिबिधि बचनसुनायो ।
children.translated_text: I cannot understand anything at all.' The king thus delivered his words,

children.text: मुनिबर हंसि राजहिं समुझायो ७१ ॥
children.translated_text: and the great sage, smiling, explained to the king: (71)

children.text: दोहा । शकुन्तलाको मेनका ल्याई जबै उठाय ॥
children.translated_text: Dohā: 'When <s>Menakā</s> came and carried <s>Śakuntalā</s> away,

children.text: तबहींयह धरि ध्यानमें जान्योंभेद बनाय ७२ ॥
children.translated_text: at that very time, perceiving this through meditation, I understood the mystery. (72)

children.text: दीन्हों शाप शकुंतलहि दुर्बासा करि रोष ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Durvāsā</s>, in his wrath, placed a curse upon <s>Śakuntalā</s>;

children.text: ताते तुम बेसुध भये तुम्हें कछू नहिं दोष ७३ ॥
children.translated_text: because of that you became oblivious — you are not at fault at all.' (73)

children.text: चौपाई । सोई शाप सखियन सुनि पायो । शकुंतला
children.translated_text: Caupāī: 'That curse was heard by the companions [of Śakuntalā],

children.text: को नहीं सुनायो ॥ सखियन वहमुनि जाय मनायो । तब
children.translated_text: but they did not tell <s>Śakuntalā</s>. The companions went and appeased that sage;

children.text: मुनि कछुक दया उरलायो ॥ मुनि यहकह्यो नृपहिंसुधि
children.translated_text: then the sage brought some compassion into his heart. The sage said: "The king shall regain his memory

children.text: ऐहै । जब निज लखन अंगूठी पैहै ॥ यहकहि मुनिटरि
children.translated_text: when he obtains his own ring as a token of recognition." Having said this, the grief-giving sage

children.text: गयो दुखदाई । सो यहबात सांच ठहराई ॥ पहले तुम
children.translated_text: departed. And that matter proved to be true. First you

children.text: सब सुधि बिसराई । लखन अंगूठी सब सुधि आई ॥
children.translated_text: forgot everything, and [then] upon [seeing] the ring, the token of recognition, all memory returned.

children.text: याको दुख कछु मन नहिं आनौ । मेरो कहो उचित
children.translated_text: Do not bring any sorrow about this to your mind; consider what I say to be right and proper.

children.text: करि जानौ ॥ इँद्र तुम्हें यहि हेत बुलायो । शकुंतला
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> summoned you for this very purpose — he desires to reunite you

children.text: सों चहत मिलायो ७४ ॥
children.translated_text: with <s>Śakuntalā</s>.' (74)

children.text: दोहा । शकुंतला अरुसुतसहित सबकोलियोसमाज ॥
children.translated_text: Dohā: 'Together with <s>Śakuntalā</s> and your son, take everyone in your retinue.

children.text: करो जाय घरयज्ञ अब महाराज तुम राज ७५ ॥
children.translated_text: Go home now and perform the <s>yajña</s> (sacrifice); rule, O great king!' (75)

children.text: चौपाई । इँद्रहुत होयँ कहाय पठावा । मैं तुमकोयहि
children.translated_text: Caupāī: '<s>Indra</s>'s oblation being complete, he sent word: "I summoned you

children.text: हेतु बुलावा ॥ काजौ तुमसे भयो हमारो । तुम अवअ-
children.translated_text: for this very purpose." Our purpose with you is accomplished;

children.text: पने घरहि सिधारो ७६ ॥
children.translated_text: now depart to your own home.' (76)

children.text: दोहा । योंपुनि बैठि बिमान में मुनिको कियोप्रणाम ॥
children.translated_text: Dohā: Thus, seated again in the aerial chariot, having bowed to the sage,

children.text: शकुंतलासुत सहितनृप आयो अनेधाम ७७ ॥
children.translated_text: the king, together with <s>Śakuntalā</s> and his son, arrived at his own capital. (77)

children.text: चौपाई । इहिबिधि भाग्य भाल में जाग्यो । राजा
children.translated_text: Caupāī: In this manner, the fortune inscribed on his forehead awakened. The king

children.text: राज करन फिर लाग्यो ॥ नृपके सुख सब रैयति राजी ।
children.translated_text: began to rule his kingdom once more. All the subjects were happy with the king's prosperity;

children.text: घर २ पुर में नौबति बाजी ॥ शकुंतला तब भइ पट
children.translated_text: in every house and in the city, drums of celebration resounded. <s>Śakuntalā</s> then became

children.text: रानी । यह इतनी ह्वैचुकी कहानी ७८ ॥
children.translated_text: the chief queen. This much has been the story. (78)

children.text: इतिश्रीशकुन्तलानाटककथाचतुर्योङ्कसम्पूर्णम् ॥
children.translated_text: Thus ends the fourth act of the <s>Śakuntalā</s> dramatic tale, complete.

children.text: दोहा । जो देखा सोई लिखा मोर दोष जिनि देव ॥
children.translated_text: Dohā: What I saw, that I wrote — do not find fault in me, O wise ones;

children.text: मात्रा अक्षरदोहरा बुध बिचार करि लेव ॥
children.translated_text: let the learned consider and accept the <s>mātrā</s> (meter), letters, and <s>dohā</s> (couplets).

children.text: इस मतबे में जितने प्रकारकी काब्यकी पुस्तकें छपी
children.translated_text: Of the various kinds of poetry books that have been printed at this press,

children.text: हैं उनमें से कुछ नीचे लिखीजाती हैं ॥
children.translated_text: some are described below:

children.text: नवीनसंग्रह ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Navīna Saṅgraha</s> (New Collection):

children.text: जिसमें भक्तभयहारी कुञ्जविहारी रसिकशिरोमणि श्रीकृष्ण
children.translated_text: In which various types of most excellent <s>kabitts</s> (verses) and <s>savaiyās</s> (odes) concerning the

children.text: चन्द्र और श्रीराधिकाजीके लीलाविषयक नानाप्रकारके अत्यु-
children.translated_text: sports of the devotee-fear-removing, bower-sporting, crown-jewel of connoisseurs, Śrī <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>-

children.text: त्तम कबित और सवैयादि वर्णितहैं जिसको हफ़ीजुल्लाहखांसां-
children.translated_text: candra and Śrī <s>Rādhikā</s> jī are described. This was collected with great effort by <s>Hafīzullāh Khān</s>,

children.text: ड़ीनिवासि सुदर्रिस मदर्सा मौज़ा बन्नापुर परगनै बंगर थाना
children.translated_text: resident of <s>Sāṇḍī</s>, <s>Sudarris</s> Madrasa, village <s>Bannāpur</s>, <s>pargana Baṅgar</s>, police station

children.text: बघौली स्टेशन ज़िला हरदोई ने अपने शौक़ीन दोस्तोंके दि-
children.translated_text: <s>Baghaulī</s>, district <s>Hardoī</s>, for the amusement of

children.text: लबहलानेके निमित्त अति परिश्रमसे संग्रह किया ॥
children.translated_text: his connoisseur friends.

children.text: षट्ऋतुकाव्यसंग्रह ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Ṣaṭ-Ṛtu-Kāvya-Saṅgraha</s> (Collection of Six-Season Poetry):

children.text: हफ़ीतुल्लाहख़ां संग्रहीत जिसमें वसन्त, ग्रीष्म, वर्षा, शरद
children.translated_text: Collected by <s>Hafīzullāh Khān</s>, in which <s>kabitts</s> and <s>savaiyās</s> on <s>Vasanta</s> (Spring), <s>Grīṣma</s> (Summer), <s>Varṣā</s> (Rains), <s>Śarad</s> (Autumn),

children.text: हेमन्त, शिशिर, छओ ऋतुओंके कबित्त व सवैया ऐससे२ अत्यु-
children.translated_text: <s>Hemanta</s> (early Winter), and <s>Śiśira</s> (late Winter) — the six seasons — have been selected and written with great effort

children.text: रंगीन तबीयतवाले महाशयोंके चित्तविनोदार्थ बड़े परिश्रमसे
children.translated_text: for the entertainment of gentlemen of most colorful

children.text: छांट २ कर लिखेगये हैं ॥
children.translated_text: temperament.

children.text: प्रेमतरङ्गिनी ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Prema-Taraṅgiṇī</s> (Waves of Love):

children.text: मुंशीहफ़ीजुल्लाहख़ां संग्रहीत इसमें चित्रविचित्र सामयिक
children.translated_text: Collected by Munshī <s>Hafīzullāh Khān</s>. In this, wonderfully varied seasonal

children.text: देवपक्ष व प्रत्येक ऋतुओं के कबित्त सवैया हरएक कविके बनाये
children.translated_text: <s>kabitts</s> and <s>savaiyās</s> on the divine aspect and on each of the seasons, composed by various poets,

children.text: हुये संग्रह किये गये हैं इसकी उत्तमता देखनेहीसे मालूम
children.translated_text: have been collected. Its excellence is apparent

children.text: होती है ॥
children.translated_text: upon viewing.

children.text: हफ़ीजुल्लाहखांका हजारा ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Hafīzullāh Khān kā Hazārā</s> (The Thousand of Hafīzullāh Khān):

children.text: इसमें नानाप्रकार के बहुतही उत्तम २ सब १९८४ कबित्त
children.translated_text: In this, 1984 most excellent <s>kabitts</s> of various kinds

children.text: लिखे गये हैं स्थान २ पर तसवीरैं भी बनी हैं ऐसा ग्रंथ कबित्तों
children.translated_text: have been written; illustrations have also been made at various places. Such a collection

children.text: का संग्रह कियाहुआ आजतक देखनेमेंनहीं आया उत्तमता दे-
children.translated_text: of verses has never before been seen. Its excellence

children.text: खनेसे प्रकटहोगी रसिकपुरुषोंके लिये अत्यन्त आनन्दकारी है
children.translated_text: will become apparent upon viewing; it is extremely delightful for connoisseurs.

children.text: कृष्णप्रिया ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇapriyā</s> (Beloved of Kṛṣṇa):

children.text: मंगलीप्रसाद विरचित ब्रजविलासकी तरहपर श्री कृष्णजी
children.translated_text: Composed by <s>Maṅgalīprasād</s>, in the style of <s>Brajavilāsa</s>, it contains the life of Śrī <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> jī

children.text: का जन्म से बैकुण्ठगमन पर्यन्त चरित्र है यहकाब्यालंकारयुक्त
children.translated_text: from birth to his departure to <s>Vaikuṇṭha</s>. This is a very beautiful book,

children.text: बहुतही सुन्दर पुस्तक है ॥
children.translated_text: replete with poetic ornamentation (<s>kāvyālaṅkāra</s>).

children.text: मनमोहनी ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Manamohinī</s> (The Mind-Enchantress):

children.text: हुफ़ीजुल्लाहख़ां संग्रहीत इसमें अच्छी २ दोहा मिली हुई
children.translated_text: Collected by <s>Hafīzullāh Khān</s>. In this, fine <s>dohā</s>-mixed

children.text: ग़ज़लें और बहुत उत्तम २ भजन, होली, ठुमरी, चौमासा, वि-
children.translated_text: <s>ghazals</s>, and most excellent <s>bhajans</s> (devotional songs), <s>holī</s> (spring songs), <s>ṭhumarī</s> (light classical songs), <s>caumāsā</s> (monsoon songs),

children.text: हाग भैरवी, दादरा, कबित्त और सवैया आदि विद्यमान हैं ॥
children.translated_text: <s>vihāg</s>, <s>bhairavī</s>, <s>dādrā</s>, <s>kabitts</s>, and <s>savaiyās</s>, etc. are present.

children.text: रामसुधा ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Rāmasudhā</s> (Nectar of Rāma):

children.text: जिसको ब्रजचन्दजी ने महाराजाधिराज काशीनरेश की
children.translated_text: Which <s>Brajacandajī</s> composed, by the command of the Mahārājādhirāja, the King of <s>Kāśī</s>,

children.text: आज्ञानुसार अनेक रागों व कबित्तों में श्रीरामचन्द्रजीका गुणा-
children.translated_text: singing the praises of Śrī <s>Rāmacandra</s> jī

children.text: नुवाद गाया है ॥
children.translated_text: in various <s>rāgas</s> (musical modes) and <s>kabitts</s>.

children.text: कविप्रिया सटीक ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Kavipriyā</s> with commentary (<s>saṭīka</s>):

children.text: टीका हरिचरण दास कबि कृत-जिसमें नृपबंश व कविबंश
children.translated_text: Commentary by the poet <s>Haricaraṇadāsa</s>. In it, descriptions of royal lineages and poetic lineages,

children.text: वर्णन, कवित्तदूषण, कवि व्यवस्था, गणागणफलाभाव, सामान्या-
children.translated_text: defects of verse (<s>kavittadūṣaṇa</s>), conventions of poets, effects of metrical groupings, general

children.text: लंकार, नखशिख, नायक नायका भेद और चित्रालंकारादि
children.translated_text: figures of speech (<s>sāmānyālaṅkāra</s>), head-to-toe descriptions (<s>nakhaśikha</s>), types of heroes and heroines (<s>nāyaka-nāyikā bheda</s>), and pictorial figures of speech (<s>citrālaṅkāra</s>), etc.

children.text: वर्णित हैं ॥
children.translated_text: are described.

children.text: शृ्ंगारसंग्रह ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Śṛṅgāra-Saṅgraha</s> (Collection of the Erotic Sentiment):

children.text: सरदार कवि संग्रहीत इसमें भाषा के उत्तम २ कवियों के
children.translated_text: Collected by the poet <s>Sardār</s>. In it, <s>kabitts</s> on types of heroes and figures of speech

children.text: नायकाभेद व अलंकार के कवित्तहैं और बहुतसे कवियों की
children.translated_text: by the finest poets of the Hindi (<s>bhāṣā</s>) tradition are present, and the praises of

children.text: गुणना भी लिखित हैं ॥
children.translated_text: many poets are also written.

children.text: श्यामकेलि ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Śyāmakelī</s> (Pastimes of the Dark One):

children.text: लाला गोविंद सहाय कायस्थ भटनागर सिकंदराबादी कृत,
children.translated_text: Composed by <s>Lālā Govinda Sahāya</s>, Kāyastha Bhaṭnāgar of <s>Sikandarābād</s>.

children.text: इस में श्रीकृष्ण व राधा जी के चरित्र और लीलाओं का
children.translated_text: In this, the character and pastimes of Śrī <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> and <s>Rādhā</s> jī

children.text: वर्णन है ॥
children.translated_text: are described.

children.text: कुंडलिया गिरिधरदासमूल ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Kuṇḍaliyā Giridhardāsmūla</s> (Kuṇḍaliyā Verses of Giridhardās):

children.text: इसमेंगिरिधरदास जीने सामयिक वार्त्ता, चेतावनी कुण्डलि-
children.translated_text: In this, <s>Giridhardās</s> jī has described topical matters and admonitions

children.text: योंमें वर्णन की हैं ॥
children.translated_text: in <s>kuṇḍaliyā</s> (linked couplet) verses.

children.text: कृष्णसागर ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇasāgara</s> (Ocean of Kṛṣṇa):

children.text: राधाकृष्णजी रचित जिसमें श्रीकृष्णजीका नवीन रीति से
children.translated_text: Composed by <s>Rādhākṛṣṇa</s> jī, in which the complete character of Śrī <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> jī

children.text: परिपूर्ण चरित्र वर्णितहै ॥
children.translated_text: is described in a new style.

children.text: बिश्रामसागर बहुत मोटे अक्षर बातसवीर ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Biśrāmasāgara</s> (Ocean of Repose), in very large letters, with illustrations:

children.text: जिसको महन्त श्रीरघुनाथदास रामसनेहीने प्रेमियोंके लिये
children.translated_text: Made for devotees by Mahant Śrī <s>Raghunāthadāsa Rāmasanehī</s>,

children.text: बनाया जिसमें छहों शास्त्र और अठारहों पुराणों के मत और
children.translated_text: in which the doctrines of the six <s>śāstras</s> and eighteen <s>Purāṇas</s>, and

children.text: नवीन रीति से श्रीकृष्णचन्द्र व रामजी के सरल चरित्र पद्य में
children.translated_text: the simple narratives of Śrī <s>Kṛṣṇacandra</s> and <s>Rāma</s> jī in verse,

children.text: रचेहुये हैं ॥
children.translated_text: composed in a new style, are found.

children.text: रघुवंश भाषा टीका सहित ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Raghuvaṃśa</s> (Lineage of Raghu), with Hindi commentary:

children.text: जिसके मूल श्लोकों को कालिदास कबि और भाषाटीका
children.translated_text: Whose original <s>ślokas</s> are by the poet <s>Kālidāsa</s>, and whose Hindi commentary

children.text: को राजा लक्ष्मण सिंह साहब बहादुर डिप्टीकलक्टर बुलन्द
children.translated_text: was done by Rājā <s>Lakṣmaṇ Siṃha</s> Sāhab Bahādur, Deputy Collector of <s>Bulandśahr</s>.

children.text: शहरने किया यह ऐसे कवि हैं कि इनकी कीर्ति हिन्दुस्तान से
children.translated_text: He is such a poet that his fame extends from <s>Hindustān</s> to

children.text: बिलायत तक है जिसमें राजा दिलीप का सन्तान न होने से
children.translated_text: England. In it, [the story tells of] King <s>Dilīpa</s>, who, having no offspring, goes

children.text: रानी समेत वशिष्ठजी के आश्रमपर जाकर सुरभी की पूजा का
children.translated_text: with his queen to <s>Vasiṣṭha</s> jī's hermitage, receives instruction to worship <s>Surabhī</s> [the divine cow],

children.text: उपदेशपा रानी समेत नन्दिनी गौकी सेवाकर राजाका२१दिन
children.translated_text: serves the cow <s>Nandinī</s> together with his queen, and for twenty-one days the king

children.text: गौको बनमें चराना और गौको मायासे उपजेहुये सिंहसे बचा
children.translated_text: grazes the cow in the forest. He saves the cow from a lion conjured by illusion

children.text: कर दूध और पुत्रहोने का वरदान पाना फिर दिलीपसे रघुका
children.translated_text: and receives the boon of milk and a son. Then from <s>Dilīpa</s> comes <s>Raghu</s>;

children.text: पाना दिलीपका निन्नानबे अश्वमेध यज्ञ करना और सौवें यज्ञ
children.translated_text: <s>Dilīpa</s> performs ninety-nine <s>Aśvamedha</s> (horse) sacrifices; and at the hundredth sacrifice,

children.text: में इन्द्रका घोड़ा हरलेजाने में रघु और इन्द्र से घोरयुद्ध होकर
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> steals the horse, leading to a fierce battle between <s>Raghu</s> and <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: इन्द्रका सौवें यज्ञ के फल पानेका वरदान पाना फिर रघुसे अज
children.translated_text: after which <s>Indra</s> grants the boon of the fruit of the hundredth sacrifice. Then from <s>Raghu</s> comes <s>Aja</s>,

children.text: अज से दशरथ दशरथसे रामचन्द्रादि चारों भाइयों की सम्पूर्ण
children.translated_text: from <s>Aja</s> comes <s>Daśaratha</s>, from <s>Daśaratha</s> come <s>Rāmacandra</s> and the other four brothers — the complete

children.text: कथा इत्यादि अनेक चरित्र १९ सर्गोंमें बर्णितहैं ॥
children.translated_text: story and many other narratives are described in 19 cantos (<s>sargas</s>).

children.text: प्रेमसागरबातसवीर ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Premasāgara</s> (Ocean of Love), with illustrations:

children.text: लल्लूजीलाल कबिकृत इसमें दशमस्कन्ध भागवतकी पूरी
children.translated_text: Composed by the poet <s>Lallūjīlāl</s>. In it, the complete story of the Tenth Book (<s>Daśama Skandha</s>) of the <s>Bhāgavata</s>

children.text: कथा ब्रजभाषामें वर्णितहै ॥
children.translated_text: is described in <s>Braj Bhāṣā</s> (the Braj dialect).

children.text: माधवबिलास॥
children.translated_text: <s>Mādhavavilāsa</s> (Pastimes of Mādhava):

children.text: माधवप्रसाद तेवारीजी संग्रहीत इसमें नायकाभेद के कबित्त
children.translated_text: Collected by <s>Mādhavaprasāda Tevārī</s> jī. In it, <s>kabitts</s> on the types of heroes

children.text: वर्णितहैं ॥
children.translated_text: are described.
Once, the chief among sages, <s>Kauśika</s> (Viśvāmitra), went to the forest and performed great austerities,
